Company owns and promotes the technology of hardware cold-wallet for digital assets with secure and simple UX in 220 countries today. Our customers enjoy setup time within 1 minute with the ultimate security level for digital assets on their wallet. Tangem solutions offer multi-support of a growing number of thousands of tokens by a single wallet. SBI Crypto Investment Ltd., the digital asset venture investment company wholly owned by SBI Holdings Inc., has invested $15 million into Tangem in 2019 for mass adoption of blockchain technology.

raw.description:
Who Are We?

Looking for a job that makes a real difference in our world today and one that you’ll be proud of when you look back in 20, 30 or 40 years? This is it. Clean Power Research® is advancing the energy transformation through cloud software that informs, streamlines and values energy-related decisions and processes for utilities, energy professionals and consumers.

We’re a growing company that counts 10 of the top 10 Fortune 500 utilities and many of the largest renewable energy companies in the U.S. as our customers. We’re focused on expanding our market reach and impact with new software technologies that help solve the energy industry’s hardest problems.

At Clean Power Research, every employee has a seat at the table and an important role.

Why Work Here?

  • Go from building solutions to being part of the solution
  • Join a growing team of software and energy veterans from companies like Microsoft, Amazon, Google, Oracle, General Electric and Pacific Gas & Electric
  • Bring your passion and ideas to the table
  • Use your creativity to solve hard problems and make tough decisions
  • Work in a start-up like environment coupled with the stability and customer base of an established, profitable company
  • Realize work-life balance; we like to see our families, friends and pets at night!
  • Join a growing company that expects you to grow with us and invests in your growth

Clean Power Research offers competitive compensation and benefits to full-time employees including medical/dental/vision, paid vacation, paid holidays, a bonus plan and 401(k) plan with matching.

What You’ll Be Doing as a Software Engineer

Our Engineering Team develops Software-as-a-Service (Saas) solutions hosted in the cloud using sophisticated development tools and cutting-edge cloud infrastructure. As a software engineer, you’ll be learning and contributing to the development of highly scalable, reliable, performant and secure software products.

One of the interesting and fun challenge you’ll face here is:

Energy resource workflow automation

On the PowerClerk® team, you’ll work on the leading software service for utility program automation. PowerClerk powers the rollout and adoption of distributed energy resources (e.g., solar, batteries/storage and electric vehicles) at some of the largest utilities in the U.S. by digitizing utility programs through intuitive, self-service interfaces that enable extensive process automation as well as utility back-end system integration. You’ll be writing code used by hundreds of thousands of utility employees, utility customers and energy industry professionals that helps these energy technologies get installed and have an impact.

This is a full-stack position where you’ll design, build, and own features end-to-end. You’ll be using C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, JavaScript frameworks and SQL in a cloud-hosted (AWS) environment. You’ll be part of an agile, empowered and high-performing team. You’ll have exposure to customers and the business, and be an important participant in product, design and technology decisions.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Deliver high-quality code and features with a high-degree of ownership
  • Participate in writing test automation (unit tests and integration tests) and be part of a combined engineering team
  • Collaborate with other team members to define the product and make it great
  • Participate in release testing, monitoring of performance and functionality of the service in production
  • Effectively use modern AI-assisted development tools to support software development activities including writing and understanding code, troubleshooting issues, developing tests, and improving developer productivity

Who You Are

  • 1+ years of professional software development experience
  • Someone who has strong aptitude for problem solving and consistently delivers high quality code
  • BA/BS or MS degree in Computer Science or related technical discipline
  • Experience in building web applications/services using C#/ASP.NET/SQL and running in a cloud-hosted environment is a plus
  • Some experience with AI-assisted development tools and a strong interest and willingness to learn, adopt, and become proficient with AI tools as part of the software development process
  • Passion for renewables and for advancing the energy transition to clean energy

Pay Range and Benefits

  • Base Salary Range: $90,000 to $110,000 annual depending on experience
  • Benefits: Performance-Based Bonus, Company Equity Plan
  • Benefits: Paid Time Off, Sick Time, Holidays, Medical/Dental/Vision/Life and Disability Insurance, 401(k), Parental Leave, Commuter Benefits

How To Apply

Click the link below to submit your resume. Please include a cover letter detailing your interest in this position and the renewable energy space along with your resume.  Due to the large number of applicants for our positions, we regret that we can only respond to candidates who meet our requirements.

Clean Power Research is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.

The company’s employment decisions are based on merit, competence, performance and business needs.

Role Title: Forensic SME - Firearm & Toolmark Examination

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Forensic SME - Firearm & Toolmark Examinations to contribute to a specialized project focused on evaluating and enhancing AI capabilities in forensic science. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity involves reviewing and validating AI-generated responses to complex firearm and toolmark examination scenarios, directly influencing the accuracy of AI in forensic contexts.

Scope of Work

  1. Review AI model benchmark answers for 10 forensic firearm and toolmark examination test cases.
  2. Assess the accuracy and completeness of AI-generated responses related to microscopic comparative ballistics and toolmark identification.
  3. Evaluate firing pin and breech face impression analyses for adherence to forensic laboratory methodologies.
  4. Examine responses for correct interpretation of rifling characteristics and other ballistic evidence.
  5. Provide written and verbal feedback on strengths and areas for improvement in AI model outputs.
  6. Document recommendations to enhance AI systems based on forensic laboratory standards and best practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Extensive experience in forensic firearms analysis, toolmark identification, and ballistics casework.
  2. Hands-on background in microscopic comparison and interpretation of firing pin and breech face impressions.
  3. Demonstrated expertise applying forensic laboratory standards and protocols to real-world examinations.
  4. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate complex forensic concepts clearly.
  5. Prior participation in laboratory or research projects involving comparative ballistics or toolmark analysis.
  6. Familiarity with current forensic technologies, instrumentation, and industry trends.
  7. Attention to detail and a commitment to scientific accuracy in forensic assessment and reporting.

Role Title: Marine Geology SME - Core Logging & Sedimentology

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Marine Geology SME - Core Logging & Sedimentology experts to contribute to a client's project focused on the marine sciences. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.   4. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with an emphasis on precise technical articulation and critical review.
  5. Background in conducting or supervising offshore sedimentological surveys or participating in marine core sampling projects.
  6. Familiarity with standard offshore sampling practices and the nuances of visual core description protocols.
  7. Experience reviewing or developing educational, reference, or training materials in the earth sciences is a plus.

Job Description

The World Trade Center Health Program is a limited federal health program administered by the National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health (NIOSH), part of the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) in the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS). The Program provides no-cost medical monitoring and treatment for certified WTC-related health conditions to those directly affected by the 9/11 attacks in New York, the Pentagon, and in Shanksville, Pennsylvania.

Summary:
The Member Services Processing Specialist supports day‑to‑day operations within a Third‑Party Administrator (TPA) healthcare environment by reviewing, validating, and processing member applications, certifications, transfers, appeals, designated representative appointments, documentation, and service requests. This role plays a critical part in ensuring members experience a smooth and efficient program experience, maintaining accuracy, compliance, and service quality across all processing activities. The specialist works closely with supervisors and cross‑functional teams, utilizing member services systems and tools to support timely and compliant workflow execution.

Responsibilities:

  • Process enrollment applications, documentation, certifications, transfers, appeals, and designated representative appointments and updates in accordance with program policies, SOPs, and federal requirements.

  • Review member-submitted materials for completeness, accuracy, and eligibility, ensuring all required data is properly captured and validated.

  • Analyze documentation submitted with the application and assess if the submission meets the requirements of program enrollment.

  • Perform data entry and record updates within member services tools—including digital mail center systems, entry portal, and intelligent document processing platforms—ensuring timely routing and processing of member documentation.

  • Maintain accurate and high-quality case notes, documentation, and processing records for program review, compliance, and audit readiness.

  • Communicate professionally with members, providers, and internal stakeholders regarding documentation requirements, missing information, or status updates.

  • Escalate complex or ambiguous cases to the Member Services Processing Supervisor for review and guidance.

  • Adhere to HIPAA and program privacy requirements when handling PII/PHI.

raw.description:
Why MSI? We thrive on solving challenges. As a leading MGA, MSI combines deep underwriting expertise with insurer risk capacity to create specialized insurance solutions that empower distribution partners to meet customers’ unique needs. We have a passion for crafting solutions for the important risks facing individuals and businesses. We offer an expanding suite of products – from fully-digital embedded renters coverage to high-value homeowners insurance to sophisticated commercial coverages, such as cyber liability and habitational property – delivered through agents, brokers, wholesalers and other brand partners.


Our partners and customers count on us to deliver exceptional service through a dedicated team that makes rapid resolutions a priority. We simplify the insurance experience through our advanced technology platform that supports every phase of the policy lifecycle. Bring on your challenges and let us show you how we build insurance better.


The Problem

Platform Architecture is our most overloaded cross-cutting team. Priorities are pushed down onto them from every direction. They're also the final gate in the PR approval chain (Platform Review → Staff Engineering → Platform Architecture) — not the only reviewers, but the ones who carry the heaviest review load and have the most influence over how that process is designed — which makes them a bottleneck with limited ability to control their own inbound work.


Infrastructure has a related but distinct problem. They just stood up a formal SDLC and are early in adopting ADO, and teams with dependencies on them often reach out at the last minute rather than planning ahead — disrupting their flow of work the same way competing top-down asks disrupt Platform Architecture's. They also need to get better at communicating outward: proactively flagging when scrum and product teams need to test architectural changes or enhancements, rather than that falling through the cracks after the fact.


Both teams need their capacity protected from poorly-timed, uncoordinated demands, and both need a partner who can build the two-way communication habits — inbound planning lead time and outbound impact visibility — that neither currently has.


We also want dedicated Agile coaching capacity across the broader team eventually — someone who can dig into how each team runs planning, standups, and retros, and help our strategic Agile plan translate into practice, not just theory. That's not this role's starting focus: given the depth of what's already being asked for Platform Architecture and Infrastructure, we don't want to set this person up to juggle too much on day one. We see broader coaching as a natural growth path for this role once the Platform Architecture and Infrastructure work is stable, and only if/when they have the capacity for it.


The Role

Reports to the Head of Agile or Head of AI Enabled Delivery with a dotted line to the other. Serves as the embedded Scrum Master for Platform Architecture and Infrastructure, and acts as mentor/lead to the other Scrum Masters across the organization to drive consistent execution of our Agile strategy. No direct reports.


Key Responsibilities

Core Responsibilities (Day One)

  • Prioritization gatekeeping: Push back on stakeholders, convene cross-team prioritization sessions, and protect Platform Architecture and Infrastructure capacity from competing top-down asks, maintaining clear cross-portfolio dependency maps so trade-offs are visible to stakeholders.
  • Cross-team visibility & coaching: Coach Platform Architecture and Infrastructure to proactively communicate their work, roadmap, and potential downstream impact to dependent scrum and product teams; facilitate a recurring cross-team forum until this becomes routine practice, and use it to support prioritization decisions.
  • Capacity protection for bottleneck relief: Influence and partner with Platform Architecture leadership to reduce the volume of competing top-down asks landing directly on their team, freeing their capacity to redesign the release-approval process they anchor (Platform Review → Staff Engineering → Platform Architecture). This role does not own that approval process itself — it protects the time Platform Architecture needs to fix it.
  • Ceremony-level coaching: Run and coach ceremonies for both teams, tailoring facilitation and training to each team's specific needs and maturity rather than a one-size-fits-all approach.
  • Strategic accountability: Report directly to the Heads of Agile on team health, blockers, and adherence to the strategic plan.
  • Compliance & documentation: Ensure delivery routines for Platform Architecture and Infrastructure align with applicable security, risk, and governance requirements across Baldwin partner organizations; support accurate delivery documentation and audit/accreditation readiness where required.

Growth Opportunity (As Capacity Allows)

  • SM mentorship: Provide informal lead guidance to the Scrum Masters on other teams, ensuring our strategic Agile plan is executed consistently across the org.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience as an embedded Scrum Master or Agile Coach supporting highly technical, cross-cutting engineering or infrastructure teams.
  • Strong negotiation and stakeholder-alignment skills, with the ability to balance competing priorities and drive alignment across business units and portfolios.
  • Working knowledge of Azure DevOps (ADO); familiarity with DevSecOps, multi-cloud, or CI/CD delivery environments a plus.
  • Experience with cross-portfolio dependency mapping, OKRs, and delivery/quality metrics reporting.
  • Agile certification (CSM, PSM, SAFe SSM/Advanced SM, or equivalent) preferred.

Success Metrics (6–12 Months)

  • Platform Architecture reports measurably more protected capacity (e.g., reduced ad hoc/competing asks), enabling them to own redesign of their release-approval process.
  • Recurring cross-stakeholder prioritization cadence established and adopted.
  • Recurring roadmap/impact forum between Platform Architecture, Infrastructure, and dependent teams established and running independently of this role.
  • Visible execution of the Heads of Agile's strategic plan across team ceremonies.

Growth Opportunity (As Capacity Allows)

  • Tailored coaching plans rolled out for Scrum Masters.
  • Informal coaching practices shared with Scrum Masters on other teams, if bandwidth allows once core scope is stable.

Paysafe is a global payments platform powering the experience economy, with a strong focus on the iGaming, video gaming, e-commerce, retail, travel and hospitality sectors. With 30 years of expertise in payment technology, Paysafe helps businesses and consumers lift every experience through seamless, secure payment solutions, including card payments, digital wallets such as Skrill, eCash solutions like PaysafeCard, and a suite of local payment methods. With approximately 2,900 employees across 12 countries and annualized transactional volume of $167 billion in 2025, Paysafe connects people and businesses worldwide through innovative digital payment experiences. 

Your career starts here. Help us build and deliver innovative payment solutions.


Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Sales Executive, Mid-Market, to join our team and accelerate growth in our mid-market payments segment. The ideal candidate is a seasoned merchant-services sales professional with deep payments expertise and a proven ability to engage and close mid-market accounts.
As a hunter, you’ll generate high-value opportunities, build strong client relationships, and maintain a robust sales pipeline. You’ll drive new business and expand our market share with customers processing annual volumes of $10MM to $250MM.

This position requires a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment and can independently structure productive days and weeks while collaborating closely with the broader sales team and senior leadership. Success requires strong follow-up, accurate Salesforce management, consistent execution, and personal accountability for pipeline creation and opportunity progression.


Responsibilities:
  • Proactively develop and manage a robust pipeline of mid-market leads and prospects, with a meaningful portion generated through direct prospecting and territory development.
  • Drive new business through a balanced mix of in-person field prospecting, cold calling, email, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, networking, referrals, and existing relationships. Negotiate deal terms and close high-revenue opportunities to meet and exceed sales targets.
  • Own and execute a structured territory plan, including daily and weekly priorities for pipeline creation, customer engagement, follow-up, and opportunity advancement. Collaborate with internal teams to refine selling methodologies and share successful approaches.
  • Build strong prospect and client relationships by educating decision makers on product capabilities, new offerings, and industry trends. Establish clear next steps after each meaningful interaction and maintain consistent follow-up to keep opportunities moving.
  • Monitor competitive offerings and industry trends within the mid-market space. Stay informed of regulatory changes and evolving client needs to inform sales strategy.


Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field; or equivalent experience in lieu of a degree, required.
  • Minimum 6 years’ experience in a high-performing sales role, required. Mid-market merchant services or payments experience is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to self-generate a significant portion of sales pipeline, acquire new merchant relationships, consistently secure high-value accounts, and meet or exceed sales targets.
  • Strong understanding of payment processing, merchant services, acquiring, pricing, and point-of-sale solutions. Experience with Fiserv and Clover is highly preferred.
  • Experience selling payments solutions into business-to-business customers.
  • Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills. Ability to engage clients, understand their needs, and deliver tailored solutions.

  • Proficiency with CRM and sales analytics tools. Salesforce experience is strongly preferred, along with demonstrated discipline in maintaining accurate activities, next steps, opportunity stages, close dates, and forecasts.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, and capable of working independently. Demonstrated ability to manage priorities, follow through on internal and external commitments, and operate with urgency and accountability.


Life at Paysafe
One network. One partnership. At Paysafe, this is not only our business model; this is our mindset when it comes to our team. Being a part of Paysafe means you’ll be one of over 3200 members of a world-class team that drives our business to new heights every day and where we are committed to your personal and professional growth.

Are you ready to make an impact? Join our team that is inspired by a unified vision and propelled by passion.

Our culture values humility, high trust & autonomy, a desire for excellence and meeting commitments, strong team cohesion, a sense of urgency, a desire to learn, pragmatically pushing boundaries, and accomplishing goals that have a direct business impact.  


Equal Employment Opportunity
Paysafe provides equal employment opportunities to all employees, and applicants for employment, and prohibits discrimination of any type concerning ethnicity, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other protected characteristics. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of recruitment and employment. If you need any reasonable adjustments, please let us know. Additionally, the position provides technical consultation across departments and actively participates in New Product Introduction (NPI) and process improvement projects.

  • Production Trials & Process Optimization: Plan and execute production trials for quality enhancement, process stabilization, and customized customer requirements; evaluate trial outcomes to ensure manufacturing repeatability.
  • SOP Development: Formulate, standardize, and continuously refine Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to minimize waste and optimize production cycles.
  • Technical Specifications & Quality Gates: Collaborate with engineering and operational teams to define accurate manufacturing parameters and quality control gates for both new samples and automated lines.
  • Process Assessment & NPI: Monitor and assess technical feasibility for new products, identifying potential bottlenecks early in the development lifecycle.
  • Operator Guidance & Training: Train machine operators on standardized methods and validate on-floor process compliance and operational efficiency.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with GPD, Total Quality, and Technical teams to mitigate technical risks and resolve cross-departmental alignment challenges collaboratively.
  • Education: College or University degree in Printing, Industrial Management, or related technical disciplines.
  • Experience: 1 to 2 years of relevant technical experience in manufacturing or printing. Fresh graduates with strong academic records and a proactive learning mindset are encouraged to apply.
  • Technical Knowledge: Solid understanding of manufacturing workflows, process control methodologies, and sample development.
  • Organizational Skills: Well-organized and capable of managing multiple deadline-driven priorities concurrently.
  • Language: Good English communication skills (TOEIC score ≥ 450 or equivalent).
  • Computer Skills: Proficient in Microsoft Office; hands-on experience with design software (Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop) is an advantage.
  • Soft Skills: Practical problem-solving capabilities, adaptability, and strong teamwork and communication skills.

raw.description:
First, what we’re actually doing

Fours (formerly Suger.io) helps revenue teams sell more effectively by simplifying the workflows required to buy and sell through cloud marketplaces. We make it easier for our customers to transact, manage, and grow deals across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Alibaba, Oracle and Snowflake, creating a smoother buying experience for their customers. We’ve grown quickly by becoming the end-to-end orchestration system for the fastest growing sales channel (B2B Cloud Marketplaces) leveraging AI and integrations with core systems. Today, we work with over 300 B2B customers, ranging from large enterprises like Snowflake and Intel to fast-growing startups like Glean and Vanta.

Role Overview

We’re looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to help drive new customer acquisition. This role is intentionally broad: you’ll work deals of varying sizes and complexity, partner closely with cross-functional teams, and play an active role in shaping how we sell as we grow.
This is a great role for someone who enjoys variety, wants real ownership of outcomes, and thrives in an environment where you’re trusted to run your business—not just execute a narrow motion.
Location: *Please note that candidates based in San Francisco will follow a hybrid schedule of three days per week on-site and two days remote. Candidates in all other states will be fully remote, with the possibility of transitioning to a hybrid model in the future.

What You’ll Own (for real)

  • Own the sales cycle from first conversation through close
  • Work inbound and outbound opportunities across a mix of customer sizes and use cases
  • Develop a deep understanding of our product, customers, and the cloud marketplace ecosystem
  • Run thoughtful, customer-centric discovery and product conversations
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, and Customer Success to close and grow accounts
  • Forecast accurately and manage pipeline with discipline and transparency
  • Contribute to improving sales processes, messaging, and playbooks as we scale
  • Represent the voice of the customer internally

Who This Is For

  • 3+ years of experience in a quota-carrying SaaS sales role
  • Proven ability to manage deals end-to-end and consistently hit or exceed targets
  • Comfortable selling to a range of customers and navigating varying deal complexity
  • Strong discovery and communication skills; able to explain complex workflows clearly
  • High ownership mentality—you take responsibility for outcomes, not just activity
  • Curious and adaptable; you want to understand the product, market, and buying motion deeply
  • Collaborative, low-ego approach to working across teams

Nice to Have

  • Experience at a high-growth or early-stage SaaS company
  • Exposure to AI, B2B Cloud marketplaces, partner-led sales, or complex procurement workflows
  • Background selling into high tech software companies such as platform, infrastructure, or devops
  • Experience working closely with founders or small leadership teams

Why Join Us

  • The OTE for this role is $240,000–$300,000/year, depending on experience, market location, and overall fit for the role
  • We are a driven team of ~74 people, headquartered in the Bay Area (with teams globally), and growing rapidly
  • You’ll sell into one of the fastest-growing routes to market in B2B SaaS, as cloud marketplaces become a primary way enterprises buy software
  • A chance to operate closer to the market, product, and strategy than is possible in highly segmented sales orgs
  • A product positioned at the center of how ISVs, partners, and hyperscalers transact across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud
  • Real ownership and visibility into outcomes at a stage where your work directly influences growth
  • A focused GTM team of top performers with high trust, clear expectations, and minimal bureaucracy

raw.description:
Job Description:

Sharecare is a digital healthcare company that delivers software and tech-enabled services to stakeholders across the healthcare ecosystem to help improve care quality, drive better outcomes, and lower costs. Through its data-driven AI insights, evidence-based resources, and comprehensive platform, including benefits navigation, care management, home care resources, and health information management, Sharecare helps people easily and efficiently manage their healthcare and improve their well-being. Across its three business channels, Sharecare enables health plan sponsors, health systems and physician practices, and leading pharmaceutical brands to drive personalized and value-based care at scale. AskMD by Sharecare, the company’s free AI health app, helps people describe a symptom, ask a health question, and get evidence-based guidance and a clear next step. AskMD is available in the U.S. on the App Store, Google Play, and the web. To learn more, visit sharecare.com.

Job Summary:


As the AI Engineer, you will play a critical role across vision, strategy, operations, and execution for defining and driving the transformation of Sharecare into the era of agentic engineering.


We are looking for engineers who can take a big problem domain we hand to them, disappear into it, and they come back with it working, documented, and theirs. We don’t need to check their work or meddle, because checking isn’t unnecessary. The people who have struggled here waited for scoped tickets to tell them what to do, but that’s what we have agents for.

What "a fit" looks like, concretely:


  • Demonstrate you can ship daily at high volume with a fleet of AI agents. In the interview we'll ask to see your actual setup and what you let it do unsupervised. "I use Copilot sometimes" is not this.
  • You've owned architecture across multiple companies or many codebases: staff-plus IC, chief-architect, or platform-consulting background. You've seen a dozen ways teams ship and you have opinions with scars behind them.
  • When handed an ambiguous, ugly, load-bearing problem, your instinct is to take it whole: read everything, decide, build, write the doc, tell us what you decided. Not to schedule a meeting about scope.
  • Prior experience working in healthcare and/or clinical research, on health data products including electronic health records, claims, wearables, etc. and/or remote patient monitoring technologies is a plus
  • You communicate proactively in writing. For example: a Sunday text that says "took care of it, here's the PR and what I changed."
  • 6+ years and multiple systems owned end to end

What you will own:

  • The Factory spine. Develop and improve our existing factory to maximize and align in the era of agentic engineering. Increase our throughput by 50% while maintaining a lean team. Your job is to evolve our factory platform: Merge gates, migration safety, canary and rollback on a system where a bad deploy can touch patient care.
  • The application work spine. The layer that lets AI agents and humans act on patient care with auditability and fail-closed checks. You’ll own the guardrails that ensure agents can safely provide broader components of care.
  • The data and metrics. Warehouse, analytics platform, and the pipelines that tell us what happened.
  • Architecture syncs with me. You'll have the standing I give someone who has seen more systems than I have: disagree with me, make the call in your domain, unpack it for the team when asked.

Essential Job Functions:


  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain AI and machine learning solutions to support business needs.
  • Build and optimize machine learning models, predictive analytics solutions, recommendation systems, and intelligent automation tools.
  • Develop and implement generative AI applications utilizing large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and conversational AI technologies.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate business challenges into AI-driven solutions.
  • Integrate AI and machine learning models into enterprise applications, workflows, and business processes.
  • Develop and maintain data pipelines that support model training, evaluation, deployment, and ongoing monitoring.
  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and platforms to identify opportunities for innovation and business improvement.
  • Monitor model performance and implement processes for model retraining, optimization, and lifecycle management.
  • Ensure AI solutions meet security, privacy, compliance, and governance standards.
  • Conduct testing, validation, and performance assessments of machine learning models and AI applications.
  • Collaborate with cloud engineering and infrastructure teams to deploy and scale AI solutions in cloud environments.
  • Develop technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and operational procedures for AI systems.
  • Support AI governance initiatives, including model transparency, explainability, fairness, and responsible AI practices.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to AI models, integrations, and production environments.
  • Participate in code reviews, solution design sessions, and architectural planning activities.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance on AI best practices and implementation strategies.
  • Stay current with advancements in artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, and related technologies.
  • Support strategic innovation initiatives and contribute to the organization's AI roadmap.

Qualifications


Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Information Technology, or a related field required.

Experience:

  • Minimum of at least 4 years of experience software engineering or systems architecture.
  • Experience developing, deploying, and supporting machine learning models and AI-driven applications.
  • Experience developing solutions using large language models (LLMs), generative AI platforms, and natural language processing tools preferred.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Experience working with model deployment, MLOps, DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and containerization technologies preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Familiarity with model governance, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
  • Knowledge of cloud-native AI services, distributed computing, and scalable architecture principles.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business-focused solutions and recommendations.
  • Strong collaboration and teamwork skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and business functions.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Knowledge of data privacy, cybersecurity, compliance, and responsible AI practices.
  • High level of professionalism, integrity, and accountability.

Sharecare and its subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity Employers and E-Verify users. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, equal pay, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or other status protected under applicable law.

raw.description:
The Company


We are a leading global company committed to bettering lives through cannabis.

At Canopy Growth, quality, consistency and trust guide everything we grow, make and deliver. From cultivation to consumer, we take a long-term view, with the ambition to help set the standard for the industry.

We're looking for principled, driven people who want to do meaningful work and help shape what comes next. We invest in our people, support their growth and value the different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives they bring.

We believe the best of this industry is still ahead - and we intend to lead it there. Come join us.

The Opportunity

The Procurement Specialist reporting to the Director, Strategic Partnership & Wholesale Operations, will support procurement, supplier, and contract manufacturing activities across the organization. This role is responsible for sourcing raw materials and bulk flower products, managing supplier and CMO relationships, monitoring purchasing and production performance, analyzing costs and spend trends, and identifying opportunities for savings and process improvements. The incumbent will prepare reports, forecasts, and KPI analyses to support supply chain decisions while collaborating with Supply Chain, Operations, Quality, Finance, Regulatory, and Commercial teams to ensure supply requirements are met.

Responsibilities


Procurement & Supplier Management

  • Support the procurement of raw materials, API components.
  • Analyze purchasing data, supplier pricing, lead times, minimum order quantities, and spend trends.
  • Support Bulk flower purchases and sales for both domestic and international markets.
  • Support supplier selection, qualification, onboarding, and ongoing performance management.
  • Monitor purchase orders, delivery schedules, pricing, and supplier commitments.
  • Identify opportunities for cost savings, supplier consolidation, and process improvements.
  • Maintain accurate supplier, pricing, contract, and purchasing information as well as tracking information of all orders.
  • Support negotiations with suppliers by preparing spend analyses, market comparisons, and cost models.

CMO Management

  • Support the management of Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) and external manufacturing partners.
  • Track CMO production plans, capacity, lead times, costs, and delivery performance.
  • Coordinate with CMOs on purchase orders, production schedules, material requirements, and shipment timelines.
  • Monitor CMO performance against agreed service levels, budgets, quality requirements, and delivery commitments.
  • Assist with CMO onboarding, business reviews, contract updates, and commercial negotiations including compiling the Contracts.
  • Identify and escalate potential supply, capacity, cost, or delivery risks.
  • Track key performance indicators (KPIs), including on-time delivery, cost variance, purchase price variance, supplier performance, and CMO utilization.
  • Provide data-driven insights and recommendations to support procurement and supply chain decisions.
  • Maintain accurate forecasts and scenario analysis related to supplier and manufacturing capacity.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Supply Chain, Operations, Quality, Finance, Regulatory, and Commercial teams to ensure supply requirements are met.
  • Support demand and supply planning activities.

Experience


  • Post-secondary education in Business, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, or a related field.
  • 3-5 years of procurement experience, preferably in a manufacturing or agriculture setting.
  • Experience sourcing raw materials, packaging, ingredients, API components, or manufactured products.
  • Demonstrated success managing supplier relationships, including onboarding, performance management, and issue resolution.
  • Experience supporting domestic and international procurement activities.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess spend, pricing, lead times, MOQs, and cost-saving opportunities.
  • Experience supporting supplier negotiations through spend analysis, market research, and cost modeling.
  • Knowledge of purchase order management, inventory replenishment, delivery scheduling, and contract administration.
  • Proficiency with ERP systems and Microsoft Excel skills.

Other Details


This is a full-time, remote position based out of Ontario.


Benefits - extended health and dental coverage, paid vacation and participation in our employer-supported retirement savings program.

Salary - $62,000 - $75,000

Overview

Unified is a nationwide community of providers, operations specialists, and thought leaders who look for the greatest opportunities to impact every woman’s health, at every stage of their journeys. We are unparalleled in our scale and ability to adapt to address unmet and underserved needs. Through 815+ clinics, 23 IVF labs, nationwide telehealth capabilities, and targeted case management, our 2,700+ independent, affiliated providers deliver comprehensive women’s health services and continuously work to implement methods and develop techniques or platforms that improve the healthcare experience. We remain focused on enabling the discovery of new ways for our affiliated providers to deliver the high-quality care experience women deserve, in the ways they most wish to receive it, and collaborate across our community to make our vision a reality.

The AthenaIntegration & Solution Architect is responsible for analyzing user, business, clinical, and system requirements and designing, documenting, testing, modifying, and implementing computer systems, applications, interfaces, APIs, and data integration solutions that securely and reliably exchange data across athenaOne, Athena Health Marketplace applications, third-party vendors, and enterprise systems. This role applies advanced systems analysis and application architecture expertise to develop technical specifications, design integration patterns, evaluate system performance, and direct the configuration and modification of computer systems using HL7, FHIR, RESTful APIs, and other healthcare interoperability standards.


Responsibilities

Healthcare Data Integration Architecture

  • Analyze current and future-state computer system capabilities, integration requirements, and workflow needs to establish architecture standards and technical specifications for Athena and other practice management solutions.
  • Design, document, and implement future-state computer system architectures and integration approaches for existing and new technology ecosystems.
  • Perform systems analysis with product, clinical, operational, and technology stakeholders to define integration requirements and maintain the interoperability roadmap for athenaOne, Marketplace applications, and third-party systems.
  • Translate organizational strategy, clinical priorities, and user requirements into executable technical designs for integrations, automation, application configuration, and data enablement capabilities.
  • Evaluate Athena Health features, Marketplace offerings, APIs, and interoperability standards to determine required system design, configuration, testing, and implementation approaches.
  • Design scalable, maintainable integration solutions that support system reliability, performance, security, and long-term platform modification needs.
  • Identify automation opportunities and design the technical modifications, application configurations, and integration logic needed to improve system efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Design and govern end-to-end healthcare data integration architectures using HL7 v2, FHIR, and RESTful APIs.
  • Define integration patterns for real-time, near-real-time, and batch data exchange across Athena Health, Marketplace apps, and third-party systems.
  • Ensure consistent handling of patient identity, encounters, clinical events, orders, results, and claims data.

Athena Health, Marketplace & Third‑Party Integrations

  • Architect integrations using Athena Health APIs, Marketplace‑supported interfaces, and standards-based messaging.
  • Design and oversee HL7-based integrations for clinical and operational workflows where applicable.
  • Lead FHIR-based integration strategies for modern interoperability, data access, and third-party enablement to improve patient and clinician experience
  • Evaluate when to use native Athena interfaces vs. Marketplace apps vs. external API/FHIR integrations to deliver scalable solutions
  • Ensure integrations are resilient, observable, and support retry, reconciliation, and auditing.

Product Roadmap & Strategy

  • Develop and maintain technical roadmaps for integration, interoperability, application architecture, and data platform capabilities based on systems analysis, user requirements, and platform performance needs.
  • Apply advanced knowledge of computer systems, application architecture, healthcare interoperability standards, and data exchange methods to design solutions that meet business, clinical, regulatory, security, and operational requirements.
  • Evaluate vendor platforms, EMR capabilities, and healthcare technology ecosystems from a technical architecture perspective, including interface options, API functionality, interoperability constraints, system performance, and implementation feasibility.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience performing systems analysis, application architecture, integration design, technical documentation, testing, implementation, and modification of computer systems and enterprise applications.
  • Strong understanding of application lifecycle management, software implementation methods, systems governance frameworks, security requirements, and regulatory compliance.
  • Demonstrated expertise designing and modifying large-scale application portfolios, integration platforms, and data exchange solutions to support enterprise technology requirements.
  • Experience designing, configuring, testing, and implementing automation technologies, application workflows, and system integrations in a business or healthcare technology environment.
  • In-depth knowledge of application architecture, interoperability standards, integration engines, APIs, data structures, analytics platforms, and system performance considerations.
  • Proven track record of leading technical solution design and system implementation efforts from requirements analysis through testing, deployment, monitoring, and post-implementation optimization.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders to achieve strategic objectives.
  • Extensive knowledge of healthcare industry standards, regulations, and compliance requirements, including HIPAA and other relevant healthcare regulations.
  • Experience managing technology initiatives within the healthcare sector, focusing on improving patient care and operational efficiency.
  • Understanding of healthcare-specific challenges and opportunities related to technology adoption and integration.
  • Strong experience managing SaaS solutions, including vendor selection, integration, and performance management.
  • Ability to assess vendor-provided systems, integration capabilities, interface specifications, and platform performance to determine technical fit and implementation approach.
  • Expertise in enterprise architecture frameworks, application architecture design, systems analysis, and technical solution design, ensuring computer systems and applications are scalable, secure, maintainable, and aligned with technology strategy.

OpenShift Platform Engineer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: OpenShift Platform Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$180,000 Annually
Experience Required: 8+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced OpenShift Platform Engineer to design, deploy, and operate enterprise-grade Red Hat OpenShift container platforms running mission-critical workloads across on-premises and cloud environments. In this role you will own the end-to-end platform lifecycle — from cluster provisioning and hardening, through workload onboarding and developer enablement, to ongoing operations and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in OpenShift and Kubernetes internals, strong Linux fundamentals, and a security-first mindset, and will partner with application teams, security engineers, and infrastructure stakeholders to deliver a stable, secure, and developer-friendly container platform.
Key Responsibilities
  • Architect, provision, and operate Red Hat OpenShift clusters across on-premises, virtualized, and major cloud environments, applying best practices for high availability, scalability, and security.
  • Design and implement multi-tenant OpenShift platforms with appropriate project isolation, network policies, quotas, RBAC, and security context constraints.
  • Automate cluster lifecycle operations — installation, upgrades, scaling, and decommissioning — using OpenShift installer, GitOps tooling (Argo CD, OpenShift GitOps), and IaC frameworks.
  • Onboard application development teams to the platform, providing clear self-service patterns, project templates, CI/CD integrations, and supporting documentation.
  • Operate OpenShift networking, including SDN/OVN-Kubernetes, ingress controllers, routes, network policies, and integration with enterprise firewalls and load balancers.
  • Manage OpenShift storage strategies (block, file, object), including dynamic provisioning, OpenShift Data Foundation, and integration with external storage platforms.
  • Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing using the OpenShift observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, EFK, Tempo) and integrate with enterprise SIEM and APM tools.
  • Harden the platform in collaboration with security teams, including image scanning (Quay/Clair), runtime protection, secret management, and continuous compliance with regulatory frameworks.
  • Design and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines on OpenShift using Tekton, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Argo Workflows, enabling safe and frequent application deployments.
  • Develop disaster-recovery and backup strategies for cluster state, etcd, and persistent workloads, validated through regular failover and restore drills.
  • Plan, test, and execute cluster upgrades across minor and major versions with minimal disruption to workloads, including pre-upgrade validation and rollback strategies.
  • Partner with application teams to right-size workloads, manage resource quotas, and tune cluster autoscaling for predictable performance and cost efficiency.
  • Continuously evolve platform tooling and developer experience, capturing feedback from internal users and translating it into roadmap improvements.
  • Mentor junior engineers and act as an OpenShift subject-matter expert across the broader organization.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Eight or more years of experience operating container platforms in production, with at least three years on Red Hat OpenShift.
  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of Kubernetes and OpenShift internals, including operators, CRDs, RBAC, and networking.
  • Strong Linux administration skills, including networking, performance tuning, and troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or Helm.
  • Solid experience implementing CI/CD pipelines on OpenShift or Kubernetes using Tekton, Jenkins, or Argo CD.
  • Strong scripting skills in Bash, Python, or Go.
  • Working knowledge of cluster monitoring, logging, and tracing tools.
  • Familiarity with container image security and supply chain hardening.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration or Architect-level Red Hat certification.
  • Experience operating OpenShift on at least one major public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Exposure to service mesh implementations (OpenShift Service Mesh, Istio, Linkerd).
  • Familiarity with regulated environments such as PCI-DSS, HIPAA, or SOC 2.
  • Experience with GitOps workflows using Argo CD or Flux.

How to Apply

title: Software Engineer 4/5 – Model Development and Management, AI Platform
description: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world.

raw.title: Software Engineer 4/5 – Model Development and Management, AI Platform
raw.excerpt: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world.
raw.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Netflix is the world's leading streaming entertainment service with 300M+ paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, documentaries and feature films across a wide variety of genres and languages. Machine Learning drives innovation across all product functions and decision support needs. Building highly scalable and differentiated ML infrastructure is key to accelerating this innovation.

We are seeking an ambitious software engineer to join the Model Development and Management team, that is building the user interface layer for Netflix’s AI Platform in order to accelerate the core loop of model creation, evaluation, experimentation, and deployment. In this role, you'll help shape the future of ML infrastructure at Netflix, with opportunities to contribute to open-source projects and you’ll develop expertise across the full ML lifecycle while working with cutting-edge technologies.

AI Platform and Model Development and Management team are working with various teams at Netflix. You’ll gather requirements, design, and implement products that help accelerate model development for different ML use cases. You’ll have the opportunity to work alongside our applied researchers and data scientists on the cutting edge of machine learning. You will have a strong customer focus and consistently engage with our ML community to source feedback, identify pain points, and opportunities to evolve our platform.

To be successful in this role, you must have a strong software engineering background, a keen sense of software design, have proven experience with distributed applications and ML systems, be a good communicator, and work well in large cross-functional teams.

What we are looking for:

  • Experience developing platform solutions - SDKs, developer frameworks, or internal tooling used by ML Researchers, ML Engineers, and Data Scientists, emphasizing a user-first approach and demonstrating strong user empathy.

  • Excellent software design and development skills in Python along with one of Scala, Java, C++.

  • Experience working on or alongside modern, large-scale ML services. You understand the full lifecycle from data and features to training, experiment tracking, and production deployment, and can build tooling that makes that lifecycle faster and more reliable.

  • Familiarity with ML workflow orchestration, experiment tracking, or feature/data infrastructure — ideally with tools like Metaflow, Airflow, Kubeflow, MLflow, or similar.

  • Broad understanding of core machine learning concepts and their application in large-scale, real-world machine-learning systems.

  • 5+ years of full time software engineering or machine learning experience with a bachelor’s and master’s degree; or PhD degree.

Preferred, but not required additional areas of experience:

  • Experience building machine learning models or LLMs

  • Experience designing or building agentic systems.

  • Experience working with public clouds, especially AWS.

  • Significant contributions to open source projects.

More information

To learn more about the work we do to check if it aligns with your interests, check the following articles:

  • Supporting Diverse ML Systems at Netflix

  • Metaflow

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $466,000.00 - $750,000.00. This compensation range will vary based on location.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here.

Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here.

Inclusionis a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

Job is open for no less than 7 days and will be removed when the position is filled.

raw.title: Forward - Security Engineer, Network & Infrastructure Security
raw.excerpt: THE OPPORTUNITYShyftLabs is a fast-growing data and technology company that partners with Fortune 500 and enterprise organizations to deliver innovative, data-driven solutions.
raw.description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

ShyftLabs is a fast-growing data and technology company that partners with Fortune 500 and enterprise organizations to deliver innovative, data-driven solutions. We specialize in building scalable, enterprise-grade platforms that leverage modern technologies, cloud infrastructure, and advanced engineering practices to solve complex business challenges.

We are seeking a Security Engineer, Network & Infrastructure Security to support enterprise security initiatives for one of our clients. This is a client-facing, individual contributor role that combines deep technical expertise with security architecture advisory, risk assessment, and cross-functional collaboration.

In this role, you will help define, assess, and strengthen security controls across enterprise network and infrastructure environments. You will serve as a trusted technical advisor, partnering directly with client stakeholders across Network Engineering, Infrastructure, Cloud, and Information Security to establish security standards, evaluate architecture and design decisions, and implement scalable security practices.

The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience in network and infrastructure security, a strong understanding of enterprise security architecture, and the ability to communicate complex technical concepts and recommendations to both technical teams and business stakeholders.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Define and maintain enterprise security standards, reference architectures, and configuration baselines for next-generation firewalls, intrusion prevention and detection systems, web filtering, TLS inspection, and secure web gateways. Review client network designs and implementations to ensure alignment with security requirements and industry best practices.

  • Work directly with client stakeholders to assess security requirements, provide technical recommendations, communicate risks, and guide security architecture and implementation decisions. Collaborate with engineering teams to translate security requirements into practical, scalable solutions.

  • Establish and assess security standards for VPN and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) solutions, including platforms such as Palo Alto GlobalProtect. Define access controls, device posture requirements, and compliance monitoring practices.

  • Establish standards for Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), certificate authority governance, cryptographic key management, and certificate lifecycle operations. Identify opportunities to automate certificate discovery, renewal, and compliance monitoring.

  • Define security requirements for enterprise and cloud DNS architectures, including protective DNS filtering, DNS Security Extensions (DNSSEC), split-horizon DNS, and centralized logging.

  • Develop and assess segmentation strategies and Zero Trust architectures across corporate networks, retail environments, payment card industry (PCI) zones, IoT/OT environments, and third-party connections to reduce attack surfaces and limit lateral movement.

  • Define and validate security hardening standards for Windows and Linux servers, containers, hypervisors, and network appliances. Apply CIS Benchmarks and automated compliance tools to identify configuration drift and drive remediation.

  • Investigate complex network security incidents, connectivity issues, and remote access failures. Conduct root-cause analysis, coordinate remediation with client engineering teams, and provide recommendations to prevent recurrence.

  • Ensure relevant network, DNS, proxy, endpoint, and identity telemetry is appropriately captured and integrated into Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) platforms. Partner with security operations teams to improve visibility, detection, and investigation capabilities.

  • Review firewall changes, network designs, infrastructure requests, and security exceptions for risk and compliance. Promote least-privilege access, accurate configuration and asset records, and consistent security governance.

  • Develop scripts, tools, and workflows to automate security compliance assessments, firewall rule reviews, configuration validation, and security posture reporting using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar technologies.

  • Assess existing security controls against recognized frameworks and regulatory requirements, including CIS Benchmarks, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, and PCI DSS. Document findings, recommend remediation strategies, and communicate progress to relevant stakeholders.

  • Identify opportunities to improve enterprise security architecture, reduce infrastructure exposure, standardize security controls, and embed secure-by-design principles into engineering processes.

What You'll Bring

  • 4–6 years of IT or cybersecurity experience, including at least 3 years in network security or infrastructure security engineering, architecture, or advisory roles.

  • Hands-on experience with enterprise firewall and secure access technologies such as Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco, or Zscaler.

  • Strong understanding of networking fundamentals and protocols, including TCP/IP, routing and switching, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, NAT, VPN, and TLS, with the ability to perform packet-level analysis.

  • Working knowledge of PKI, certificate lifecycle management, enterprise DNS security, and cryptographic key management.

  • Practical experience with Windows and Linux server hardening, privileged access management, vulnerability remediation, and infrastructure security controls.

  • Experience with endpoint detection and response (EDR) platforms, such as CrowdStrike, and SIEM technologies and query languages, such as KQL or SPL.

  • Familiarity with security frameworks and compliance standards, including CIS Benchmarks, NIST CSF, and PCI DSS.

  • Scripting or automation experience using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar languages to support security assurance, compliance validation, and reporting.

  • Experience assessing security architecture, reviewing technical designs, documenting standards, and providing actionable security recommendations.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage directly with clients, explain technical risks, and influence engineering decisions.

  • A consultative, collaborative approach to problem-solving, with the ability to balance security requirements, operational constraints, and business priorities.

  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and drive security initiatives through assessment, recommendation, and remediation.

Nice to Have

  • Experience securing cloud network infrastructure and logging services across AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

  • Familiarity with automated certificate management solutions, such as ACME or Venafi, and protective DNS platforms, such as Infoblox or Cloudflare.

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, including Terraform or Ansible, and integrating security guardrails into CI/CD pipelines.

  • Experience securing distributed enterprise environments, retail edge infrastructure, or IoT/OT networks.

  • Working knowledge of compliance requirements such as PCI DSS and SOX.

  • Familiarity with IT service management and change management platforms, such as Jira Service Management or ServiceNow.

  • Relevant security certifications, including CompTIA Security+, Network+, PCNSE, CCNP Security, AWS or Azure Security certifications, or GIAC credentials.

Salary Range

  • $100,000 - $120,000 (CAD)

Inclusion at ShyftLabs

We’re building something big, and we want you on the journey with us. If you’re ready to use data and innovation to make an impact, apply today and let’s grow together.
ShyftLabs is an equal-opportunity employer committed to creating a safe, diverse, and inclusive environment. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds including ethnicity, religion, disability status, gender identity, sexual orientation, family status, age, and nationality to apply. If you require accommodation during the interview process, let us know and we’ll be happy to support you.

Where you’ll work:

Remote (Guatemala)

Customer Care & Success at GoTo

At GoTo, our Customer Care & Success team helps people get the most out of technology. We use innovative, AI-driven tools and automation to make support faster and smarter. Creative thinking and teamwork are at the heart of how we solve problems and enhance customer experience. Join us and use your skills to add value for our customers and have a positive impact on everyone who uses our products.

Your Day to Day:
As a Technical Support Manager your responsibilities will:

  • Provide advanced support for VIP customers and escalations
  • Troubleshoot VoIP, SIP, networking, and UCC/ITSG product issues
  • Participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation to support critical customer needs
  • Partner with Engineering and Development teams to resolve complex technical issues
  • Identify trends, manage escalations, and ensure strong customer satisfaction
  • Document support cases and maintain SLA commitments

What We’re Looking For

As a Technical Support Manager your background will look like:

  • Experience in IT Networking or Technical Support
  • Strong troubleshooting experience with production networks
  • Knowledge of VoIP and SIP call flows
  • Excellent English communication skills
  • Ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong problem-solving mindset and willingness to learn new technologies
  • Availability to participate in a rotating on-call schedule including nights and weekends


What We Offer

At GoTo, we care about helping our people succeed at work and feel supported in life. Our employee benefits and programs are designed to support your well-being, growth, and sense of belonging. Here's what you can expect as part of our team:

  • Comprehensive health benefits
  • Generous paid time off, including paid holidays, volunteer days, quarterly self-care days, and company-designated no-meeting days
  • Tuition reimbursement and access to instructor-led and on-demand learning and development programs
  • The Thrive Global Wellness Program, a confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP), a wellness app and one-on-one wellness coaching
  • Employee-led communities and programs, including Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), GoTo Gives, and charitable matching

We work hard to create an environment where everyone feels welcome, respected, and able to contribute. Building a culture of belonging isn't just something we talk about - it's part of how we work every day.

Specific benefits and offerings may vary by country in line with local regulations and market practices.


At GoTo, you’ll find the flexibility, resources, and support you need to thrive—at work, at home, and everywhere in between. You’ll work towards a shared goal with an open-minded, cohesive team that’s greater than the sum of its parts. We’re committed to creating an inclusive space for everyone, because we know unique perspectives make us a stronger company and community. Join us and be part of a company that invests in your future, where together we’ll Be Real, Think Big, Move Fast, Keep Growing, and stay Customer Obsessed.Learn more.

description: JOB SUMMARY: Defines and maintains Molina’s security architecture framework for artificial intelligence and machine learning systems, evolving it as capabilities, deployment approaches, and threats change.

raw.title: Senior Azure Artificial Intelligence Security Architect - Remote
raw.excerpt: JOB SUMMARY: Defines and maintains Molina’s security architecture framework for artificial intelligence and machine learning systems, evolving it as capabilities, deployment approaches, and threats change.
raw.description:
JOB SUMMARY:

Defines and maintains Molina’s security architecture framework for artificial intelligence and machine learning systems, evolving it as capabilities, deployment approaches, and threats change. Creates reusable security patterns, implementation guidance, and technical requirements for secure AI adoption across enterprise platforms and business use cases. Serves as the AI/ML security subject matter expert, including for Microsoft Azure and Databricks workloads, and partners with technology teams to implement and validate controls.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES:

Designs Secure AI/ML Architectures: Develops and promotes secure, resilient, and scalable architecture patterns for AI/ML solutions built on Microsoft Azure, Databricks, and other platforms.

AI Model Security: Defines lifecycle security requirements, architecture patterns, and evaluation processes to protect the integrity, confidentiality, and availability of AI models, associated data, and dependencies. Guides teams in assessing model risks, implementing safeguards, and validating security before deployment and during operational use. Updates requirements as model technologies, deployment approaches, and threats evolve.

AI/ML Threat Modeling: Conducts comprehensive threat modeling and risk assessments specifically for AI/ML systems, identifying vulnerabilities related to model inversion, data poisoning, adversarial attacks, and prompt injection.

Agentic AI Security: Leads threat modeling, risk assessment, and security architecture for autonomous AI agents, addressing prompt injection, tool abuse, and uncontrolled agentic behavior. Defines requirements and patterns that constrain agent actions, protect data and connected resources, and establish oversight and accountability. Validates control effectiveness as agent capabilities and operating models evolve.

AI Tools and Integration Security: Defines trust boundaries, access controls, data protection, and oversight for interactions between AI systems and enterprise resources. Establishes supporting security requirements and reusable architecture patterns for AI tools, services, and integrations, including Model Context Protocol (MCP). Partners with implementation teams to validate controls protecting the integrity, confidentiality, and availability of contextual data and connected systems, and updates guidance as integration technologies evolve.

MLSecOps Integration: Collaborates with our MLOps and Data Science teams to embed automated security controls ("shift-left") into the entire machine learning development lifecycle, from data ingestion to model deployment.

Architectural Guidance: Maintains AI reference architectures and publishes security guidance, standards, and patterns addressing AI technology, development, security, privacy, and observability. Updates these architectural resources to guide secure AI implementation across the enterprise.

Strategic Advisory & Business Alignment: Consults on AI capabilities across business and technology platforms, ensuring alignment between AI architecture frameworks and the organization’s strategic goals. Offers actionable recommendations on solution design, risk mitigation, and cross-domain impacts.

Partner & Collaborate: Partners with solution architects, technology leaders, business, governance, cyber security, compliance, and privacy teams to identify AI risks, documents design decisions, and provides enterprise patterns to resolve issues.

AI Platform and Service Security: Evaluates enterprise AI platforms, products, and services against enterprise security requirements, assessing security capabilities, integration risks, and control gaps. Defines safeguards, acceptance criteria, security requirements, and deployment guidance. Partners with technology and governance teams to enable secure adoption and reassesses requirements as platform capabilities and business uses change.

Threat Research and Security Observability: Tracks emerging threats and vulnerabilities targeting AI systems and develops proactive defensive strategies. Designs security capabilities that support AI governance and observability, using threat research to inform their evolution.

Job Qualifications

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • At least 5 years of experience in a senior cybersecurity role (e.g., Security Architect, Cloud Security Engineer), or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
  • Proven, hands-on experience securing AI/ML workloads and data pipelines within Microsoft Azure and Databricks platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience translating AI threat models into reusable security architecture patterns, implementation guidance, and testable technical requirements. Ability to validate practical controls through prototypes or security testing and guide engineering teams in adopting them across multiple AI implementation types.
  • Deep understanding of the AI/ML lifecycle and MLOps practices, with the ability to identify where security controls and validation belong from data ingestion through model deployment.
  • Strong understanding of network, application, and data security controls in a cloud-native environment.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of security challenges, threat landscapes, and mitigation approaches for AI/ML systems, including generative and agentic AI. Ability to assess risks such as prompt injection, data poisoning, model inversion, adversarial attacks, tool abuse, and uncontrolled agent behavior.
  • Proficiency in Python for security testing, control-validation prototypes, and automation, with familiarity with data science and AI libraries.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Displays intellectual curiosity, integrity, and is motivated by achieving long-term business outcomes.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment and lead cross-functional teams.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Practical experience applying agentic AI security architecture, implementation requirements, and control validation approaches to autonomous systems. Demonstrated ability to assess autonomous-behavior risks and apply mitigations for common attack vectors.
  • Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and securing the infrastructure that supports it.
  • Familiarity with applying MLSecOps principles through security-testing and automation tools in Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
  • Professional certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP), or Azure Security Engineer Associate/Expert.
  • Experience translating governance, compliance, security, and privacy management requirements into security architecture.
  • Familiarity with requirements under the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) and the Health Information Technology for Economic and Clinical Health (HITECH) Act, and ability to partner with privacy, legal, and compliance teams to define AI data-handling controls, document design decisions, and produce validation evidence.
  • Experience supporting agile teams by providing guidance on design, opportunities, impact, and risks, taking account of technical and architectural debt.
  • Experience designing generative AI solutions and applying machine learning operations practices to AI models, applications, and supporting platforms. Ability to assess the architecture and security implications of unfamiliar AI technologies and apply transferable security principles as implementation approaches evolve.
  • Ability to balance the long-term (big picture) and short-term implications of individual decisions.

To all current Molina employees: If you are interested in applying for this position, please apply through the Internal Job Board.

Molina Healthcare offers a competitive benefits and compensation package. Molina Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE) M/F/D/V.
