raw.title: Senior AI Product Analyst - Voice AI Agents
raw.excerpt: DescriptionMEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States.
raw.description:
Description

MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States. We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality.

At MEDvidi, the AI Receptionist Team builds and improves Voice AI Agents that interact directly with patients and automate critical parts of the patient journey. These systems handle real-world conversations, support operational workflows, and help patients navigate care more efficiently.

As these agents become more autonomous and handle increasingly complex interactions, understanding how they behave in production becomes a critical product and business challenge.

We're hiring an AI Product Analyst to help us evaluate, monitor, and improve Voice AI systems operating at scale. You'll work at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Operations, and AI, helping the team understand how AI behaves in the real world, where it creates value, where it fails, and what should be improved next.

Why this role

  • Work on one of the most visible AI products inside MEDvidi.
  • Help shape the future of Voice AI in healthcare.
  • Influence product decisions using real production evidence.
  • High ownership in a fast-moving, product-driven medical tech company.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze production behavior of Voice AI Agents and conversational AI workflows.
  • Investigate hallucinations, inconsistencies, silent failures, and quality degradation in AI-driven conversations.
  • Work directly with call transcripts, logs, generated outputs, and operational datasets to uncover patterns and actionable insights.
  • Design evaluation frameworks for measuring AI quality, reliability, and business impact.
  • Build monitoring systems and dashboards for AI performance visibility.
  • Measure the impact of AI systems on operational efficiency, business outcomes, and patient experience.
  • Detect quality shifts, anomalies, and emerging failure modes in production environments.
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and Operations teams on AI initiatives.
  • Support rapid decision-making in fast-changing and ambiguous environments.

This role is not for you if

  • You prefer working only with structured datasets and predefined metrics.
  • You are uncomfortable analyzing raw conversations, transcripts, and AI-generated outputs.
  • You expect clearly defined answers rather than investigating ambiguous problems.
  • You are not interested in understanding how AI systems fail in production.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Analytics, Data Analytics, Operational Analytics, or analytics roles within complex production systems.
  • Strong SQL skills.
  • Python for analytical investigations and working with large-scale text datasets.
  • Experience working with ML pipelines or AI-powered products
  • Understanding of LLM limitations, hallucinations, evaluation challenges, prompt sensitivity, and AI failure modes.
  • Experience building monitoring systems, analytical frameworks, or operational dashboards.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to translate analysis into product decisions.
  • Ability to work effectively in ambiguous and fast-changing environments.
  • Fluent Russian; English level B2 or higher.
  • Ability to work CET-overlapping hours.

Would be a plus

  • Experience with conversational AI or AI agents.
  • Experience evaluating LLM outputs.
  • Experience with AI quality metrics and evaluation methodologies.
  • Experience with prompt iteration and AI evaluation frameworks.

What we offer

  • High-impact environment: A chance to influence how AI is used in real patient interactions.
  • Growth & compensation: Competitive compensation and clear growth opportunities.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote, long-term B2B collaboration.
  • Health & wellness: Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports & wellness compensation.
  • Career development: Career growth, including personalized English lessons via Preply.
  • Time off: 19 working days of vacation per year, 4 additional wellness days, and paid sick leave for the first 5 working days.
  • Culture: Thoughtful gifts for important life events.

Ready to make an impact? Send us your profile, let's build something meaningful together.

MEDvidi is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and contractors. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

raw.description:
Why Valtech? We’retheexperience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

  • The work we do and the innovation we drive
  • Our values of share, care and dare
  • A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
  • Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The opportunity

We are looking for a Senior or Lead Project Manager to join our delivery team on a long-term client engagement. You will run complex software delivery end to end, working with distributed, cross-functional teams across several countries. We need someone who combines strong technical understanding with excellent soft skills, and who own outcomes rather than just processes.

The ideal candidate

  • 6+ years of project management experience in a software development environment, including at least 3 years in client-facing roles at a service company or agency.
  • Technically strong: comfortable discussing architecture, integrations, APIs, environments and release processes with engineers. Able to challenge estimates and spot technical risk early.
  • Strong command of Agile/Scrum and hybrid delivery setups.
  • Proven ownership of scope, timeline and budget on medium to large projects.
  • Experience managing several projects or workstreams at the same time.
  • Experience leading distributed teams across countries and time zones.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, including with senior client contacts.
  • Strong negotiation skills on scope, timelines and change requests.
  • Calm and constructive in escalations and difficult conversations.
  • Clear, structured verbal and written communication.
  • Hands-on with Jira and Confluence, and with MS Office.
  • English at B2+, with confident spoken English for client calls.

Also considered

  • Candidates with prior Delivery Manager experience, provided they are ready to work hands-on at project level.

Nice to have

  • A technical background (ex-engineer, BA or QA).
  • Relevant domain experience.
  • Previous experience in management Data Engineering/Science projects will be a plus
  • Hands-on use of AI tooling in delivery.
  • Professional PM certifications (PMP, PSM, PRINCE2).

The role

You will:

  • Plan, manage and control scope, budget and timeline of software delivery projects.
  • Act as the main point of contact for the client on day-to-day delivery and own the client relationship at project level.
  • Negotiate scope, priorities and change requests with client stakeholders.
  • Identify and manage risks, dependencies and technical issues early, working closely with tech leads.
  • Allocate work and manage workload across the team.
  • Keep a distributed team aligned, motivated and productive.
  • Run Agile ceremonies and continuously improve delivery processes.
  • Provide clear, regular reporting on status, risks and budget to the client and internal management.
  • Give performance feedback to team members and input into their development.
  • At Lead level, additionally: mentor other PMs and contribute to delivery standards across the account.

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

The benefits

This is a position based in Poland.

Mental and physical health:

  • 24 working days of paid vacation
  • National holidays covered
  • Sick leave (up to 20/year)
  • Unpaid leave (up to 20/year)
  • Medical insurance
  • Multisport card OR Multikafeteria
  • Maternity & paternity leave support

Personal and professional development:

  • Internal workshops & learning initiatives
  • Professional certifications reimbursement
  • Participation in professional local & global communities
  • Growth Framework to manage expectations and define the steps to move towards the selected career
  • Mentoring program with the ability to become a mentor or a mentee to grow to a higher position

Valtech Poland has a system of progressive benefit packages – the longer you stay with the company, the more benefits you get!

Beyond a competitive compensation package, we offer:

  • Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country-dependent)
  • Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs
  • Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud!

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

About Valtech

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.

At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.

raw.description:
The Role

The BC Solution Architect is responsible for designing, implementing and ensuring solution integrity for implementation projects involving Business Central, coordinating consultant teams, and providing invaluable advice to customers regarding business system design and implementation. This role will also include contributing to the development of best practices and active participation in presales activities.

Key Responsibilities

Solution Design & Architecture:

  • Lead and assist with the development and design of end-to-end processes for BC solutions, ensuring alignment with business objectives and technical standards.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and analyze business requirements, translating them into functional design documents and configuration specifications.

  • Design scalable, flexible, and secure architecture solutions that integrate with existing systems.

  • Identify potential risks in operations and develop strategies to mitigate them.

Implementation & Deployment

  • Provide leadership and guidance to a team of functional consultants on the implementation of BC solutions, including configuration, customization, and integration with other enterprise systems.

  • Ensure smooth deployment of solutions by coordinating with project teams, managing timelines, and addressing technical challenges.

Technology Integrations:

  • Oversee the integration of BC systems with other enterprise applications

  • Ensure data integrity and consistency across integrated systems.

Project Management:

  • Collaborate with Project Managers to manage project timelines, resources, and budgets, ensuring successful delivery of solutions within scope.

The National Consumer & Logistics Sector Marketing Manager leads strategic marketing for the national Consumer & Logistics sector within the Marketing and Business Development (MBD) organization. This role partners closely with National Sector and Service Line Leaders, sector committees, consulting marketing leaders, regional sector marketing leaders, business development, and other key stakeholders to shape and execute marketing strategies that increase brand awareness, strengthen relationships, and contribute to measurable growth and opportunity conversion. As a marketing leader, this position brings a firm-first perspective, translates industry priorities into integrated campaigns and content strategies, manages national sector programs and budgets, and coaches other national marketers to deliver an Unmatched Client Experience®.

What You Will Do:

  • Serve as the central point of coordination for Consumer & Logistics marketing activities, ensuring transparency and communication of plans, decisions, calendars, account priorities, and campaign execution across sector, service, and regional marketing teams.
  • Lead the development and execution of national sector marketing strategies, plans, campaigns, and deliverables aligned to sector priorities, business objectives, go-to-market strategies, and growth goals in alignment with the sector strategic plan.
  • Work with National Sector Leaders, sector committees, and consulting leadership to identify industry themes, client needs, differentiators, value propositions, priority audiences, and revenue-generation opportunities.
  • Build and manage integrated campaign strategies, including multi-touch, multi-channel campaigns that may cross sectors, service lines, and consulting offerings.
  • Lead thought leadership strategy and execution for assigned industries, including content calendars, distribution plans, and multi-channel approach: articles, webinars, videos, case studies, testimonials, and sector-specific point of view.
  • Own and nurture national association partnerships – including the publication advertising, speaking, sponsorships, and event opportunities that elevate the firm’s brand and demonstrate return on investment.
  • Guide pre-event planning, promotion, attendee strategy, post-event follow-up, and coordination with MBD colleagues to support business development activation and opportunity conversion.
  • Collaborate with Brand & Communications, Digital, Writing, Public Relations, Data & Insights, Consulting Marketing, Regional Marketing, and Business Development teams to align roles, timing, messaging, channels, and KPIs.
  • Develop, manage, and monitor national sector marketing budgets, ensuring resources are allocated effectively and marketing investments support sector priorities.
  • Support go-to-market and business development efforts by connecting sector strategy to impact clients and prospects, target lists, pursuits, cross-selling opportunities, and relevant solutions.
  • Track, analyze, and communicate marketing performance, campaign engagement, and ROI; use insights to optimize plans and improve impact over time.
  • Actively manage sector content on the U.S. website and intranet.
  • Serve as a people and program leader by managing, coaching, and mentoring national marketers; sharing best practices; and modeling collaboration, accountability, and high-quality execution.
  • Champion a digital-first, client-centered approach to marketing that supports the firm’s commitment to operational excellence and an Unmatched Client Experience®.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 5-6 years of relevant marketing experience, including experience developing and executing strategic marketing plans, campaigns, content programs, events, and/or business development support initiatives
  • Passion for servant leadership, collaboration, and teamwork
  • Experience within the Consumer & Logistics sector preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to lead projects, manage competing priorities, influence stakeholders, and drive results in a collaborative, matrixed environment
  • Strong leadership, communication, project management, stakeholder management, and executive presence skills
  • Strong computer and software skills, including proficiency with Microsoft 365, CRM and/or marketing automation tools, project management platforms, and effective use of AI
  • Ability to travel up to 15% and support occasional activities outside normal business hours, as needed

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree
  • Prior experience at a professional services, consulting, public accounting, or B2B services firm
  • Experience leading or mentoring marketing professionals
  • Experience supporting industry, sector, service line, or account-based marketing programs
  • Working knowledge of lead generation, brand building, events, business development, strategic pursuits, client/prospect targeting, marketing analytics, and ROI measurement

raw.description:
We are looking for AIConversation Recording Contributors to join a Bosnian speech data collection project and help support the evaluation and development of the next generation of AI technologies.
Job Type: Freelance
Location: Work from home
Work Schedule:Flexible, task-based work (approximately 2–4 hours daily)
Project Duration: TBC
Start Date: Immediately
Rate: 7 USD/hour

Help Shape the Future of AI

This short project offers an opportunity to evaluate and improve speech recognition and conversational AI technologies by providing spontaneous speech collected from real-life situations.

How Your Recordings Will Be Used

The collected recordings, annotations, and related metadata will be used to evaluate the spontaneous speech capabilities of speech-enabled AI models. The compiled data may be reviewed for quality and incorporated into datasets used for research, development, testing, and improvement of AI systems.

What You’ll Do

  • Record or collect natural, spontaneous speech in accordance with the project guidelines.
  • Participate in or capture speech from approved real-life situations, such as workplace conversations or casual one-on-one discussions.
  • Complete individual or two-person conversational speech tasks, or participate in voice or voice-text interactions with an AI or machine-based system.
  • Annotate collected speech data according to the instructions provided.
  • Provide the required information and metadata related to each recording.

What We’re Looking For

  • Native-level fluency in Bosnian.
  • Authentic pronunciation and strong familiarity with the target language through everyday use.
  • Advanced level of English to understand written instructions.
  • Contributors must not imitate dialects or accents that are not their own.
  • Experience with speech recording or data annotation projects is an advantage, but not required.
  • Strong attention to detail when providing annotations and recording metadata.
  • Ability to follow detailed project and recording instructions.

Technical Requirements

  • Quiet room or recording space with minimal background noise.
  • Computer microphone or headset with microphone.
  • Reliable internet connection.
  • Ability to access and use an online recording platform.

What We Offer

  • Flexible, remote work.
  • Timely and reliable payments.
  • Opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge AI technology.
  • Access to future language and AI-related projects.
  • A flexible engagement ideal for gaining experience with AI data collection projects.

Vendor Type

When applying, please select the option that best describes your working status.

Are you a Freelancer or Private Individual?

A Freelancer is someone who has a business license and may have a VAT number or EIN for tax purposes. A VAT (Value Added Tax) number is a unique identifier assigned to a registered business in many countries; an EIN (Employer Identification Number) is a similar identifier used in the US. A Private Individual does not have a business license. If you aren’t sure, you are probably a private individual.

RWS is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. RWS will not tolerate discrimination based on any of these characteristics.

raw.excerpt: AHEAD builds platforms for digital business.  By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
raw.description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.
We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.

AHEAD is seeking a thoughtful, driven Product Manager to help build Hatch and Unity, two core platforms transforming how we deliver IT asset intelligence and management. This is a role that blends strategy, execution, and collaboration, perfect for someone energized by owning a problem space and bringing complex ideas to life.

As Product Manager, you'll own one of our product modules and the outcomes it drives, from ideation through rollout and beyond. Your work will span user discovery, stakeholder alignment, solution definition, and go-to-market delivery. From working sessions with UI/UX to stand-ups with engineering, to prototyping new solutions, to frontline user sessions, your ability to turn insight into outcomes will shape the experience of thousands of users.

In this role you will have strong opinions, loosely held. Details matter to you. You see the world of software today and regularly identify how it should be better. You have a passion for what's next and you're always eager to explore and understand something new. You understand the role AI is playing in changing how software works and what that means for its relationship to users.

And above all, you believe the client experience comes first.

What Will You Be Doing?

    • Own one of our product modules end to end: its outcomes, roadmap, and full lifecycle from concept to launch to measuring results

    • Contribute to overall product strategy and own communicating your module's roadmap to internal and external audiences

    • Define product requirements grounded in real user problems and validated feedback

    • Collaborate with UI/UX designers to bring intuitive, user-centered experiences to life

    • Work closely with stakeholders across various teams, such as platform success, marketing, operations, to ensure launches are well-coordinated and successful

    • Identify new ways to leverage AI to enhance the product experience

    • Stay deeply engaged with clients and end users: run feedback sessions, iterate quickly, and proactively surface improvement opportunities

What Does the Ideal Candidate Look Like?

  • Focus on driving outcomes over output: problems solved, metrics moved, user behavior changed, revenue influenced

    • Strong product discovery skills that turn ambiguity into insight and a strong opinion on what to do next

    • Proven user empathy: starts with the user's problem, not the feature request

    • Builder mindset: quick to make ideas tangible, quicker to throw them away when they miss

    • Works fluently with designers and engineers: translates vision into prototypes and understands technical feasibility firsthand

    • Excellent judgment balancing user value and business needs

    • Clear, concise communicator comfortable with executives, engineers, and everyone in between

    • Fluent with current AI tools, with an aptitude for using them to research, prototype, and communicate intent

Why You’ll Love It Here:

    • Join a client-centric culture where your ideas shape the tools our clients rely on every day

    • Be a builder—launch meaningful features from the ground up and influence the evolution of our platforms

    • Thrive in a collaborative environment where delivery, engineering, design, and operations work together as partners

    • Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and a healthy respect for work-life balance

Make Your Voice Heard:

    We know impactful product managers bring more than just requirements, they bring perspective. Whether you’ve led internal tools for complex orgs or helped ship customer-facing features in tight timelines, your experience matters. Share what you’ve built, how you think, and what product leadership means to you.

    Please include links to any product documentation, project briefs, launch materials, or artifacts that showcase your work and ownership.

The compensation range indicated in this posting reflects the On-Target Earnings (“OTE”) for this role, which includes a base salary and any applicable target bonus amount. This OTE range may vary based on the candidate’s relevant experience, qualifications, and geographic location.

Why AHEAD:

Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between.
We fuel growth by stacking our office with top-notch technologies in a multi-million-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning.

- Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
- 401(k)
- Paid company holidays
- Paid time off
- Paid parental and caregiver leave
- Plus more! See benefits for additional details.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.

raw.description:
Location: Remote, New York City, or Oakland, CA

Role Type: Full-time

Compensation: $170,000

Reports to: Chief Growth Officer

Visa sponsorship: Not available

Hires remotely in: United States

Experience: 8+ years

-

About the Role

The Director of Development will lead Recidiviz’s fundraising team and ensure that the organization has sufficient philanthropic capital to achieve our ambitious goals. They’ll raise largely unrestricted capital, often in rounds, which allows for strategic injections of capital for major impact opportunities.

In the year ahead, this leader will secure $20M+ in philanthropic capital dedicated to supporting Recidiviz’s expansion to new states and deeper impact. They’ll balance steady-state and big bet fundraising, securing transformational gifts alongside cultivating a broad base of funders. They’ll lead the fundraising team by setting strategy and vision for the team, pacesetting towards ambitious goals, and coaching and developing the team. And they will own Principal Gifts and relationships with our highest diligence funders, translating rigorous, data-driven impact into a compelling case for continued and expanded support.

What Success Looks Like

  • Raise $20M+ in new commitments in 2027 and is set up to raise $30M annually by 2030. Build a healthy philanthropic pipeline, steadily growing YoY revenue to match organizational growth. There’s a strategic balance of big bets and steady state fundraising. There’s a strategic mix of renewals and new funders. The Director of Development is building the pipeline for the future.
  • The funder base is engaged, with at least 4 stewardship points per year, and sees Recidiviz’s success and their success.
  • Funders feel deeply informed, engaged, and confident in the organization's trajectory and impact.
  • Materials and pitches are grounded in rigorous data and a clear impact narrative, tailored to sophisticated funder audiences. The Director of Development owns relationships with our highest diligence funders.
  • Meet the steady drumbeat of application and reporting deadlines, providing tailored, nuanced, high quality outputs without last minute scrambles.

Key Responsibilities

Funder Relationships, Big Bets

Serve as the primary relationship-holder for Recidiviz's high diligence funders.

  • Build direct, trust-based relationships with Recidiviz's largest and most rigorous funders and supporters.
  • Translate Recidiviz's technical, data-driven impact into a compelling, rigorous case for support — tailored to funders who expect real evidence, not just narrative. Partner with Impact Analytics to ensure the organization's strongest results reach funders in a form they can scrutinize and trust.
  • Prepare for and lead funder meetings and major proposal/reporting cycles, ensuring materials meet a high bar of customization and detail.
  • Steward relationships between formal asks — proactively sharing wins, answering funder questions, and maintaining trust over time.

Fundraising Strategy

Set and execute a fundraising strategy that supports the organization’s ambitious growth targets

  • Set the fundraising strategy: revenue targets, fundraising rounds, renewal vs. new funders, big bets vs. steady state
  • Support the team in executing on that strategy: support the work at all altitudes, from individual pitch strategy, to round shaping, to yearly targets.
  • Own the fundraising plan and revenue targets, working with the Chief Growth Officer, Chief Administrative Officer, and Executive Director to set priorities and track progress.

Team Leadership

Lead the fundraising team, supporting the people and processes that ensure capital is brought in sustainably

  • Manage and grow the team: set goals, coach, and build the systems — pipeline reviews, proposal calendars, reporting cadence — that let the team operate reliably.
  • Build and maintain the systems and processes (data hygiene, reporting templates, stewardship touchpoints) that let the team operate efficiently and scale as Recidiviz grows. Lead with an entrepreneurial spirit, building systems as you go, identifying what needs a quick and scrappy fix and what needs a full rebuild.
  • Represent the team’s work and priorities across the organization, ensuring fundraising needs are understood by Finance, Impact Analytics, and program teams.

Who You'll Work With

You’ll lead and manage Recidiviz’s fundraising team. That consists of a senior relationship manager, analyst, and writer. You’ll report to the Chief Growth Officer and work closely on fundraising with the Executive Director.

Outside of the fundraising team, your two greater collaborators will be Finance and Impact Analytics. You’ll have co-conspirators on both teams. With finance, you’ll work to understand and balance the financial needs of the organization. With Impact Analytics, you’ll ensure that our greatest wins reach our supporters and that all our tracking needs are met.

Importantly, in communicating the impact of Recidiviz with our supporters, you’ll interact with nearly every team at Recidiviz. You’ll frequently work with state, product, design, and GTM teams, understanding the ins and outs of Recidiviz’s impact in our state partners.

What We're Looking For

  • Significant experience in nonprofit development / for-profit fundraising leadership role, with a track record of managing a team and meeting revenue goals.
  • Excellent relationship-building skills with senior, sophisticated stakeholders, such as major donors, principals, and foundation staff.
  • Comfort and credibility with high diligence, quantitative funders — able to translate complex, data-driven impact into a clear, rigorous case for support.
  • Strong people-management skills: able to coach, set goals for, and grow the capacity of a small team.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to represent Recidiviz's mission and impact persuasively.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in government, public-sector, or B2G contexts, or with mission-driven and nonprofit organizations.
  • Existing relationships within the tech for good, economic development, justice, and adjacent fundraising ecosystems

This Role Might Not Be a Fit If…

  • You’re strongest in grassroots or peer-to-peer fundraising — Recidiviz’s growth to $30M annually in philanthropy is dependent on large institutional, multilateral, and major-gift dollars, not high-volume small gifts.
  • You’ve mostly managed a mature, steady-state portfolio — This roles will require optimizing on an existing portfolio while bringing in additional supporters via major gifts.
  • You’d rather stay behind the scenes — Recidiviz needs a Director of Development genuinely energized by being a public face of the organization at global forums and in front of funders.

Role Title: Finance & Accounting Expert

Role Type: Contract

Location: Remote, global

Required Skills:

  • Turning Real Finance Work Into a Defined Task

  • Objective Grading Criteria

  • Reconciliation and Error Diagnosis

  • Judgment in Reporting and Analysis

  • Working Across Documents

  • AI training

Opportunity Snapshot:

  • Time per task: ~10 hours per task

  • Engagement: Project-based - paid per approved task

  • Location: Fully remote - no geographic restrictions. Strong English required (B2 advanced or C1 minimum)

  • Next step: Complete the role-specific AI interview - it’s how your expertise gets in front of the client

  • Your tasks: Design realistic, multi-step finance and accounting tasks with objective criteria for grading the output

Your domain knowledge is what matters here - no prior AI experience required.

The work is to turn real finance workflows into benchmark tasks: realistic, difficult, and gradable against objective criteria. If you’ve built a review checklist, trained a junior analyst against a standard, or signed off on someone else’s workpapers, that’s the instinct this needs.

Scope of Work:

  • Design multi-step tasks drawn from real finance and accounting work — FP&A analysis, financial reporting, audit procedures, reconciliations — with realistic reference files and clear instructions.

  • Define objective grading criteria so two qualified reviewers would reach the same verdict on the same output.

  • Build tasks that require judgment rather than lookup: ones where the right answer depends on reading the materials correctly.

  • Create or source the supporting materials each task needs: spreadsheets, GL extracts, financial statements, policy documents.

  • Flag tasks that turn out to be ambiguous or ungradable instead of submitting them anyway.

  • Deliver approved tasks on schedule and at the required quality level.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of hands-on responsibility in FP&A, financial reporting, audit, reconciliations, or accounting — direct ownership of the work, not supervisory-only or adjacent exposure.

  • Experience creating or applying structured review standards: audit programs, review checklists, close checklists, grading rubrics, or training assessments.

  • Strong Excel capability and comfort reasoning across multiple documents at once.

  • CPA, CA, ACCA, CMA or equivalent is a plus, but not required.

  • Strong written English.

  • AI or LLM evaluation experience is a plus, but not required.

raw.description:
About Us

Hungryroot is using AI to build the most consumer-centric food and wellness company to ever exist. We act as your personal assistant for healthy living—getting to know your goals, lifestyle, and budget, and recommending and delivering healthy groceries, easy recipes, and essential supplements for you and your family.

It’s the easiest way to eat healthy, achieve your goals, save time, and discover new foods. We believe food is the foundation of health, convenience should not mean compromise, and that everyone is unique in how they eat and live. That’s why we’re building a future in which healthy living is both easy and enjoyable.

Hungryroot is a distributed team of top talent across 28+ U.S. states. While we have a headquarters in New York City, our remote-first culture emphasizes collaboration, team-building, and flexibility. Expect regular virtual team events, strong ownership and accountability, and an annual company retreat.

About the Role

We are seeking a Director of FP&A to own Hungryroot's financial planning, forecasting, performance reporting and serves as a strategic partner to the executive team. This role will report to the CFO and manage a team of FP&A analysts.

You'll have an opportunity to turn our rich customer and operational data into clear insights that shape how we grow, allocate capital, and improve unit economics. The ideal candidate will be able to work cross-functionally across a complex organization and be able to present to Senior Leadership, Board or Investors. If you want to help us change how people grocery shop and eat for the better, we encourage you to apply!

Important: This is a hands-on role! At Hungryroot, we are all technical individual contributors in our respective fields and as such, this role requires a deep understanding of hands-on financial modeling and financial analytics.

Responsibilities

Planning and Forecasting

  • Lead the annual operating plan and long-range plan, working with leaders across Growth, Product, Operations, Merchandising, and G&A
  • Own the monthly and quarterly forecast, including revenue, gross margin, contribution margin, opex, EBITDA, and cash
  • Build and maintain a driver-based financial model tied to customer cohorts, order frequency, basket size, and fulfillment costs

Performance Management and Reporting

  • Run the monthly business review: actuals vs. plan and forecast, variance analysis, and clear recommendations
  • Prepare board and investor materials with the CFO, including KPI dashboards and financial narratives
  • Define and track the KPIs that matter most: CAC, LTV, retention, AOV, and contribution margin per order

Strategic Partnership

  • Act as finance business partner to the executive team on pricing, marketing spend, new categories, and fulfillment network decisions
  • Lead ad hoc analyses and business cases for major investments and initiatives
  • Partner with Marketing to measure channel ROI and guide budget allocation

Team and Infrastructure

  • Hire, develop, and mentor a high-performing FP&A team
  • Improve planning tools, processes, and data infrastructure, working closely with Accounting and Data/Analytics
  • Strengthen budget ownership and accountability across departments

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in FP&A, investment banking, private equity, or corporate strategy, including 3+ years leading an FP&A function or team
  • Expert financial modeling skills, including driver-based and cohort-based models
  • Deep understanding of unit economics, P&L management, and the three financial statements
  • A track record of influencing senior leaders and presenting to boards or investors
  • Experience incorporating AI tools (Claude) into your workflow
  • Comfortable working directly with data teams and leveraging BI tools (e.g., Looker, Databricks)
  • Advanced experience with Microsoft Excel and GSuite (Google Sheets, Google Docs, etc.)
  • Experience at a high-growth consumer, e-commerce, subscription, or CPG company
  • Clear, concise communication: you turn complex analysis into simple recommendations
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a related field

Nice to Have

  • Experience in grocery, food, meal kits, or a supply-chain-heavy business
  • Familiarity with marketplace or subscription economics, including cohort retention and LTV modeling
  • Experience scaling FP&A through a major growth phase, fundraise, or IPO readiness
  • MBA or CFA

Perks & Benefits

  • Remote-first: work from home, work from our NYC office, work from anywhere in the U.S. - you decide!
  • Equity
  • Unlimited vacation policy
  • Universal paid parental leave
  • Monthly Hungryroot credit for delicious, healthy groceries
  • Comprehensive health, vision, dental, and life insurance
  • Wellbeing benefits
  • 401k with match
  • A work from home stipend to support your initial home-office setup

Expected Pay Range:$200,000 - $225,000Bonus Eligible

The employer will not sponsor applicants for work visas.

Our mission to help make healthy eating easy, accessible, and joyful is better served by a diverse workplace. We are a proud Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building an inclusive workplace. We have zero-tolerance for harassment or discrimination. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected class.

Role Title: Finance & Accounting Expert

Role Type: Contract

Location: Remote, global

Required Skills:

  • Turning Real Finance Work Into a Defined Task

  • Objective Grading Criteria

  • Reconciliation and Error Diagnosis

  • Judgment in Reporting and Analysis

  • Working Across Documents

  • AI training

Opportunity Snapshot:

  • Time per task: ~10 hours per task

  • Engagement: Project-based - paid per approved task

  • Location: Fully remote - no geographic restrictions. Strong English required (B2 advanced or C1 minimum)

  • Next step: Complete the role-specific AI interview - it’s how your expertise gets in front of the client

  • Your tasks: Design realistic, multi-step finance and accounting tasks with objective criteria for grading the output

Your domain knowledge is what matters here - no prior AI experience required.

The work is to turn real finance workflows into benchmark tasks: realistic, difficult, and gradable against objective criteria. If you’ve built a review checklist, trained a junior analyst against a standard, or signed off on someone else’s workpapers, that’s the instinct this needs.

Scope of Work:

  • Design multi-step tasks drawn from real finance and accounting work — FP&A analysis, financial reporting, audit procedures, reconciliations — with realistic reference files and clear instructions.

  • Define objective grading criteria so two qualified reviewers would reach the same verdict on the same output.

  • Build tasks that require judgment rather than lookup: ones where the right answer depends on reading the materials correctly.

  • Create or source the supporting materials each task needs: spreadsheets, GL extracts, financial statements, policy documents.

  • Flag tasks that turn out to be ambiguous or ungradable instead of submitting them anyway.

  • Deliver approved tasks on schedule and at the required quality level.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of hands-on responsibility in FP&A, financial reporting, audit, reconciliations, or accounting — direct ownership of the work, not supervisory-only or adjacent exposure.

  • Experience creating or applying structured review standards: audit programs, review checklists, close checklists, grading rubrics, or training assessments.

  • Strong Excel capability and comfort reasoning across multiple documents at once.

  • CPA, CA, ACCA, CMA or equivalent is a plus, but not required.

  • Strong written English.

  • AI or LLM evaluation experience is a plus, but not required.

About Us

Hungryroot is using AI to build the most consumer-centric food and wellness company to ever exist. We act as your personal assistant for healthy living—getting to know your goals, lifestyle, and budget, and recommending and delivering healthy groceries, easy recipes, and essential supplements for you and your family.

It’s the easiest way to eat healthy, achieve your goals, save time, and discover new foods. We believe food is the foundation of health, convenience should not mean compromise, and that everyone is unique in how they eat and live. That’s why we’re building a future in which healthy living is both easy and enjoyable.

Hungryroot is a distributed team of top talent across 28+ U.S. states. While we have a headquarters in New York City, our remote-first culture emphasizes collaboration, team-building, and flexibility. Expect regular virtual team events, strong ownership and accountability, and an annual company retreat.

About the Role

We are seeking a Director of FP&A to own Hungryroot's financial planning, forecasting, performance reporting and serves as a strategic partner to the executive team. This role will report to the CFO and manage a team of FP&A analysts.

You'll have an opportunity to turn our rich customer and operational data into clear insights that shape how we grow, allocate capital, and improve unit economics. The ideal candidate will be able to work cross-functionally across a complex organization and be able to present to Senior Leadership, Board or Investors. If you want to help us change how people grocery shop and eat for the better, we encourage you to apply!

Important: This is a hands-on role! At Hungryroot, we are all technical individual contributors in our respective fields and as such, this role requires a deep understanding of hands-on financial modeling and financial analytics.

Responsibilities

Planning and Forecasting

  • Lead the annual operating plan and long-range plan, working with leaders across Growth, Product, Operations, Merchandising, and G&A
  • Own the monthly and quarterly forecast, including revenue, gross margin, contribution margin, opex, EBITDA, and cash
  • Build and maintain a driver-based financial model tied to customer cohorts, order frequency, basket size, and fulfillment costs

Performance Management and Reporting

  • Run the monthly business review: actuals vs. plan and forecast, variance analysis, and clear recommendations
  • Prepare board and investor materials with the CFO, including KPI dashboards and financial narratives
  • Define and track the KPIs that matter most: CAC, LTV, retention, AOV, and contribution margin per order

Strategic Partnership

  • Act as finance business partner to the executive team on pricing, marketing spend, new categories, and fulfillment network decisions
  • Lead ad hoc analyses and business cases for major investments and initiatives
  • Partner with Marketing to measure channel ROI and guide budget allocation

Team and Infrastructure

  • Hire, develop, and mentor a high-performing FP&A team
  • Improve planning tools, processes, and data infrastructure, working closely with Accounting and Data/Analytics
  • Strengthen budget ownership and accountability across departments

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in FP&A, investment banking, private equity, or corporate strategy, including 3+ years leading an FP&A function or team
  • Expert financial modeling skills, including driver-based and cohort-based models
  • Deep understanding of unit economics, P&L management, and the three financial statements
  • A track record of influencing senior leaders and presenting to boards or investors
  • Experience incorporating AI tools (Claude) into your workflow
  • Comfortable working directly with data teams and leveraging BI tools (e.g., Looker, Databricks)
  • Advanced experience with Microsoft Excel and GSuite (Google Sheets, Google Docs, etc.)
  • Experience at a high-growth consumer, e-commerce, subscription, or CPG company
  • Clear, concise communication: you turn complex analysis into simple recommendations
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a related field

Nice to Have

  • Experience in grocery, food, meal kits, or a supply-chain-heavy business
  • Familiarity with marketplace or subscription economics, including cohort retention and LTV modeling
  • Experience scaling FP&A through a major growth phase, fundraise, or IPO readiness
  • MBA or CFA

Perks & Benefits

  • Remote-first: work from home, work from our NYC office, work from anywhere in the U.S. - you decide!
  • Equity
  • Unlimited vacation policy
  • Universal paid parental leave
  • Monthly Hungryroot credit for delicious, healthy groceries
  • Comprehensive health, vision, dental, and life insurance
  • Wellbeing benefits
  • 401k with match
  • A work from home stipend to support your initial home-office setup

Expected Pay Range:$200,000 - $225,000Bonus Eligible

Every school district in America runs on service. Parents need answers, teachers need support, IT teams need systems that work. Most districts cobble that together with disconnected tools, overwhelmed staff, and no real visibility into what's working.

Onflo built the platform that fixes that. Our unified service platform brings together customer service, help desk ticketing, call center operations, AI chat, and IT asset management, purpose-built for K-12 public education. When a district runs on Onflo, their staff spends less time firefighting and more time serving students and families.

You'll be the person who makes the platform do what each district needs it to do.

The Role

You'll own client solutioning for our district clients, post-implementation. When a district needs a custom workflow, a chatbot configured, a call center stood up, or a stubborn problem diagnosed, that lands with you. You'll run discovery to figure out what's really needed, build and validate the configuration, and train the district to use it. You'll scope expansion projects with Account Management and write the statements of work that delivery runs on. Small projects, you'll run end to end yourself. Larger ones, you'll scope cleanly and hand off to our Implementation team.

What you'll own

  • Solutioning for a book of district accounts: discovery, design, configuration, delivery
  • Platform customization: custom forms, workflows, chatbot and call center configuration
  • Advanced troubleshooting on escalated district issues
  • Scoping and statements of work for expansion projects, in partnership with Account Management
  • Training and webinars that leave districts more self-sufficient, not more dependent
  • Daily coordination with our India-based Client Care team, with clean written handoffs across time zones

Who Thrives Here

We'll be direct with you, because we think you'll appreciate it.

Onflo is a small, entrepreneurial team. We don't have a perfect playbook for everything. Priorities shift. This role sits between three teams (Account Management, Implementation, and Client Care) and the seams between them are yours to work. Some days that means a superintendent's cabinet in the morning and a webinar for front-office staff in the afternoon. Districts will ask for things the platform shouldn't do, and part of your job is saying so, with a better alternative attached.

The people who do their best work here genuinely like building things and teaching people to use them. They keep commitments without being chased. They push back on unworkable requests instead of quietly absorbing them. They write clearly enough that a colleague nine and a half time zones away can act without a call. And underneath it, they care about public schools and the families they serve.

If you want to advise from a distance and hand the building to someone else, this isn't your role. If you want to own the problem from "what do you need?" through "here's how it works," keep reading.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years in a post-sales technical client-facing role in B2B SaaS: technical account management, implementation, professional services, or similar
  • Hands-on platform configuration experience you personally performed: workflows, forms, integrations, or comparable
  • Experience scoping client projects and writing statements of work or equivalent
  • Experience designing and delivering client training, live and virtual
  • Able to explain the same solution to a district IT director and a school front-office team, and be understood by both
  • K-12 or public-sector experience is a plus, not a requirement; we'll teach you the industry if you bring the fundamentals

The right person reading this already knows if they're right for it. If that's you, apply.

At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Machine Learning/Artificial Intelligence powers innovation in all areas of the business, from helping members choose the right title for them through personalization, to better understanding our audience and our content slate, to optimizing our payment processing and other revenue-focused initiatives. Building highly scalable and differentiated ML infrastructure is key to accelerating this innovation.

ML models can only be as good as the data we provide them. That's why we continue to innovate on making data and feature engineering as simple, scalable, and efficient as possible. Are you interested in joining us on this mission? You will have the opportunity to build cutting-edge data and feature infrastructure that will power ML models across various domains, including personalized recommendations, payments, games, ads, and more.

The Opportunity

In this role, you will have the opportunity to build a next-generation ML data and feature platform to significantly improve the productivity of ML practitioners. Our goal is to enable our ML practitioners to easily define and test ML features and labels, while our platform takes care of the computation, storage, and serving of feature values for both high-throughput training and low-latency member-scale inference use cases.

You will also have the opportunity to build a centralized feature and embedding store to enable sharing across various ML domains. Unlocking access to these shared datasets will foster innovation through ML in new business areas that otherwise wouldn’t have been feasible. You will collaborate closely with ML practitioners and domain experts to ensure that our models are built with high-quality features and labels. You will also get to work with the broader AI Platform organization to deliver a cohesive end-user experience that significantly improves the productivity of ML practitioners.

Here are some examples of the types of things you would work on:

  • Design and build a near-real-time feature computation engine to generate ML features for both high-throughput training and low-latency inference applications.

  • Operate and manage the feature computation pipelines and feature serving infrastructure for various ML models across multiple ML domains.

  • Build and scale systems that accelerate training through performant data loading, transformation, and writing.

  • Create frameworks to streamline and expedite the availability of new data for training and serving.

  • Develop feature stores that enable feature discovery and sharing.

  • Increase the productivity of ML practitioners by making it easy to define and access features and labels for experimentation and productization.

Who We Are

Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions:

Is this identity synthetic? Detect AI-generated and manipulated voice and video.
Is this identity risky? Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals.
Is this identity known? Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals.

Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI-driven interactions.

Pindrop protects billions of high-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents.

Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.

What you’ll do

As a Research Scientist II on our core Research team, you will independently drive research initiatives, deliver reproducible experimental results, and help translate machine learning models into real-world product solutions across deepfake video, deepfake audio, and voice/identity authentication. In this role, you will:

  • Conduct research to develop new functionalities and improve existing technologies for synthetic media detection, multimodal deepfake identification (audio and video), and real-time identity authentication.
  • Design, implement, and evaluate deep learning algorithms related to audio-visual deepfake detection, speech synthesis detection, facial manipulation analysis, and biometric authentication.
  • Design, develop, and maintain internal research packages and pipelines to train, evaluate, and benchmark ML models, ensuring computational efficiency and absolute reproducibility.
  • Partner closely with research engineers and engineering teams to transition complex research prototypes into efficient, scalable, production-ready systems across cloud and edge platforms.
  • Support targeted investigations by analyzing model behavior, edge cases, attack vectors, and detection gaps, turning insights into measurable improvements in model robustness.
  • Participate in regular code and research reviews, cross-functional project syncs, and contribute to patents and peer-reviewed papers for top-tier computer vision, speech, audio, and machine learning conferences.

Who you are

  • You remain focused, persistent, and scientifically rigorous through multiple experimental iterations, navigating ambiguity in complex multimodal datasets, evolving attack techniques, and shifting methodologies.
  • You seamlessly bridge the gap between research and engineering teams, explaining complex AI/ML and biometric concepts with clarity to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • You take individual ownership of assigned research projects and workstreams, making sound technical decisions grounded in empirical data, mathematical theory, and rigorous experimental validation.
  • You follow through on your commitments, communicate research progress transparently, and maintain the highest standard of technical integrity, documentation, and model reproducibility.
  • You design, train, and evaluate machine learning models with a strong awareness of bias, drift, and operational deployment constraints, applying sound judgment to balance experimentation speed with model quality and robustness.

Your skill-set

Must-Haves:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent industry research experience).
  • 3+ years of professional or post-graduate research experience in Deep Learning, with a dedicated focus on at least one core area: computer vision (facial analysis, video processing), speech/audio processing (speaker recognition, speech synthesis detection), or voice biometrics and identity authentication.
  • Hands-on research experience in audio-visual deepfake detection, synthetic media identification, or multimodal biometric verification.
  • Strong programming proficiency in Python with a proven ability to build, maintain, and structure reproducible research tooling, experimentation frameworks, or evaluation workflows.
  • Hands-on mastery of modern machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Keras.
  • A proven track record of successful, timely project delivery and the ability to translate research findings into practical improvements, supported by peer-reviewed publications or patent contributions.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Functional programming experience in C/C++ or familiarity with model optimization and deployment tools (e.g., ONNX, TensorRT, TF-Lite, Go).
  • Practical experience with real-time streaming video or audio processing pipelines and large-scale synthetic data generation/augmentation.
  • Experience competing in or leveraging benchmarks from prominent challenges (e.g., DFDC, ASVspoof, NIST SRE/FRVT, Kaggle).
  • Familiarity with natural language processing (NLP), foundational multimodal architectures, or sequence modeling applied to authentication and spoofing detection.

What’s in it for you

At Pindrop, research sits at the intersection of AI, voice, video, fraud prevention, and identity trust. You will turn real-world interaction data into insights that protect millions of people from synthetic media and sophisticated identity manipulation:

  • Build expertise in an emerging category: Develop firsthand knowledge of multimodal deepfake detection, generative AI defenses, and real-time authentication as these technologies rapidly evolve.
  • Work with real-world data at meaningful scale: Train and evaluate models on complex audio and video datasets, identifying subtle artifacts, anomalies, and evasion tactics in high-stakes environments.
  • Bridge research and production: Partner closely with Research Scientists, Research Engineers, and Product leaders to see your algorithms transition from experimental code into live enterprise deployments.
  • Strengthen your scientific and engineering rigor: Sharpen your ability to formulate hypotheses, design reproducible evaluation pipelines, and push the state of the art in synthetic media defense.
  • Drive measurable impact: Your work directly strengthens Pindrop's defense stack against deepfake threats, fortifying trust across voice and video communications for major global enterprises.
  • Grow as an independent researcher: Take full ownership of meaningful research roadmaps while collaborating with a world-class team that balances technical excellence with sustainable culture and continuous learning.

What we offer

As a part of Pindrop, you’ll have a direct impact on our growing list of products and the future of security in the voice-driven economy. We hire great people and take care of them. Here’s a snapshot of the benefits we offer:

  • Competitive compensation package, including RSUs (Restricted Stock Units) for all employees, so everyone shares in our long-term success.
  • Remote-first environment - giving you flexibility and autonomy in how you structure your day.
  • While we work flexibly, we prioritize meaningful in-person moments through regular team on-sites, company-wide events, and intentional gatherings that foster connection, collaboration, and shared success.
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Generous health and welfare plans to choose from - including one employer-paid “employee-only” plan!
  • Best-in-class Health Savings Account (HSA) employer contribution
  • Low-cost vision and dental plans for you and your family, providing comprehensive coverage and peace of mind.
  • Paid Parental Leave - Including birth, adoptive & foster parents
  • One year of diaper delivery for your newest addition to the family! It’s our way of welcoming new Pindroplets to the family!
  • Recurring monthly phone and internet allowance to help cover essential connectivity costs and support flexible work.
  • Enhanced fertility and GLP-1 benefits to support family-building journeys and personalized health needs.
  • Annual Learning & Development stipend to support your professional growth, skill-building, certifications, and continued education.

Please note that the base pay range is a general guideline only. Pindrop considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, a candidate's work experience, education/training, and key skills, as well as market and business considerations, when extending an offer.

Not sure if this is you?

We want a diverse, global team, with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you’re not sure if you qualify, apply anyway! We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

AI - A Transformative Force

At Pindrop, we view artificial intelligence as a transformative force that, when harnessed responsibly, can unlock unprecedented value for our customers, partners and society and enable and empower us to continue to deliver cutting-edge technology to combat fraud and unblur the lines between what it means to be human versus machine.

For over 35 years, Youth Villages has transformed the lives of children and families nationwide through innovative, research-based programs focused on preserving and restoring families.

As a national leader in children’s mental and behavioral health, we serve more than 47,000 youth, young people, and their families annually across 29 states and Washington, D.C. Our proven treatment models drive long-term success in child welfare, juvenile justice, and mental health systems. At Youth Villages, we do what works — partnering with others to expand our impact and advocate for meaningful, lasting change.

We're seeking purpose-driven individuals who are passionate about making a difference. With a dedicated team of more than 5,000 staff, Youth Villages is committed to investing in and supporting our employees by offering opportunities to build a fulfilling career through professional growth, personal development, and a mission that matters— helping children and families live successfully.

For more information, please visit

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:


The Salesforce Product Manager will work closely with the Director, senior leadership, and departments to do the following as well as other duties as assigned:


  • Operate as a functional leader, working alongside the Product Analysts, to manage Salesforce
  • Serve as system lead for Salesforce and related systems and integrations
  • Support the integration of Salesforce and other systems, and coordinate activities related to the flow of data between systems
  • Prepare and maintain product roadmap(s) that defines product development in both the short and long term
  • Provide guidance to product analysts to conduct discovery to gather business requirements for projects, documenting and organizing them into features, stories, and tasks
  • Understand business needs and translate them into requirements, updating them as needed
  • Ensure solutions follow best practices as well as meet business needs
  • Oversee all administrative functions including user account maintenance, workflows, and other routine tasks
  • Manage help desk tickets and support product analysts in responding to requests for the product(s)
  • Oversee production of functional, technical, and system design training and documentation
  • Complete regular internal system audits and prepare for upgrades
  • Act as technical lead for all Salesforce projects
  • Partner with product analysts and stakeholders to understand and document current and future state business processes
  • Work with various internal and external teams to understand operational data needs and ensure solutions align
  • Facilitate testing of new functionality and manage rollouts
  • Regularly report analytics on platform utilization and functionality
  • Monitor and evaluate new technologies and features, informing the company on their potential application to the product
  • Manage relationships with vendor(s), including product licensing

Qualifications:


To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The candidate must also be a self-motivated and hard-working individual who is willing to be flexible in a fast-paced environment. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

  • Ability to critically evaluate information gathered from multiple sources, reconcile conflicts, decompose high-level information into details, abstract up from low-level information to a general understanding, and distinguish user requests from the underlying true needs
  • Demonstrated understanding of data and data management practices, specifically ability to work with data users to ensure data collection and management adhere to best practices
  • Ability to assess the impact of new requirements on current platforms and all upstream and downstream applications, systems, and processes
  • Excellent skills and experience in product and project management
  • Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines, handle and prioritize simultaneous requests, and manage laterally, upwards, and external vendors
  • Ability to communicate across all levels of the organization and work with diverse project team
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to regularly learn and adopt new technology
  • Ability to influence cross-functional teams without formal authority
  • Demonstrated experience managing employees

Education and Experience:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, Engineering, or related field or equivalent experience
  • 3+ years of product management or similar experience
  • 7+ years of Salesforce experience
  • 2+ years of technical consulting experience strongly preferred
  • Experience working with nonprofit organizations required
  • The following Salesforce certifications are required:
    • Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator II
    • Salesforce Certified Agentforce Nonprofit Consultant
    • Salesforce Certified Application Architect
  • The following Salesforce certifications are nice to have:
    • Salesforce Certified Platform Strategy Designer
    • Salesforce Certified Platform User Experience Designer
    • Salesforce Certified System Architect
    • Salesforce Certified Technical Architect
    • Salesforce Certified Platform Data Architect
    • Salesforce Certified Platform Development Lifecycle and Deployment Architect
    • Salesforce Certified Platform Identity and Access Management Architect
    • Salesforce Certified Platform Sharing and Visibility Architect
    • Salesforce Certified Omnistudio Developer

Work Environment:


Work must be performed from a secure, private home office workplace with a reliable high-speed internet connection. Environment should have moderate noise level consistent with a standard home office


Physical Demands:


  • Must be able to remain in a stationary seated position for an extended period
  • Frequent and continuous use of hands, wrists, and fingers to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, and other standard office equipment
  • Continuous near vision required for reading computer screens and documents. Constant ability to hear and speak clearly during meetings (including virtual meetings) and phone calls
  • Occasional moving about workspace
  • Occasional lifting or carrying of light office supplies, files, or laptop equipment, typically weighing less than 15 pounds

Youth Villages Benefits

  • Medical, Dental, Prescription Drug Coverage and Vision

  • 401(k)

    • 2 week paid vacation (full-time) / 1 week paid vacation (part-time)

    • 12 paid sick days per year

    • 11 paid holidays

We are seeking an AEM Developer to build and maintain enterprise-grade digital experiences on AEM Sites, AEM Assets, and AEM as a Cloud Service. The role focuses on hands-on development of components, templates, workflows, integrations, and front-end experiences using AEM’s modern stack, with strong attention to performance, content authoring experience, and long-term maintainability. The ideal candidate has shipped meaningful AEM work in production, understands modern AEM patterns including SPA editor and headless delivery, and balances technical rigor with editor and content-author needs.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and develop AEM Sites components, templates, and content fragments following modern AEM patterns.

  • Implement headless and hybrid delivery patterns using AEM Content Fragments, GraphQL APIs, and edge delivery.
  • Migrate or build implementations on AEM as a Cloud Service with cloud-native CI/CD pipelines.
  • Develop AEM Assets workflows including DAM customizations and metadata schema design.
  • Integrate AEM with Adobe Experience Cloud (Target, Analytics, Campaign) and external systems.
  • Implement personalization, A/B testing, and targeted content delivery using AEM and Adobe Target.
  • Optimize page performance, caching, and Dispatcher configuration for high-traffic sites.
  • Build CI/CD pipelines using Cloud Manager, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins for AEM deployments.
  • Participate in code reviews, contribute to standards, and document technical decisions.
  • Troubleshoot production issues spanning author, publish, and Dispatcher tiers of the AEM stack, applying systematic diagnostic techniques and partnering with infrastructure teams when issues cross tier boundaries.
  • Collaborate with content authors, designers, and product owners on authoring experience improvements.
  • Stay current with AEM releases, Cloud Service evolution, and Adobe ecosystem developments.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Eight or more years of AEM development experience.
  • Deep expertise in Java, OSGi, Sling, and HTL.

  • Hands-on experience with AEM as a Cloud Service or AEM 6.5.
  • Experience building Content Fragments, GraphQL APIs, and headless delivery patterns.
  • Strong front-end skills with modern JavaScript and build tools.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines for AEM deployments.
  • Strong troubleshooting and performance-tuning skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Adobe Certified AEM Developer credentials.
  • Experience with Edge Delivery Services and Franklin/HLX.
  • Familiarity with Adobe Experience Platform.
  • Exposure to multi-region or multi-brand AEM deployments.
  • Experience integrating AEM with commerce platforms (Magento, Salesforce Commerce Cloud).
