raw.description:
Get started on an exciting career at Element!

Element employees make a difference in the lives of others every day. We are re-defining the fleet management industry to be people first, then business – delivering on our promise of a superior client experience. This takes hard work and innovation, and we need more like-minded people on our team.

Shape the standards, architecture, and automation that power enterprise digital support.



THE OPPORTUNITY


Digital support platforms sit at the intersection of client experience, operational efficiency, and scalable automation. As Digital Support Engineer, you will own the technical direction, governance, and continuous evolution of Element's enterprise digital support platform and automation capabilities.


You will define enterprise workflow standards and automation frameworks, establish long-term platform direction, and serve as a technical authority for digital support architecture. Working across Operations, Commercial, Product, Technology, Client Experience, and other business functions, you will translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions and help guide complex architecture and workflow decisions.


This is an individual contributor role with significant enterprise influence. You will lead cross-functional digital support initiatives, evaluate emerging technologies and AI capabilities, and help strengthen the standards, controls, and technical practices that support consistent, maintainable, and scalable digital support solutions.


WHAT YOU WILL OWN


  • Own the enterprise digital support platform strategy, governance, and technical roadmap, including the long-term evolution of workflow automation capabilities, platform enhancements, and technical direction.
  • Establish and govern enterprise workflow standards and automation frameworks, including architecture principles, workflow design standards, automation methodologies, documentation, testing requirements, and quality controls.
  • Serve as a technical authority for digital support architecture by reviewing solution designs, establishing technical standards, resolving complex architecture decisions, and aligning platform capabilities with enterprise technology principles and operational objectives.
  • Lead enterprise digital support initiatives spanning multiple business units and technology teams, including requirements gathering, business process analysis, workflow design, solution optimization, and implementation activities.
  • Drive platform innovation and continuous improvement by evaluating emerging technologies, AI capabilities, vendor enhancements, and automation opportunities, and by recommending technology improvements that strengthen enterprise digital support capabilities.
  • Develop platform governance, performance measurement, and technical documentation, including key performance indicators (KPIs), governance reporting, architecture documentation, operational standards, and best practices.

YOU SHOULD CONSIDER THIS ROLE IF:


You bring strong technical judgement, systems thinking, and experience turning enterprise business needs into scalable workflow automation and digital support solutions.

  • You have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Information Systems, Business Technology, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • You have demonstrated experience designing, implementing, governing, and optimizing enterprise workflow automation or digital support platforms.
  • You have experience translating business strategies and operational requirements into scalable technical solutions and automation frameworks.
  • You have demonstrated the ability to lead complex cross-functional technical initiatives involving multiple stakeholders.
  • You bring strong analytical, problem-solving, systems-thinking, and technical troubleshooting skills.
  • You communicate clearly with both technical and business stakeholders and can influence decisions without formal authority.
  • You can balance competing priorities while independently managing multiple initiatives.

Preferred experience includes 5–7 years of progressively responsible experience supporting enterprise digital platforms, workflow automation, client engagement technologies, or conversational AI solutions; advanced experience with Fin/Intercom or comparable enterprise customer engagement platforms; defining automation standards, governance frameworks, and technical best practices; working with REST APIs, integrations, webhooks, middleware, or related technologies; evaluating emerging technologies and recommending enterprise technology improvements; and leading digital transformation or enterprise automation initiatives. Preferred certifications may include Intercom, cloud platform certifications, AI or automation platform certifications, Agile, or other relevant technical credentials.


YOU SHOULD BE ABLE TO TELL US


  • How you have designed, governed, or evolved an enterprise workflow automation or digital support platform, including the standards or architecture decisions you established.
  • About a complex cross-functional technical initiative you led, including how you translated business requirements into a scalable solution and aligned multiple stakeholders.
  • How you have created automation standards, governance frameworks, testing requirements, or technical best practices that improved consistency, maintainability, or scalability.
  • About a complex architecture or platform decision you resolved, including the competing business and technical considerations you balanced.
  • How you have evaluated an emerging technology, AI capability, vendor enhancement, or automation opportunity and turned that evaluation into a practical recommendation or improvement.
  • How you have used platform performance measures, governance reporting, or technical documentation to support platform maturity and ongoing optimization.

WHY ELEMENT


Element Fleet Management is the world's largest publicly traded pure-play automotive fleet manager, serving organizations across North America, Australia, New Zealand, and Ireland. Our work brings together deep fleet expertise with technology, data, connected vehicles, payments, and mobility capabilities.


In this role, you will help shape the technical foundation for enterprise digital support. You will work across business and technology functions, influence platform direction through technical leadership, and help evolve automation and digital support capabilities that support client experience and operational effectiveness.


LOCATION AND WORKING ARRANGEMENT


  • Location: Canada
  • Working arrangement: Remote

COMPENSATION


The hiring base salary range for this position is $99,200-$136,000 annually. This range represents the Company's good-faith estimate of the expected base salary at the time of posting. Salary ranges may vary based on the geographic location where the work is performed. The salary range listed in this posting applies only to the location identified. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including the successful candidate's qualifications, knowledge, skills, experience, internal pay equity, and relevant market data. In addition to base salary, eligible employees may participate in annual incentive programs, including bonuses, commissions, or other incentive compensation, as applicable to the role. Element also offers a comprehensive benefits package, which may include health insurance, tuition reimbursement, and retirement savings plans.

What’s in it for You
• A culture of innovation, empowerment, decision-making, and accountability
• Comprehensive health and welfare benefits that serve the needs of you and your family and foster a culture of wellness (for qualified roles)
• Additional benefits and amenities, including paid time-off programs (vacation, sick leave, and holidays) (for qualified roles)

Applicants will be required to undergo a background check only if and after a conditional offer of employment has been extended.

Element Fleet Management and its wholly owned subsidiaries are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We are pleased to consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, genetic information, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, family status, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, physical or mental disability, veteran status, military obligations or any other characteristic protected by federal, state and local laws. Disability-related accommodations during the application and interview process are available upon request. Should you require an accommodation with our hiring process please send an email to or call (800) 665-9744. Element Fleet Management also uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess applications. These tools analyze information you provide (for example, your rēsumē and screening responses) to identify job-related skills, qualifications, and experience. AI outputs do not by themselves determine whether you advance or receive an offer – they assist recruiters and hiring managers. Final hiring decisions are made by people.

  • Analyser l’environnement technologique actuel et les contraintes de transformation associées au programme;
  • Définir l’architecture technologique cible requise pour soutenir les services numériques et les solutions futures;
  • Évaluer les options de déploiement, d’hébergement, d’intégration et d’évolution des composantes technologiques;
  • Produire les analyses d’écarts entre l’environnement actuel et l’environnement cible;
  • Contribuer à la définition de principes, standards et orientations technologiques cohérents avec les objectifs du mandat;
  • Appuyer la préparation des livrables d’architecture, des tableaux de décision et des recommandations technologiques;
  • Collaborer avec les architectes d’affaires, SI et sécurité pour assurer la cohérence de l’ensemble de l’architecture cible;
  • Soutenir le client dans la structuration d’une trajectoire réaliste d’implantation.

Requirements

  • Détenir un diplôme universitaire pertinent en informatique, en génie informatique, en télécommunications ou dans un domaine connexe, ou une expérience équivalente;
  • Posséder au moins 8 ans d’expérience pertinente en architecture technologique, infrastructures, plateformes ou transformation numérique;
  • Avoir une bonne compréhension des architectures modernes, des environnements hybrides et des enjeux d’intégration technologique;
  • Expérience en définition d’architectures cibles, en recommandations de solutions et en analyse comparative d’options technologiques;
  • Capacité à documenter clairement les hypothèses, contraintes, risques et décisions d’architecture;
  • Connaissance de cadres tels que TOGAF, ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288 ou équivalents (atout);
  • Esprit de synthèse, rigueur méthodologique et orientation client;
  • Excellente capacité de communication et de rédaction en français.

Benefits

  • Du télétravail et de la flexibilité pour s’adapter à vos obligations familiales
  • Une culture entrepreneuriale favorisant la créativité et l'innovation
  • Horaires flexibles (selon le type de contrat de travail)
  • Congés en cas de maladie et à l'occasion d'événements familiaux
  • Outils informatiques adaptés
  • Espace de travail épanouissant et motivant
  • Initiatives sociales et environnementales
  • Programme d’apprentissage en milieu de travail
  • Cheminement de carrière

SALAIRE
Le salaire sera calculé sur la base du taux horaire moyen correspondant à votre profil.

LIEU DE TRAVAIL

Le lieu de travail est à 100% télétravail.

POURQUOI SE JOINDRE À TEHORA?

TEHORA est une firme québécoise multidisciplinaire reconnue pour l'excellence de ses services professionnels, de nature technique et de gestion de projets à l'échelle nationale et internationale. Notre mission est d'accompagner nos clients dans la concrétisation de leurs projets par l'excellence de notre savoir-faire et de notre créativité.

Depuis sa création en 2017, notre équipe de professionnels connait une croissance exponentielle en répondant aux besoins importants en gestion de projets multidisciplinaires, dans le domaine des transports, du génie civil, du TI et plus.

Nos collaborateurs travaillent sur des mandats aussi bien à l’interne que chez des clients d’envergures.

TEHORA se distingue par sa culture d’entreprise, axée sur le bonheur de ses employés et la diversité.

Chez TEHORA, chaque collaborateur est un membre important de l'équipe qui contribue à notre succès collectif. Nos membres ont la flexibilité requise pour avoir un équilibre entre le travail et leur vie privée, tout en menant une carrière enrichissante.

Nous offrons un environnement de travail motivant. La diversité des projets, la grande autonomie et l’interaction directe avec les clients sont appréciées. Une telle proximité est possible en raison de notre structure organisationnelle horizontale, qui se traduit par des relations de confiance et une communication efficace entre notre équipe et les clients.

Job Title: Senior Clinical Research Associate - CNS / Rare Disease (US, Central)

Job Location: Virtual United States Kansas

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Seniority Level:

Join a global Contract Resource Organization (CRO) where innovation meets purpose. At Worldwide Clinical Trials, we're driven by a shared commitment to improving lives through high-quality clinical research. Our teams are empowered to think creatively, take ownership, and deliver meaningful work that helps bring life-changing therapies to patients around the world.


With more than 4,000 professionals across the globe, we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, growth is encouraged, and every contribution makes an impact. Whether you're building your career or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and help shape the future of clinical research.


Make an Impact as a Senior CRA at Worldwide


As a Senior CRA, you’ll play a critical role in ensuring clinical studies are conducted with the highest standards of quality, patient safety, and regulatory compliance. Your expertise will help drive the successful execution of studies from site qualification through closeout, supporting the delivery of reliable data that advances clinical research.

In this role, you'll serve as a trusted partner to investigative sites, study teams, and sponsors, building strong relationships while providing leadership, guidance, and oversight across clinical trial activities. You’ll have the opportunity to influence study success through proactive monitoring, site management, and collaboration with global teams.

Your contributions will directly support high-quality study delivery by ensuring protocol adherence, regulatory compliance, timely data collection, and effective site performance throughout the clinical trial lifecycle.


Where You'll Work


This is a home-based Clinical Research Associate role supporting sites across the Midwest of the United States. Candidates must reside within the territory to effectively support site visits and study activities. You will collaborate with sites, sponsors, and global study teams while traveling to investigative sites approximately 8-10 days per month.

To best support our sites, we're seeking candidates who are based in the Midwest of the United States. Travel will primarily be regional, with occasional travel to support sites in other locations as needed.


What You'll Do

  • Manage clinical research activities at investigative sites participating in Worldwide clinical studies.
  • Identify and assess potential research sites to support successful study execution.
  • Coordinate study start-up activities, including collection of regulatory documentation and support of contract and budget processes.
  • Conduct all types of monitoring visits: Pre-Site Selection Visits (PSSVs), Study Initiation Visits (SIVs),Interim Monitoring Visits (IMVs) and Closeout Visits (COVs).
  • Train site personnel on protocol requirements, data collection processes, and safety reporting expectations.
  • Monitor site performance and provide ongoing support throughout study maintenance activities.
  • Ensure compliance with informed consent requirements, safety reporting obligations, and applicable regulatory standards.
  • Partner with sites and study teams to drive data quality, participant safety, and overall study success.
  • Support site closeout activities and ensure study requirements are completed at the conclusion of the trial.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's Degree or a Nursing Degree, along with 5+ years as a regional, traveling Clinical Research Associate.
  • Required experience monitoring CNS and Rare Disease clinical trials.
  • Requires travel within the specified region; 8 – 10 DOS monthly
  • Experience in full-service monitoring preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of clinical trial processes, site management, and regulatory requirement


Discover the Difference


We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.  Discover the Difference at Worldwide Clinical Trials. Explore additional opportunities on our careers page, visit , or connect with us on LinkedIn.

United States of America - $97,000.00 - $193,000.00

The final salary will be determined based on relevant experience, performance, education, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, we offer a competitive benefits package depending on location. We ensure pay equity and transparency and comply with all applicable labor laws. Salary information will be discussed during the interview process, and we encourage candidates to inquire about compensation at any stage.

C.H Robinson is seeking a Senior Business Intelligence Analyst who will transform open-ended business questions, freight market data, and external signals into decision-ready insights that influence commercial strategy, forecasting, and operational performance. This role combines advanced analytics, market intelligence, and business consulting to identify emerging opportunities, evaluate external market trends, and develop scalable analytical solutions that support strategic decision-making across C.H. Robinson.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

The duties and responsibilities of this position consist of, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Leverage internal and external data sources to uncover business opportunities, emerging risks, and performance trends that shape strategic priorities.
  • Apply statistical techniques and business logic to translate complex data into clear insights that drive confident, data-informed decisions.
  • Communicate findings through concise, narrative-driven storytelling tailored to executive and operational audiences.
  • Architect and maintain dynamic dashboards, KPIs, and self-service analytics tools using platforms like Power BI or Tableau.
  • Frame ambiguous business challenges into structured analytical approaches, defining requirements and recommending actionable solutions.
  • Develop predictive and forecasting models using internal and external market indicators to improve business planning and commercial decision-making.
  • Evaluate and integrate external market intelligence, economic indicators, and public data sources to uncover emerging trends and business opportunities.
  • Build prototypes and proof-of-concept analytical solutions that can be operationalized and scaled across the organization.
  • Deliver clear analytical narratives, recommendations, and visualizations that enable leaders to make informed business decisions.
  • Utilize AI-enabled tools and advanced analytics techniques to accelerate research, insight generation, and decision support.
  • Validate data, methodologies, models, and analytical outputs to ensure accuracy, reliability, and business relevance

Required Qualifications:


  • 6+years of experience in analytics, with a focus on developing business solutions using large scale, high quality data sets
  • Advanced Proficiency in SQL and experience working with relational databases.
  • Demonstrated advanced ability to work with BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Advanced Proficiency with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Azure, AWS).
  • Proficiency with Python, R, or other scripting languages for data analysis.
  • Comfortable integrating generative AI tools into analytical workflows.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Information Systems, Statistics, or a related field
  • undefinedundefined

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Understanding of data governance, data modeling, and ETL processes.
  • Experience in logistics, supply chain, or transportation industries.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Effective communicator and data/reporting/business liaison through multiple mediums
  • Values a diverse and inclusive work environment

We will review applications for this role on an ongoing basis and encourage all interested candidates to apply at their earliest convenience.

Compensation Range

$77,000.00 - $173,600.00

Your individual base pay within this range is determined by work location, which takes into account geographic cost of labor, and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base pay only and do not include additional variable compensation.

Robinson, we’re building an inclusive workplace where all employees feel they belong. If this position excites you, we welcome you to apply whether you check all the preferred qualifications or just a few. You may just be our next great fit!

Equal Opportunity

C.H. Robinson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to a workplace and performance culture that reflects the strengths of our worldwide marketplace. We value unique experiences and diverse backgrounds of our people within our company, our business relationships, and our communities. We’re committed to providing an inclusive environment, free from harassment and discrimination, where all employees feel welcomed, valued and respected.

EOE\Disabled\Veteran

Benefits

Your Health, Wealth and Self

Your total wellbeing is the foundation of our business, and our benefits support your financial, family and personal goals. We provide the top-tier benefits that matter to you most, including:

  • Three medical plans which include

    • Prescription drug coverage

    • Enhanced Fertility benefits

  • Flexible Spending Accounts

  • Health Savings Account (including employer contribution)

  • Dental and Vision

  • Basic and Supplemental Life Insurance

Are you interested in working with a leading education technology player? If so, this is the chance to apply now! 📥 PeopleCert is the global leader in the assessment and certification of language and professional skills with presence in more than 200 countries worldwide.  We are looking for a Business Development Manager with experience in developing a strong pipeline and delivering new business in their territory.

PeopleCert is seeking a dynamic and results-driven Business Development Manager to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing and nurturing client relationships, driving sales growth, and contributing to the overall success of our organization. If you are a motivated individual with a proven track record in sales and client management, we invite you to apply and be a key player in our success story.


As a Business Development Manager, your tasks will include the following:

  • Overseeing all activities within Japan to help expand the market
  • Connect with corporates, government entities and other professional organizations to help grow the awareness and the market size of PC products
  • Work closely with the PC partner organizations in Japan and help them sell more of PC products
  • Apply astute skills in account management and employ extensive professional experience in developing and nurturing high-quality business relationships at Senior Executive level
  • Maintain and achieve maximum B2B market penetration of PeopleCert products, implementing a target-driven sales strategy
  • Coordinate various aspects of activity in tandem with the company's operations base and with respect to the local market conditions and culture
  • Plan and organise personal sales strategy by maximising the Return on Time Investment for the territory/segment
  • Monitor own progress against daily/weekly/monthly targets and report accordingly to the Headquarters
  • Facilitate and expedite the resolution of customer problems and complaints, working closely with support teams
  • Participate in trade shows and conventions
  • Ensures their work and presence is aligned with company’s core values — Quality, Innovation, Passion, Integrity, Clarity, and Velocity

What we look for:

    • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is preferred.
    • At least 5+ years of proven experience in business development or sales
    • Able to make a high number of cold calls and book meetings, even in a challenging sales environment.
    • Proficient in English and Japanese.
    • Strong understanding of the education management industry and the ability to articulate our value proposition to clients.
    • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
    • Demonstrated ability to meet and exceed sales targets.
    • Proactive and self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
    • Awareness of ITIL®, Prince2 and other products of PEOPLECERT is desirable but not an absolute must.
    • Advanced written and spoken English (C2 level certification desired, LANGUAGECERT C2 LTE or C2 IESOL certificate would be a plus).
    • Advanced computer literacy is required. ECDL Advance level certification is desirable.
    • Experience in Microsoft Dynamics CRM or similar software will be considered an asset.


What we offer:

  • Competitive remuneration package
  • Work in an international, dynamic and fun atmosphere
  • Two free vouchers for all certifications from PeopleCert's Portfolio per year for all employees
  • Huge learning experience in using best practices and global environment
  • Constant personal and professional development
  • 100% Virtual Hiring Process

If you want to become a member of our international, dynamic and agile team that creates world leading software products, then we should certainly like to hear from you!

About PeopleCert

PeopleCert is a global leader in assessment and certification of professional skills, partnering with multi-national organizations and government bodies for the development & delivery of standardized exams. Delivering exams across 200 countries and in 25 languages over its state-of-the-art assessment technology, PeopleCert enables professionals to boost their careers and realize their life ambitions.

Quality, Innovation, Passion, Integrity, Clarity, and Velocity are the core values which guide everything we do.

Our offices in UK, Greece, and Cyprus boast a culture of diversity, where everyone is different, yet everyone fits in. All of us at PeopleCert are committed to the reflection of the diversity and inclusion of our customers and the communities in which we do business.

Working on Home Office (HO) Secure English Language Tests (SELTs)

Any person who is engaged by PeopleCert to work on the SELT service must undergo a Background Check (the results of which must be acceptable to PeopleCert and the HO) prior to commencing their SELT duties. All SELT personnel will be required to complete a declaration (provided by PeopleCert) where the existence of any criminal record and/or bankruptcy must be declared.

If working on the SELT service in the UK, background checks will include:

    • A basic or enhanced Disclosure Barring Service (DBS) check
    • Right to Work in the UK check (including nationality, identity and place of residence)
    • HO security check (Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) or Counter Terrorist Check (CTC)
    • Financial background check
    • Employment reference check.

If working on the SELT service anywhere in the world (outside of the UK) personnel will undergo background checks that are equivalent to those stated for the UK.

In addition, if personnel are required to speak to SELT candidates they must be appropriately skilled in English language and, where SELT services are provided anywhere in the world (outside of the UK), the official language of the relevant country.

All applications will be treated with strict confidentiality.

Position duration: ASAP to January 30, 2028

Location: Kenya, Madagascar, Mozambique, Ethiopia, South Sudan, Uganda, Zimbabwe, Malawi, Zambia

Note: this is the general coverage area of this role; this position is a Remote based position, and we will consider only qualified applicants located in these countries. Relocation is not available.

Project Overview 

Catholic Relief Services is implementing a global emergency response initiative designed to deliver timely, life‑saving humanitarian assistance in rapidly evolving crises worldwide. Over 18 months, the program enables fast, flexible action to address urgent needs arising from sudden shocks and protracted emergencies. It supports critical humanitarian sectors through context‑appropriate assistance while emphasizing operational readiness, locally led implementation, accountability to affected communities, and safe, dignified programming. Emergency Program Managers will support Kenya, Madagascar, Mozambique, Ethiopia, Sudan, South Sudan, Uganda, Zimbabwe, Malawi, and Zambia providing readiness and response support based on evolving needs, with the composition of countries adapted according to context and operational priorities. The initiative strengthens the organization’s ability to respond at speed and scale in complex and resource‑constrained environments, ensuring help reaches people most in need when it matters most.

Job Summary

You will manage and provide technical oversight of the development and implementation of the emergency response and recovery programming, particularly for large and complex projects, ensuring effective systems and processes are in place that support high-quality programming advancing Catholic Relief Services’ (CRS) work in serving the poor and vulnerable. The role contributes to CRS’ capacity, supporting target countries across a specified focus region, of emergency program across project cycle. Your management skills and knowledge will ensure that CRS delivers high-quality emergency programming and continuously works towards improving the impact of its emergency response and recovery programming.

The Emergency Program Manager I will work closely with program office, partners and other technical departments (WASH, Food Security, Cash, Shelter etc.) to support the establishment and strengthening program function, including hazard and risks mapping, response plan, MEAL readiness and donor communication channel. S/he will support the application of CRS program standards and donor requirements, contribute to readiness learning and support rapid response and lead readiness efforts for CRS program offices and partners to promote efficient, high quality and rapid humanitarian response.

Roles and Key Responsibilities

  • Provide management, guidance, and technical oversight of all new and existing emergency response and recovery projects throughout the project cycle to ensure project design, start-up, implementation and close-out are in line with CRS quality principles and standards, donor guidelines, and industry best practices.
  • Effectively manage talent for emergency response and recovery programs and supervise. Manage team dynamics and staff well-being. Provide coaching, strategically tailored individual development plans, and complete performance management for direct reports.
  • Oversee technical assistance and capacity strengthening activities in emergency response and recovery for staff and partner organizations to enhance program quality and impact.
  • Lead the development of program learning - identify opportunities for learning, research and publications in emergency response and recovery and implementation of MEAL policy. Facilitate the dissemination of promising practices and lessons learned to contribute to the agency's knowledge management agenda. Ensure integration of innovations and best practices.
  • Contribute to the proactive pursuit of opportunities for new funding to ensure growth of the program office (PO) emergency response and recovery portfolio in line with agency, regional, and PO strategic priorities. raw.description:
About Megaport

We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.

Our Team Culture

We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.
We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role

Come join us as a key contributor in improving Megaport’s internal developer experience. Sitting within the Platform Engineering team, as a Go developer, you will design, develop, and maintain the tools and APIs that power our engineering organization.

You will focus on building robust, Go-based backend services and CLI tooling that automate operational workflows, streamline access management, and ensure our systems adhere to global engineering standards at scale.

Only candidates residing in Australia or New Zealand will be considered for this role.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Develop Internal Developer Tooling: Build high-performance Go-based APIs, microservices, and CLI tools that reduce friction, automate manual processes, and enhance productivity for our engineering teams.
  • Engineer Scalable Automation: Design and implement systems that orchestrate workflows between our systems of record, SaaS platforms, and internal infrastructure.
  • Implement Governance-as-Code: Design and maintain automated systems for repository and service oversight, ensuring our engineering ecosystem remains consistent, secure, and aligned with organizational standards as we scale.
  • Build Self-Service Infrastructure: Create and maintain the automated interfaces and abstractions that allow teams to request and manage infrastructure resources securely without Platform team intervention.
  • Operate and Optimize: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, deploy, and maintain reliable, Go-based backend systems hosted on Kubernetes/EKS. Take ownership of performance profiling and tuning to ensure platform responsiveness and reliability.

What We Are Looking For

  • Proven professional experience as a Backend Engineer using Go.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Demonstrated experience with building services on top of Kubernetes.
  • Solid knowledge of scalable web service development, including RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and distributed systems.
  • Strong proficiency in designing and consuming APIs, including managing authentication and authorization protocols.
  • Proficiency in database management, with hands-on experience in optimizing database performance, designing schemas, and query optimization.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to deliver high-quality code in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience with performance profiling and debugging tools to optimize system performance.
  • Experience managing infrastructure on AWS and working with GitHub as a core platform.
  • Solid understanding of version control systems (Git) and continuous integration/delivery.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively in a team-oriented environment.
  • Experience building internal developer-facing tools or CLI applications.
  • Passion for 'Platform as a Product'—you enjoy identifying bottlenecks in the developer lifecycle and building automated solutions to solve them.

What We Offer

  • Flexible working environment – a remote-first culture with coworking options available
  • Generous leave plans – including, parental leave, birthday leave, and a purchased annual leave program
  • Health and wellness support – through a wellness allowance and employee wellbeing initiatives
  • Comprehensive learning support – generous study and training allowance plus paid study leave
  • Creative, modern workspaces – designed to inspire when you're not working remotely, plus access to coworking spaces via our global WeWork membership if you work remotely, but like to get out of the house sometimes
  • Motivated, inclusive team – work alongside industry experts and fresh talent
  • Recognition programs – celebrate achievements with our Legend and Kudos award
If you have any questions, please reach out to Megaport's Talent Acquisition Team at
NOTE: All Megaport business correspondence is conducted via our business email accounts (@megaport.com). If you have any concerns, please reach out to Megaport's careers team directly and we will verify the legitimacy of any communication. Megaport will not ask you to create an account via Microsoft teams, and does not associate with any email accounts under "@megaportau.com".
All applications will be treated in confidence.
Please see Part 2 of our Privacy Policy to see what information Megaport collects from job applicants, why, and how we store and use it. Note that you’re entitled to know what personal data of yours Megaport holds, to request updates, rectification, and in some circumstances restriction or deletion thereof if you object (you being entitled to withdraw your consent to our holding your information at any time). raw.description:
At Dscout, we’re building the most flexible and powerful UX research platform on the market—trusted by the world’s top brands in finance (JP Morgan Chase, Intuit, Charles Schwab, PayPal), healthcare (Aya, Headspace), consumer goods (Keen, Verizon, Target, Northface), and tech (Google, Amazon, Facebook, Meta, Spotify, AirBnB). Our tools help teams deeply understand the humans behind their products, so they can build better ones. We are expanding our smart and driven team and would love for you to join us.

Building AI-native products is a different problem than building deterministic software: the same input won't always produce the same output. Good product engineering here means designing experiences that stay useful, trustworthy, and easy to understand even when the AI underneath doesn't behave the same way twice — and knowing when that's a product design problem, not just a model problem.

We're looking for a Software Engineer with 2-7 years of experience who thinks like a product owner, not just an implementer. You're comfortable being handed a vague, half-formed problem and figuring out what's actually worth building. You default to empathy for the researcher or participant on the other end of the screen, and you'd rather ship something real and learn from it than wait for a perfect spec. You're fluent enough with modern LLM-based systems to build good product experiences on top of them, even if tuning the model itself isn't your job.

What you'll do

  • Own end-to-end delivery of product features — from an ambiguous problem statement to shipped, working software real researchers and participants use
  • Partner directly with Product and Design to help define what should be built, not just how to build it
  • Use our design system to make sound, independent calls on smaller UX and interaction decisions, and know when a change is big enough to loop Design in
  • Build the product surfaces (web app flows, dashboards, in-product controls) that make AI-driven behavior understandable, controllable, and trustworthy for the people using it
  • Integrate LLM-based features and agent outputs into real product flows — treating them as a building block you design around, not infrastructure you need to own
  • Talk to users directly when you need to; bring what you learn back into design and prioritization decisions
  • Ship fast, instrument what you ship, and iterate based on real usage rather than a fixed spec
  • Collaborate with AI-focused engineers on deeper model or agent tuning when a feature's behavior depends on it
  • Sweat the craft: interaction design, edge cases, error states, and how the feature actually feels to use

What you bring

  • 2-7 years of software engineering experience shipping full-stack product features to real users
  • Comfortable working across the stack (frontend and backend) and picking up whatever's needed to ship
  • A track record of taking a vague, underspecified problem and shipping something real without a fully-scoped ticket
  • Genuine empathy for users: you default to understanding what someone is actually trying to do, not just what the ticket says
  • Working fluency with LLM-based systems: you've built features on top of LLM APIs or agents and understand prompting and non-determinism well enough to design good product experiences around them
  • Strong product judgment: you can reason about tradeoffs (build vs. buy, LLM vs. deterministic logic, speed vs. polish) and push back when a request doesn't serve the user
  • Comfortable using our design system to independently make good UX calls on smaller details, without needing Product or Design sign-off for every decision
  • Comfort using AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) as a real part of your workflow
  • High agency and a bias toward shipping

Nice to have

  • Experience building product features on top of conversational or voice AI
  • Familiarity with LLM observability/eval tooling, even if you're not the one owning it
  • Experience partnering closely with UX research or qualitative research teams
  • Direct experience talking to users or running lightweight user research yourself

raw.excerpt: About UsAfterShip, a Great Place to Work Certified company, is transforming the global eCommerce landscape.
raw.description:
About Us

AfterShip, a Great Place to Work Certified company, is transforming the global eCommerce landscape. Founded in 2012, AfterShip is a post-purchase SaaS company on a mission to build the world’s leading automation platform for ecommerce merchants.

AfterShip unifies shipping & labels, order tracking, AI predictive delivery, and returns management into one system—giving merchants a single place to manage and automate everything that happens after checkout. By centralizing these workflows, AfterShip enables merchants to reduce customer support inquiries, deliver a more reliable and engaging customer experiences, and unlock incremental revenue at every post-purchase touchpoint.

AfterShip integrates seamlessly with eCommerce platforms including Shopify and TikTok Shop, and connects with more than 1,400 carriers worldwide. Today, over 20,000 businesses—including Samsung, Gymshark, Mejuri, Dr. Squatch, and Alo Yoga—rely on AfterShip to turn every post-purchase moment into an opportunity to build trust, reduce costs, and drive repeat purchases.

Built for a global market from day one, AfterShip operates with an engineering-driven, internationally distributed team. The company employs more than 450 people across 8 offices, spanning North America, Europe, and Asia, and representing over 20 cities worldwide.

Your Mission

AfterShip's North American go-to-market team is in a growth phase. Our largest opportunity sits with enterprise retailers and D2C brands, where post-purchase spans multiple carriers, regions, storefronts and teams - and where unifying shipping, tracking, and returns on one platform creates the biggest impact.

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will win new logos among the largest eCommerce merchants in North America. You will build strategies for a named list of target accounts, earn access to senior executives, and lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from first meeting through signature. Deals are larger, longer and multi-product, typically running 6+ months and involving security, legal, and procurement review.

You will work alongside Marketing, Professional Services, RevOps, and Customer Success to land and set up long-term partnerships. This is a remote position, with a preference for candidates in the United States (New York, California, Utah, Texas) or Canada (Toronto). This role requires collaboration with teams located in Asia and Europe, which may require working outside of regular business hours 1-2 times per week.

What You’ll Do

  • Own new business across a named list of enterprise eCommerce retailers and D2C brands, from account research through negotiation and close
  • Build and run account plans for your target list, pairing your own executive outreach with BDR, marketing, and partner-sourced pipeline
  • Earn meetings with senior leaders across eCommerce, Customer Experience, Operations, Supply Chain, and Finance, and multi-thread to reach the economic buyer early
  • Lead consultative discovery that maps the merchant's post-purchase stack, quantifies the cost of the status quo, and builds an executive business case tied to support costs, shipping spend, return rates, and repeat purchase revenue
  • Qualify rigorously using a structured framework (such as MEDDICC) and drive deals with mutual action plans that keep champions, buyers, and timelines aligned
  • Orchestrate the deal team, partnering with Solutions Architects on technical discovery, integrations, and tailored demos, and with Product Marketing on competitive strategy
  • Navigate security reviews, legal redlines, and procurement, and negotiate multi-year, multi-product agreements
  • Work with ecosystem partners such as Shopify Plus, commerce agencies, and system integrators to source and accelerate deals
  • Own an accurate forecast in HubSpot and use Gong to review your calls and act on coaching
  • Represent AfterShip in person at executive meetings, onsites, and industry events
  • Hand off closed customers cleanly to Onboarding and Customer Success, setting them up for adoption and expansion

Who We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of full-cycle SaaS closing experience, including 3+ years selling to enterprise accounts, with a documented record of hitting or exceeding quota
  • A history of closing six-figure, multi-stakeholder deals with sales cycles of six months or longer
  • Experience selling to VP and C-level leaders, and building business cases that win approval from Finance and procurement
  • A structured, repeatable sales process you can walk us through, including how you qualify, multi-thread, and build mutual action plans
  • Confidence navigating security questionnaires, legal redlines, and complex procurement processes
  • Hunter mindset: you have opened doors at target accounts with no existing relationship, and you don't wait for inbound to fill your pipeline
  • eCommerce, retail tech, or logistics experience strongly preferred, along with a working understanding of the Shopify Plus ecosystem and enterprise commerce platforms
  • Proficiency with HubSpot or a comparable CRM, plus Gong, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and modern sales engagement tooling
  • High coachability and ownership: you seek feedback, review your own calls, and set your own rhythm without being told
  • Ability to travel up to 20%

Bonus points:

  • You've sold post-purchase, shipping, returns, CX, or supply chain software to enterprise retailers
  • You've built relationships with Shopify Plus partners, commerce agencies, or system integrators
  • You've sold a platform or multi-product suite, not only a single point solution
  • You've worked at a company scaling into the enterprise segment and helped shape the playbook

At AfterShip, we know great talent doesn’t always fit every requirement. If you’re passionate about our mission and believe you can make an impact, we encourage you to apply.

Why You Should Join Us

  • Great Place to Work Certified: We’ve been recognized for our inclusive, values-driven culture that celebrates diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovative & Inclusive Culture: Started by our software engineer-turned-CEO, AfterShip is built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. We’re a passionate, global team of problem solvers who put egos aside to innovate together. We take immense pride in fostering a culture that’s inclusive, which has allowed us to surround ourselves with the industry's most talented professionals.
  • Ambitious Mission with Real Impact: Join us in transforming eCommerce by making buying and selling easier for everyone. It’s one of the most dynamic spaces in tech, with limitless opportunities to innovate and grow.
  • Thrive & Grow: There’s no ceiling to what you can achieve or learn here. We’re committed to empowering your career while advancing together as a company.
  • Flexible Work Setup: We’re a remote-first team, meaning by default that employees work from home or on a hybrid-flexible basis in our hub locations. You’re empowered to choose a work setup that works best for you and your team. With flexible hours depending on your time zone, you’ll be able to have a schedule that fits your working style and the requirements of your role.

Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Remote-first/hybrid-flexible work setups
  • Healthcare coverage offered from day 1
  • Retirement plans including company match
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Annual learning & wellness benefit
  • Monthly book perk
  • Career progression & professional development
  • In-office lunch and commuter benefits for those located in our hub locations

On-target-earnings (OTE) range for this role: $190,000 - 290,000

We are an equal opportunity employer and provide accommodations upon request throughout the recruitment process, in accordance with local legislation. Please let us know if you require any support, and we’ll work with you to meet your needs.

We believe in hiring right over hiring fast. While timelines may vary, we’re looking to fill this role as soon as possible.

Our hiring process uses AI to help with initial resume screening and to support interview note-taking. These tools help our team stay organized and fair, but all hiring decisions are made by people.

raw.excerpt: OverviewEvery proposal, anniversary, and milestone that happens in a Shane Co.
raw.description:
Overview

Every proposal, anniversary, and milestone that happens in a Shane Co. store happens in front of someone we hired. Finding those people, before we need them, is this job.

Shane Co. is building a new regional Talent Acquisition model for our stores, and we’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Partner to own it on the ground across our East region. You’ll be the hiring partner to our Store Managers, the person who knows the best talent in your markets by name, and the face of a family-owned jeweler in the communities where our customers live.

We ask our jewelry consultants to be a friend first. We ask the same of the people who hire them. This is a relationship role, not a requisition-processing role.

Why This Role:

  • Build, don’t just maintain. You’ll help shape a newly structured regional recruiting model. Your ideas on sourcing, process, and candidate experience will be put to work.
  • A real seat at the table. You’re the Store Manager’s hiring partner, with direct access to field and senior leadership.
  • Out from behind the screen. Remote-based, with regular time in our stores, at events, and in the community, not forty hours a week inside an applicant tracking system.
  • A legacy you help build, not just join. A family-owned company since 1929 that invests in the people who build it.

Responsibilities

Build the Bench Before the Need

  • Build and maintain talent pipelines for critical and recurring store roles across your region, including jewelry consultants, sales leadership, customer service, and operations.
  • Engage strong candidates before a requisition opens and keep those relationships warm over months, not weeks.
  • Get to know passive talent: their motivations, their strengths, and where they want their careers to go.
  • Represent Shane Co. at job fairs, industry and community events, and university partnerships, and create local recruiting activations of your own.
  • Grow Shane Co.’s employer brand on LinkedIn, Glassdoor, and other professional platforms.
  • Spend meaningful time in our stores to learn the business, the teams, and what great looks like in each market.

Partner Like a Trusted Advisor

  • Lead structured intake conversations with Store Managers, field leaders, HR partners, and senior leadership.
  • Get to the business need behind every search and align early on qualifications, process, timing, and hiring strategy.
  • Turn market-specific staffing needs into proactive sourcing and recruiting plans.
  • Bring market intelligence, including talent availability, competitor activity, and compensation trends, to inform hiring strategy and workforce planning.
  • Give a clear point of view on candidates and market conditions, and offer practical alternatives when a request won’t lead to a strong hire.

Own the Full Cycle and the Candidate Experience

  • Own full-cycle recruiting in your markets: sourcing, engagement, assessment, interview coordination, selection, offer management, and follow-through to Day 1.
  • Treat every candidate the way we treat every customer: timely, honest, and personal at every step, whether or not they get the job.
  • Present Shane Co.’s culture, career paths, and expectations with clarity and honesty.
  • Lead and support hiring events and store-level recruiting initiatives.
  • Balance priorities across multiple markets without dropping follow-through.

Make the Function Better

  • Keep candidate, pipeline, requisition, and activity data accurate in our applicant tracking system and other systems of record.
  • Use recruiting data to drive pipeline visibility, reporting, and better hiring decisions across your region.
  • Recommend practical improvements that make recruiting more efficient without losing the relationship-first approach.
  • Facilitate hiring-related training for store leaders as assigned.
  • Share what’s working, including sourcing practices, market observations, and recruiting insights, with field and HR leadership

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of recruiting or talent acquisition experience with a proven track record of proactive relationship-building, not just requisition management.
  • Experience representing an employer brand externally through job fairs, industry associations, community organizations, or campus partnerships.
  • Specific examples of building and sustaining a talent pipeline ahead of open need.
  • Experience advising hiring managers and senior leaders with market data and a point of view, including the confidence to push back when a request works against a strong outcome.
  • The warmth, presence, and polish to represent a fine jeweler in high-visibility settings.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and competing priorities, paired with consistent follow-through.
  • Working knowledge of an applicant tracking system and the ability to learn new tools quickly.
  • Retail or multi-site hiring experience is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent experience welcome. In-house, agency, and field recruiting backgrounds are all considered.

Behavioral Characteristics

This work asks something of you. It asks you to pick up the phone before anyone tells you to. To walk into a room full of strangers and leave with names. To care about a candidate you may not be able to hire for six months, and to still be the first call they take when the right role opens. It asks you to tell a Store Manager what they need to hear, not just what they want to hear, and to do it in a way that makes them trust you more.

You’re organized enough to keep a dozen live searches moving and generous enough to keep investing in people who aren’t on a requisition yet. If you’ve ever stayed close to a great candidate for a year until the timing was right, and felt it was worth it, you already understand this role.

Work Environment

This is a remote role based from your home, with a regular, visible presence in our stores and local communities. Travel to stores, our Home Office in Englewood, CO, conferences, and events is up to 15%. You must live in Nashville / Franklin Tennessee area,and within 50 miles of a Shane Co. store.

Why Work for Shane Co.?

For nearly a century, Shane Co. has built more than beautiful jewelry. We’ve built lasting relationships, meaningful careers, and a culture where people truly matter. As a family-owned company, we believe in investing in our people, celebrating craftsmanship, and creating opportunities to grow. Our iconic promise to be Your Friend and Your Jeweler isn’t just how we serve our customers. It’s how we show up for one another every day.

What we offer:

  • $95,000 – $120,000 base salary, plus eligibility for an annual bonus based on company performance. Final pay is based on experience, skills, and location.
  • Health & wellness. Health benefits for you and your family, plus mental health and financial well-being resources.
  • Paid time off. Up to three weeks of paid vacation, paid holidays, and paid sick time, plus a paid volunteer day each year.
  • A 401(k) plan to help you invest in your financial future.
  • Employee discount. A generous discount for you and your immediate family.
  • Growth & development. On-the-job training, online courses, and management and leadership training

raw.description:
Build our future together:

The Access Services Lead for Immunology is a critical function that is responsible for the overall development and execution of the Immunology access services strategy. Once a physician writes a prescription for one of our medications, this individual will lead the team that ensures a positive journey for that patient and provider with accessing our medication. To that end this individual will hire/lead both the Immunology Patient Services Support team (PSS) and the corresponding Field Reimbursement team (FRM). This is a newly created role that harmonizes these two critical functions at the brand level and is 100% focused on ensuring every appropriate patient STARTS and STAYS on their therapy.


The Access Services Lead will be the voice for patient access across all key brand partners. This individual must maintain a high-level of communication, collaboration and integration with all cross-functional Regeneron and Alliance staff (if applicable), including CLT, Field Teams, Brand Marketing, Training, I&A, Market Access Strategy, Trade, and Market Research.


When & where:


  • Remote - US with occasional travel to the office in Sleepy Hollow, NY

Discover your role:


  • In conjunction with marketing and market access strategy leadership, define and implement the strategic commercial plan to execute appropriate field activities that significantly improve access & reimbursement for therapeutic area
  • Drive the development, coordination and implementation of all initiatives relative to patient and physician reimbursement and patient support programs that align to Brand-related strategic objectives. This includes initiatives related to streamlining and automating the patient onboarding and adherence journey
  • Develop and manage the brand specific access services budget. Collaborate with Operational Excellence team to identify opportunities to leverage technology and efficiencies to establish cutting edge best in class service within a cost-effective environment
  • Drive patient services and patient assistance benchmarking, cost analyses and forecasting (both direct and administrative) to inform Brand and Sr. Management decision-making
  • Hire, train and lead a first-class field reimbursement team that has deep access knowledge and experience with removing access barriers for patients
  • Ensure that the Field Reimbursement team and leadership are viewed by their customers as subject matter experts in Access & Reimbursement
  • Hire, train and lead a first-class patient support services (PSS) team, that has deep operational and patient support experience
  • Responsible for gathering insights related to onboarding, conversion, patient retention, copay, quality, and customer satisfaction. Also responsible for communicating those insights strategically to the Brand and senior leadership, this includes executive engagement.
  • Coordinate the development of program systems (IT and communications) planning and implementation across PSS vendors
  • Plan, develop and execute program communications (i.e., content and processes) of the PSS, reimbursement support and patient access programs
  • Collaborate with Brand & Access Marketing, Training, Legal, Regulatory, Analytics, Privacy, Trade, Sales, and payer teams to ensure optimal execution of patient access and reimbursement strategy
  • Leadership point of contact and active participant on Brand Core Teams for both REGN and Alliance (when applicable) to bring forward key field and customer insights with access & reimbursement
  • Establish measurable performance metrics and monitor achievement of these agreed parameters. Partner with HQ in developing Incentive Compensation schemes for the Field Access Specialist team that ladder up to the Market Access Business Unit strategic objectives
  • Monitor Field Force sizing, and anticipate market events that may require adjustments to deployment

This role requires:


  • BS/BA required; advanced degree a plus.
  • Experienced Business/Sales/Reimbursement leader with 15+ years overall pharma/biopharma experience. A minimum of 7 years leadership that includes the managing of managers
  • A track record of accomplishment and experience in building customer facing field teams and launching new products
  • Strong understanding of Payer environment, reimbursement and challenges within National payer markets including: government programs, managed health care and evolving health care systems
  • Experience in commercializing a biologic product
  • Strong collaboration skills and experience working in a partnership environment
  • Excellent leadership and interpersonal skills; should be an effective teammate who can engender credibility and confidence within the company, with customers, and with strategic alliance partner(if applicable). Able to articulate the Strategic Imperatives and translate / implement to the Field Access Team. Comfortable working in a science/patient focused culture and working with scientific leaders.

Does this sound like you? Apply now to take your first step towards living the Regeneron Way! We are committed to building a workplace with an inclusive culture. Regeneron is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief (or lack thereof), sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, civil status, pregnancy or parental status, age, disability, nationality, citizenship status, ethnic or national origin, membership of the Traveler community, familial status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. Where required, we will provide reasonable accommodation to applicants with known disabilities or chronic illnesses during the recruitment process, unless such accommodation would impose undue hardship.

Where necessary, we disclose salary ranges for roles in all countries in which we operate. The final offer will be determined within the relevant range based on the country of employment, specific role level, and your skills and experience. Regeneron offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package which may include, depending on country and role: annual bonuses or other incentive plans, equity awards, pension or retirement benefits, 401(k) company match, health and wellness programs, fitness centers, insurance benefits (e.g. medical, dental, vision, life and disability), paid time off, and family support benefits. For additional information about Regeneron benefits in the U.S., please visit . For other locations, additional information will be provided during the recruitment process. If you have any questions, please speak with your recruiter.


Please be advised that at Regeneron, we believe we do our best work when we are together. For that reason, many roles are required to be performed on‑site. Please speak with your recruiter and hiring manager for more information about on‑site expectations for your role and location.


As part of the recruitment process, certain background checks may be conducted in accordance with the laws of the country where the position is based. ADHDAdvisor.org is on a mission to remove the conventional barriers to ADHD diagnosis and treatment and make mental health care more accessible to everyone, no matter where they live. What are we looking for?

raw.title: Licensed Inbound Insurance Sales Specialist
raw.excerpt: Trupanion is looking for a self-motivated, customer-focused Licensed Insurance Sales Specialist to join our pet-loving team!
raw.description:
Trupanion is looking for a self-motivated, customer-focused Licensed Insurance Sales Specialist to join our pet-loving team! If you hold an active provincial General Insurance license (or equivalent) and enjoy helping customers find the right coverage for their pets, this may be the opportunity for you.

Your role is the heart and soul of Trupanion, and you love helping as many people and pets as possible. You provide support to customers who contact us about starting their pet’s medical insurance over the phone and through email and be there to assist current members. A successful candidate is a great listener and an out of the box problem solver who communicates effectively verbally and in writing. You’re comfortable navigating escalated customers and sensitive conversations with a focus on providing the best experience. You are empathetic and emotionally resilient.

Schedule (Pacific Time Hours):

This is a full-time position working 8-hour shifts, 5 days per week. Schedules rotate every two weeks and require flexibility across a range of shift times. Shifts may be scheduled as early as 3:00 AM Pacific Time, with start times as late as 1:30 PM Pacific Time. Both Saturday and Sunday are required, and one consistent day off will be guaranteed.

During your first eight weeks of training, your schedule will be Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time.

Please Note: We are unable to consider applications submitted without weekend availability.

At Trupanion, we believe in a flexible workplace! Candidates for this position have the option to work remotely from anywhere in Canada as long as they are licensed to sell insurance in Canada and the province in which they currently reside.

Responsibilities:

  • Answering inbound warm leads from potential customers who have expressed interest in our pet insurance policies.
  • Utilizing a consultative style to understand the unique needs of each customer and tailoring insurance solutions accordingly.
  • Presenting the value of our pet insurance policies and emphasizing the benefits they offer, rather than focusing solely on the price.
  • Effectively setting the agenda during calls to maintain call control and guide the conversation towards successful enrollment.
  • Providing detailed information about our policies, coverage options, and answering any questions or objections customers may have.
  • Overcoming objections and concerns with confidence and empathy to instill trust in potential customers.
  • Utilizing assumptive closing techniques to confidently guide customers through the enrollment process.
  • Accurately enrolling pets in policies, ensuring all necessary information is collected and documented.
  • Collaborating with the sales team and management to meet and exceed sales targets and objectives.

Qualifications:

  • Active provincial General/P&C Insurance license, such as an OTL General Insurance Agent license, General Level 1 license, or equivalent, depending on your province of residence.
  • Eligible for license reciprocity in additional jurisdictions, excluding Québec.
  • Minimum of 2 years' experience in a sales role.
  • Excellent communication skills with a customer-centric approach.
  • Ability to actively listen, understand customer needs, and provide appropriate solutions.
  • Familiarity with the insurance industry, particularly pet insurance, is a plus.
  • Strong ability to handle objections and turn them into opportunities.
  • Goal-oriented mindset with a proven track record of achieving, surpassing sales targets and productivity expectations.
  • Positive attitude, adaptability, and a willingness to learn and grow within the role.
  • Proficiency in basic computer applications and data entry.

Skills:

  • Customer-Centric: passionate about providing a positive customer experience
  • Critical thinking/ think creatively: the ability to assess, analyze, and tackle problems while handling complex situations.
  • Patience/active listener: listens to truly hear their customer and their problems, and able to explain solutions in different ways until the customer understands.
  • Emotional intelligence: ability to control outward emotions while handling interpersonal relationships with empathy.
  • Emotional resilience: be aware of one’s own emotional reactions and adapt to stressful situations or crises without lasting difficulties post-interaction.

Compensation:

  • The base pay for this position is $25.50 CAD an hour on a full-time schedule. Along with the hourly pay, Trupanion employees may be eligible for uncapped monthly bonuses based on individual performance
  • We want all employees to be invested in Trupanion’s success, so we grant Restricted Stock Units to all new team members. Our new hire grants vest over 4 years.

Benefits and Perks:

  • Employer-paid extended health coverage for you and your family
  • Trupanion will partner with Wealthsimple to register your RRSP, pension, etc.
  • Four weeks of paid time off and 11 paid float holidays (you can decide which days are most important to you!)
  • Five weeks, paid, sabbatical after five years of employment
  • Employer-paid medical insurance for one pet (cat or dog)
  • Paid time off to volunteer at nonprofit organizations
  • Open, casual, pet-friendly, and fun work environment

For more information about Trupanion, visit

Learn more about how Trupanion has revolutionized our industry and the reimbursement model:

Trupanion is an equal opportunity employer and embraces diversity. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, abilities, perspectives, and skills.

We will ensure that individuals are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Trupanion is a leading provider of medical insurance for cats and dogs in North America. Our mission is to help loving, responsible pet owners' budget and care for their pets. At Trupanion, we offer a collaborative, casual, and pet-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to be themselves.

Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.

Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.


The Wealth Solutions – Investment Advisor supports Empower's Wealth Solutions organization by guiding clients through the initial steps of achieving their financial goals. This advisory role is designed for licensed investment professionals who are building a career in wealth management. Through direct client engagement, mentorship, and hands-on experience with Empower's holistic financial planning process, Investment Advisors develop the knowledge and skills needed to progress into Senior Financial Advisor roles. Working primarily with clients who have less than $100,000 in total assets, Investment Advisors introduce clients to Empower's advisory experience, assist with consolidating outside assets, and establish the foundation for long-term financial relationships.

What You Will Do

What Will Set You Apart

$50,300.00 - $69,125.00

Sales positions are eligible for sales incentives, and in some instances a bonus plan, whereby total compensation may far exceed base salary depending on individual performance. raw.title: Cyber Security Lead
raw.excerpt: At GenesisCare, we're looking for a Cyber Security Lead to join our Information Technology team and play a key role in protecting our systems, services and information across the UK.
raw.description:
At GenesisCare, we're looking for a Cyber Security Lead to join our Information Technology team and play a key role in protecting our systems, services and information across the UK.

Reporting to the Head of Information Security (CISO), you'll take responsibility for the day-to-day coordination and delivery of our cyber security operations, working closely with internal technology teams and external security partners.

This is a hands-on role where you'll lead security monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management and the continuous improvement of our technical security controls. You'll also support the delivery of a secure, resilient and compliant technology environment as our organisation continues to evolve.

What you'll do:
• Lead and coordinate day-to-day cyber security operations across GenesisCare UK.
• Oversee security monitoring, threat detection and managed Security Operations Centre (SOC) services.
• Coordinate cyber security incident investigations, response and remediation activities.
• Manage vulnerability assessments, prioritise security risks and drive remediation.
• Implement, monitor and continually improve technical security controls across our technology environment.
• Support Cyber Essentials Plus certification and the ongoing development of our Information Security Management System (ISMS).
• Provide practical cyber security advice across infrastructure, applications and digital transformation projects, promoting secure-by-design principles.
• Produce security metrics, dashboards and reports to support management and governance.
• Coordinate phishing simulations, cyber awareness activities and security communications.
• Support cyber resilience, disaster recovery testing and recovery assurance activities.
• Work closely with internal stakeholders and third-party security providers to strengthen our overall security posture.

What you'll bring:
• Proven experience in cyber security, security operations or a technical infrastructure role with significant security responsibilities.
• Experience managing security monitoring, incident response and vulnerability management activities.
• Experience working with managed SOC providers and Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) solutions.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 security, including Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA and Privileged Identity Management (PIM).
• Practical experience with Microsoft Defender XDR and Purview, including threat detection, data loss prevention and Secure Score improvement.
• Experience using Heimdal Security solutions for patch management, threat prevention, antivirus and endpoint protection.
• Experience leading or supporting an ISO 27001-aligned ISMS, including risk assessments, policies, audits and Cyber Essentials Plus certification.
• Good understanding of endpoint, identity, cloud, email and network security technologies.
• The ability to assess technical security risks and coordinate effective remediation.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical colleagues.
• A proactive, collaborative approach and the ability to manage competing priorities.
It would also be advantageous if you have:
• Experience working within healthcare or another regulated industry.
• Knowledge of ISO 27001, Cyber Essentials Plus and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework.
• Experience with Microsoft Azure security technologies.
• Experience supporting penetration testing, external audits and security certification programmes.
• A relevant degree, professional cyber security certification or equivalent practical experience.

This is a national, homebased role with occasional travel to GenesisCare centres and supplier locations across the UK. You'll need a full, valid UK driving licence and access to your own vehicle, insured for business use.
Some flexibility outside normal working hours may occasionally be required to support cyber security incident response activities.

Why Choose GenesisCare?
At GenesisCare, we believe that everyone deserves access to the best possible cancer care, and that starts with looking after our people.
We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including:
• 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays.
• Private medical and dental insurance.
• Contributory pension scheme.
• Income protection.
• Employee Assistance Programme.
• Access to radiotherapy treatment for eligible family members.
• Health and wellbeing support.
• A range of retail and lifestyle discounts.
• Opportunities for professional development and career progression.

Who We Are
GenesisCare is a leading independent provider of cancer care in the UK, delivering personalised, high-quality treatment through our network of specialist centres.

We bring together world-class expertise, advanced technology and a patient-centred approach to provide innovative cancer treatments and services, including radiotherapy, medical oncology, advanced diagnostics and Theranostics.

Our teams are passionate about making a difference, working together to deliver the best possible outcomes and experiences for our patients.

Join GenesisCare UK and shape your future, while helping shape the future of cancer care.
