UPSTARS – продуктова IT-компанія, з якою злітають і люди, і бренди. Наш основний фокус – технологічні рішення та B2B-послуги для міжнародних клієнтів. Запускаємо зіркові проєкти у сфері iGaming, які отримують визнання та найвищі оцінки профільних рейтингів ✨

І так, підтримувати легальний та прозорий ринок України – це маст хев, тому третіми в країні отримали B2B-ліцензію на надання послуг у сфері азартних ігор.

У 2026 ми активно масштабуємо і проєкти, і дрім тім. Тому для підсилення GameDev департаменту шукаємо SRE Engineer.

✅ Твої майбутні задачі:

  • побудова та розвиток практик DevOps та SRE у команді;

  • участь у формуванні технічної стратегії команди та розвитку інженерної культури;

  • розвиток, підтримка та вдосконалення ігрової платформи;

  • розвиток, масштабування та супровід систем моніторингу й спостережуваності;

  • участь в оплачуваних чергуваннях OnCall, покращення процесів управління інцидентами;

  • автоматизація інфраструктурних і рутинних процесів;

  • комунікація з командами розробки щодо надійності, масштабованості, покращення процесів доставки змін та CI/CD;

  • менторинг інженерів, обмін підходами Kubernetes-native;

  • участь у прийнятті архітектурних рішень та розвитку хмарної інфраструктури.

💪 Твої скіли:

  • 3+ роки досвіду на позиціях DevOps / SRE;

  • глибока експертиза в Kubernetes та оркестрації контейнерів;

  • впевнений досвід роботи з Terraform та інфраструктурою як кодом (Infrastructure as Code);

  • досвід побудови та підтримки інфраструктури з високою доступністю (high availability);

  • досвід роботи з базами даних: SQL (PostgreSQL) та NoSQL;

  • досвід роботи зі стеком спостережуваності: Prometheus, Grafana, експортери, система алертингу;

  • впевнене написання автоматизації та скриптів на Python та Bash;

  • розуміння принципів безперервної інтеграції та доставки (CI/CD), GitOps та платформної інженерії;

  • системне мислення та вміння не лише усувати проблеми, а й знаходити їх першопричину (root cause);

  • проактивність у покращенні процесів, автоматизації та інженерії надійності (reliability engineering);

  • сильні комунікаційні навички та досвід взаємодії з інженерними командами.

🤞 Бажано, але не критично:

  • досвід роботи з хмарною платформою Oracle Cloud;

  • сертифікація Certified Kubernetes Administrator;

  • досвід роботи з хмарними платформами: AWS, GCP;

  • уміння читати код на JS/TS та Ruby.

🌟 Наші цінності та переваги:

  • командність – гуртом не лише працюємо, а ще й відпочиваємо, двіжуємо і робимо добрі справи;

  • відкритість – говоримо прямо і просто навіть про складне, чуємо ідеї та фідбеки і цінуємо проактивність;

  • автоматизуємо рутину, щоб використовувати час для розвитку та професійного зростання всередині компанії;

  • не любимо бюрократію та застарілі підходи – ми за свободу дій.

  • 20 робочих днів оплачуваних дей офів, державні вихідні і лікарняні – ми за ворк-лайф беленс;

  • медичне страхування у топових клініках і покриття витрат на психолога на платформі Pleso;

  • навчання під будь-який запит – індивідуальний бюджет на курси, корпоративна англійська, воркшопи та онлайн-бібліотека.

І ще про важливе:

❗️Не маємо клієнтів, які б використовували наші розробки та послуги на українському ринку.

❗️Не працюємо з клієнтами ринку країни-агресора чи будь-якого іншого російськомовного ринку.

Відчуваєш метч за цінностями і бажання професійно зростати? Давай знайомитися! 😉

Job Description

Join Us as Senior Clinical Research Associate I – Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation. We have successfully supported the top 50 pharmaceutical companies and more than 750 biotechs, spanning 2,700 clinical trials across 100+ countries in the last 5 years.

DESCRIPTION

As a Senior Clinical Research Associate I in our FSP model, you will be dedicated to one specific client, acting as a representative of the client while exercising strong communication and collaboration skills. You will perform and coordinate all aspects of the clinical monitoring and site management process. You will conduct remote or on-site visits to assess protocol and regulatory compliance and manage required documentation. You will act as a site processes specialist, ensuring that the trial is conducted in accordance with the approved protocol, ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations and SOPs to guarantee subjects rights, well-being and data reliability. You will ensure audit readiness and develop collaborative relationships with investigational sites.

What You'll Do:

  • Monitors investigator sites with a risk-based monitoring approach.
  • Applies root cause analysis (RCA), critical thinking and problem-solving skills to identify site processes failure and corrective/preventive actions to bring the site into compliance and decrease risks.
  • Ensures data accuracy through SDR, SDV and CRF review as applicable through on-site and remote monitoring activities.
  • Assess investigational product through physical inventory and records review.
  • Documents observations in reports and letters in a timely manner using approved business writing standards.
  • Escalates observed deficiencies and issues to clinical management expeditiously and follow all issues through to resolution.
  • Maintains regular contact between monitoring visits with investigative sites to confirm that the protocol is being followed, that previously identified issues are being resolved and that the data is being recorded in a timely manner.
  • Conducts monitoring tasks in accordance with the approved monitoring plan.
  • Participates in the investigator payment process.
  • Ensures a shared responsibility with other project team members on issues/findings resolution.
  • Investigates and follows-up on findings as applicable.
  • Provides trial status tracking and progress update reports to the Clinical Team Manager (CTM) as required.
  • Ensures study systems are updated per agreed study conventions (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System, CTMS).
  • Performs QC check of reports generated from CTMS system where required.
  • Participates in investigator meetings as necessary.
  • Identifies potential investigators in collaboration with the client company to ensure the acceptability of qualified investigative sites.
  • Initiates clinical trial sites according to the relevant procedures to ensure compliance with the protocol and regulatory and ICH GCP obligations, making recommendations where warranted.
  • Ensures trial close out and retrieval of trial materials.
  • Ensures that required essential documents are complete and in place, according to ICH-GCP and applicable regulations.
  • Conducts on-site file reviews as per project specifications.
  • Contributes to the project team by assisting in preparation of project publications/tools, and sharing ideas/suggestions with team members.
  • Performs additional study tasks as assigned by CTM (e.g. trip report review, newsletter creation, lead CRA team calls etc).
  • Facilitates effective communication between investigative sites, the client company and the project team through written, oral and/or electronic contacts.
  • Responds to company, client and applicable regulatory requirements/audits/inspections.
  • Maintains & completes administrative tasks such as expense reports and timesheets in a timely manner.
  • Contributes to other project work and initiatives for process improvement, as required.

REQUIREMENTS

Education and Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in a life sciences related field or a Registered Nursing certification or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification.
  • Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 3+ years).
  • Oncology experience preferred.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • A seasoned, experienced professional, with a full understanding of area of specialization; resolves a wide range of issues in creative ways.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent clinical trials monitoring skills; remote and on-site.
  • Demonstrated understanding of ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations and SOPs.
  • Works on problems of diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors.
  • Demonstrates good judgement in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with ability to interact effectively with investigative sites, clients, and internal teams.
  • Ability to act as a representative of the client while maintaining professional relationships.
  • Advanced written and oral communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Demonstrated use of computer systems including CTMS and other trial management platforms.
  • Ability to travel >75% as required for site monitoring activities.

Why Join Us?

When you join Thermo Fisher Scientific, you become part of a global team that values passion, innovation, and a commitment to scientific excellence. You'll work in an environment where collaboration and development are part of the everyday experience—and where your contributions truly make a difference.

Apply today to help us deliver tomorrow's breakthroughs.

Compensation and Benefits

The salary range estimated for this position based in California is $90,000.00–$113,000.00.

This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:

  • A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs

  • Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement

  • At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short- and long-term disability in accordance with company policy

  • Retirement and savings programs, such as our competitive 401(k) U.S. retirement savings plan

  • Employees’ Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offers eligible colleagues the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount

For more information on our benefits, please visit:

raw.description:
On behalf of Goldwind Denmark, Nordic Talent Collab is looking for a Senior Offshore Supporting Structure Engineer.

Are you ready for an exciting journey of development? Then you might be our new Senior Offshore Supporting Structure Engineer!

Goldwind Denmark is a subsidiary of Goldwind Science & Technology Co., Ltd (Goldwind), a world leading wind turbine technology and energy solutions provider headquartered in Beijing, China. Goldwind Denmark was established in the beginning of 2016 as a dedicated R&D office and with a steady development of the product portfolio, we are dedicated to furthering the most advanced and cost-efficient wind power technology in a high quality, continually raising the bar through a steadfast commitment to innovation.

As a Senior Engineer for Offshore Wind Support Structures, you will be the technical authority on the design and integrity of turbine towers and foundations (fixed-bottom and floating). You will lead complex engineering packages, make critical decisions that impact project safety and cost, and mentor the next generation of engineers. This role requires a blend of deep technical expertise, proven project leadership, and exceptional client-facing skills.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Product Ownership

  • Act as technical lead / design authority for offshore wind turbine towers and interfaces with foundations, including fixed-bottom and floating structures
  • Tailor and optimise project-specific variants, from concept and FEED through detailed design, serial production, and installation support.
  • Own technical integrity and design approval of critical calculations, specifications, drawings, and product documentation.
  • Define, maintain, and govern product design philosophies, analysis methodologies, and global models in line with international codes and standards (e.g., DNV, IEC, ISO, API, Eurocodes) and internal standards.
  • Lead resolution of complex, non-standard technical challenges, including extreme and fatigue load cases, soil–structure interaction, and coupled dynamic behaviour.
  • Drive continuous design optimization and standardization to improve manufacturability, scalability, and cost competitiveness (LCoE).

Project Execution & External Interfaces

  • Serve as the primary technical interface with customers (developers), certification bodies, and internal manufacturing, procurement, and installation teams.
  • Support commercial and technical negotiations, ensuring product offerings meet customer requirements while protecting technical and commercial margins.
  • Identify and manage technical risks across product development and project execution, ensuring robust mitigation strategies are embedded in design.
  • Support bid and tender activities through preparation, review, and approval of technical proposals and deviations.

Manufacturing, Supply Chain & Installation Integration

  • Ensure designs are optimized for serial fabrication, transport, and installation, with clear consideration of supply chain capabilities and constraints.
  • Work closely with manufacturing, quality, and procurement teams to resolve fabrication issues and manage non-conformances.
  • Provide technical support during installation and commissioning phases, including resolution of site-related design issues.

Innovation & Product Strategy

  • Lead R&D and product development initiatives, including next-generation fixed-bottom and floating foundation solutions.
  • Contribute to product roadmaps, modularization strategies, and platform-based design approaches.
  • Represent the OEM in industry working groups, standardization committees, and key technical forums.

Qualifications & Experience

Essential

  • Masters degree or PhD in Civil, Structural, Mechanical, or Offshore Engineering.
  • 8+ years experience in offshore wind support structure design within an OEM, contractor, or closely related environment.
  • Strong working knowledge of DNV and IEC standards, with hands-on experience applying them to serial product design.
  • Expert-level proficiency in global analysis and FEA tools for integrated, coupled analyses.
  • Demonstrated experience leading engineering teams in a product- or program-based environment.
  • Excellent communication skills across engineering, manufacturing, and commercial stakeholders.

Desirable

  • Experience with both fixed-bottom (monopile, jacket) and floating offshore wind foundation products.
  • Proven track record in design for manufacture, assembly, transport, and installation (DfMA/T&I).
  • Programming skills (Python, MATLAB) for automation, parametric design, and product scalability.
  • Experience supporting multiple projects using standardized product platforms.
  • Exposure to full product lifecycle management, including in-service support and design updates.

Information

We prefer that you can be part of the headquarters in Aarhus, but this is not a requirement. It is expected that there will be approximately 10-15 days of travel per year.

Goldwind Denmark is currently a smaller unit with an entrepreneurial and embracing culture. We value and recognize every team member's contribution, creating a collaborative and supportive work environment that promotes innovation and creativity. Our passionate and dedicated team is here to make a positive difference in our industry and society every day. Come join us and be part of creating our collective sustainable future.

Apply

If you are interested and feel you are the right person for the job, do not hesitate to send a short application along with your resume.

EMCD is a leading technology company in the crypto industry, best known as the largest mining pool in Eastern Europe. We are building a multi-product ecosystem across mining, wallets, earn products, B2B infrastructure and other digital-asset services, operating through multiple legal entities and jurisdictions with products at different stages of maturity and regulation.

We are looking for a Head of Compliance to lead the compliance function across EMCD's international crypto ecosystem. The role combines regulatory strategy, operational compliance and business partnership. You will support multiple products and legal entities across different jurisdictions, helping the business scale while keeping regulatory and financial-crime risk clear and manageable.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the group-level compliance framework across EMCD products and legal entities.
  • Lead AML/CTF, sanctions, KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, Travel Rule, and customer/counterparty risk controls.
  • Define regulatory and licensing strategy across existing and new markets.
  • Support new product launches and market entry by identifying regulatory risks and designing workable compliance structures.
  • Lead interactions with regulators, banks, payment providers, external counsel and other financial partners.
  • Oversee regulatory audits, inspections, reporting, remediation and ongoing compliance obligations.
  • Assess complex or high-risk cases and provide clear, risk-based recommendations to the business.
  • Build scalable compliance processes that support growth without unnecessary operational friction.
  • Lead and develop the existing compliance team and own the function's overall results.
  • Work closely with the CEO, Legal, Product, Finance and business leaders.

Requirements:

  • Senior compliance leadership experience in crypto, fintech, payments, banking or another regulated financial environment.
  • Strong practical knowledge of AML/CTF, sanctions, KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring and financial-crime risk.
  • Hands-on experience with regulatory licensing and working directly with regulators across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Experience assessing new products, markets and business models from a regulatory and compliance perspective.
  • Strong understanding of crypto-specific risks, including wallets, custody, transaction flows, Travel Rule and high-risk jurisdictions.
  • Experience working with banks, payment providers and other regulated counterparties.
  • Proven ability to balance business enablement with risk management, proposing alternatives rather than only identifying restrictions.
  • Strong ownership and decision-making skills.
  • Experience leading and developing a compliance team.

Big plus:

  • ﻿Hands-on experience obtaining a VASP license/registration in Argentina (PSAV registration with the CNV).

Key Challenge:

Help EMCD grow across products and jurisdictions without either blocking the business unnecessarily or allowing unmanaged risk. The successful candidate is commercially minded, pragmatic and creative, while holding clear red lines and strong compliance standards.

What We Offer:

  • A senior leadership role with direct impact on how EMCD scales across products and jurisdictions.
  • High ownership and autonomy in shaping the compliance function, frameworks, priorities and ways of working.
  • Close collaboration with the CEO and senior leaders across Legal, Product, Finance and business teams.
  • Remote-first company — work from anywhere in the world.
  • Extended time off: 20 paid vacation days + 12 additional paid days off per year.
  • 100% paid sick leave.

Apply today and help us build the future of crypto!

About The Position

This role is responsible for creating, managing, and optimizing the data and BI platforms, and for partnering closely with stakeholders to drive requirements gathering, defining data solution architecture, and building and delivering data pipeline solutions (including, but not limited to, ETL/Extract-Transform-Load, pipelines, data models, and monitoring controls). This is a hands-on role that creates, drives and tracks project plans for Business Intelligence (BI) platform and Data Engineering solutions delivery, and leads sprint planning and completion for assigned pipelines to meet business needs while implementing solutions with continuous improvement. This role reports to the Senior Director of Data Management and Governance.

Responsibilities

  • Own and drive the end-to-end delivery of data architecture and pipeline solutions, including holistic planning, requirements-gathering, design, build, and testing strategy per assessed business needs. Design and evolve the semantic layer to be the well-governed single source of truth for business intelligence and ensure it is meeting all reporting needs.

  • Design and operationalize data quality framework to ensure trust and consistency in data, with proactive monitoring, alerting, root cause analysis (including troubleshooting and resolution) with impact and sizing assessments for all critical data pipelines.

  • Manage and continuously improve data architecture and pipelines, establishing clear monitoring standards and operational controls.

  • Lead the planning for BI (Tableau) platform management, updates, enhancements, maintenance and stakeholder communication along with ensuring high availability, performance, and security. Ensure optimal data/BI platform operations and governance standards implementation aligned to operational best practices.

  • Establish foundational capabilities for AI-enabled analytics capabilities in BI platform and evolve them as organization needs mature.

  • Partner closely with stakeholders on the Analytics, Application Development, Data Collection Strategy & Operations, IT Operations, Product Management, and Regional Data Systems & Strategy teams to lead communication and own, create, drive, track, and execute project plans for owned workstreams, effectively managing competing priorities to ensure data availability and accuracy for users.

  • Lead sprint planning for assigned workstreams. Work on sprint execution and release delivery, ensuring aligned planning, timely outcomes, and resolution of dependencies and blockers to drive operational excellence.

  • Ensure transparency into progress, risks, and dependencies through consistent tracking and communication mechanisms.

  • Guide team member(s) on developing data and BI solutions with thorough validation and quality checks, and ensure up-to-date documentation.

  • Manage and develop one or more team members (FTEs or contractors) as needed, providing clear expectations, timely feedback, and coaching to support performance and accountability for results.

Skills and Mindsets

  • Mission and Student Focus: Demonstrates passion and commitment to KIPP’s mission and possesses the desire and ability to uphold KIPP’s Core Values (Focus on Excellent Results, Collective Impact, and Courageous Action)

  • Self-Management: Demonstrated record of co-creating ambitious goals with their managers – and driving toward desired outcomes; Effectively monitors progress toward goals for multiple workstreams; Leverages understanding of an organization’s operating model, structure, and core operational process to effectively drive work to achieve goals; effectively works through direct reports and peers to follow through on commitments, ensuring others do the same.

  • Work Management: Effectively drives work they own through clear action planning. Manages time effectively around competing priorities. Skilled in creating and executing project plans through partnership with stakeholders and effective delegation to achieve intended results on time. Skilled in knowledge management.

  • Process Management: Able to build and align goals and project plans with organization priorities; leverages relevant organizational processes and systems to execute work; can build and maintain knowledge management systems; effectively develops and codifies processes to ensure efficiency, alignment with organizational processes, and to improve work quality.

  • Problem-Solving: Generates solutions outside of their direct work and shrinks problems to solve independently. Shows initiative in generating and recommending ideas and solutions within their own workstreams. Anticipates risks and develops proactive solutions that support their team.

  • People Management & Development: Effective at developing and coaching teammates. Skilled in setting and managing both performance and development goals. Provides timely and actionable feedback to drive teammate development and performance; demonstrates accountability for the goals of their direct reports

  • Technical Proficiency: Has knowledge and skills in SQL, Spark, Pyspark, on-prem and cloud-based data platform management (SQL Server, Fabric/Snowflake, etc.) and architecture, CI/CD, ETL/data pipelines, version control, SSIS, agile sprint operations, project management tools, and machine learning principles.

Experience and Qualifications

  • 8+ years of professional experience in data engineering, infrastructure engineering, or a closely related technical field.

  • Experience with SQL-based data platforms (such as SQL Server) and modern cloud-based data warehouse/lakehouse platforms such as Fabric/OneLake, Snowflake, or Databricks including building & managing ETLs/ pipelines.

  • Experience managing and mentoring data engineers.

  • Strong technical proficiency in SSIS, Spark, PySpark, and SQL.

  • Demonstrated experience and expertise managing Tableau infrastructure (on-prem and cloud) and operations.

  • Experience with version control and CI/CD workflows using Git and platforms such as Bitbucket, GitHub, GitLab, or Azure DevOps.

  • Experience with SQL Server and MS Fabric/OneLake preferred.

  • Bachelor’s degree in data engineering, computer science, information systems, or a related field preferred; Master’s degree preferred.

Work Conditions

  • Travel: Low Travel: 10% (20 days per year)

  • Full, exempt role

Location

It is preferred, but not mandatory for this role to be based out of a KIPP Foundation office. This role also has the option of working from a remote office full-time. KIPP Foundation offices are in NYC and Chicago.

Compensation and Benefits

In compliance with local law, we are disclosing the compensation, or a range thereof, for roles in locations where legally required. Actual salaries will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to external market data, internal equity, and relevant experience. The salary range for this position is $120,000-145,000. In addition, KIPP Foundation provides a variety of benefits to employees, including: 

  • 25 holidays for + 18 days additional flexible PTO days (flexible PTO increases to 23 days for years 3 and 4 and to 28 days for years 5+).

  • 100% paid parental leave

  • 100% coverage of the premium for employee and 75% for employee + family’s medical/dental/vision plans.

  • Wellness benefits such as fitness reimbursements, discounted tickets to theme parks/attractions, backup care support for children and adults/elders, and our employee assistance program

  • Finance Security benefits include such as a 401K retirement plan with 4% match, employer-sponsored legal plans, life/disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts

KIPP Foundation embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects the diversity of the students and communities with whom we work and the world that’s around them. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, mental or physical disability, and genetic information, marital status, citizenship status, military status, protected veteran status or any other category protected by law.

About the Organization

KIPP Public Schools is a national network of tuition-free public charter schools that prepares students with the skills and confidence to create the future they want for themselves, their communities, and us all. We are a network of 279 schools, nearly 16,500 educators, and nearly 210,000 students and alumni.

Our mission: Together with families and communities, we create joyful, academically excellent schools that prepare students with the skills and confidence to pursue the paths they choose—college, career, and beyond—so they can lead fulfilling lives and build a more just world.

Our vision: Every child grows up free to create the future they want for themselves and their communities.

The KIPP Foundation is a nonprofit organization that supports KIPP public charter schools across the country. The KIPP Foundation helps to develop outstanding educators to lead KIPP schools; provides tools and resources for excellent teaching and learning; promotes innovation; and facilitates the exchange of insights and ideas across KIPP and other public schools and organizations.

About Our Values:

Excellent Results for Students: We value results over effort and know that our work is not finished until all students thrive. We maintain high expectations for self, team, and students. We drive outcomes by operating with agility, removing barriers, differentiating support, and prioritizing student-centered solutions—especially for those at the margins.

Collective Impact: We are one team. We win together. We embody a one-team mindset by working collaboratively across teams, aligning goals, and leveraging the strengths of all teammates. We build trust-based relationships and ensure inclusive decision-making by engaging those closest to the work. We provide clarity through simple, repeatable systems and goals that enable transformational outcomes.

Courageous Action: Our belief in what we can achieve is unwavering, fueling our optimism and commitment to overcome any challenge. We demonstrate an unwavering belief in students' potential and a commitment to addressing systemic inequities. We approach challenges with resilience, a solutions-focused mindset, and adaptability. We foster a psychologically safe environment centered on trust and accountability where feedback is encouraged. We leverage data to reflect on progress, own setbacks, celebrate successes, and continuously improve to maximize impact.

raw.description:
About Treasury Prime

Treasury Prime is the operating layer for modern banking. We run the largest bank network for embedded finance, connecting 20+ banks with the fintechs they power through modern APIs. We’re a small, senior, fully remote team (Clojure, React, Postgres, AWS, and a growing set of AI agents) with a culture built on mutual respect, collaboration, and ownership. We’re backed by Y Combinator, QED Investors, Nyca Partners, Deciens Capital, SaaStr Fund, Susa Ventures, and others.

The Role

We're hiring a Vice President of Engineering to lead software engineering, DevOps, and data, and to serve on our executive team reporting to the CEO. You'll own how we build, ship, and run the platform banks and fintechs depend on every day.

This is a leadership role first. You're technical and can go deep on architecture and tradeoffs with your team, but your job is building a strong team, setting clear direction, and keeping engineering closely tied to customers and the rest of the business. You lead through influence, earn trust across functions, and bring people along when priorities or practices need to change.

AI is changing what a small engineering team can build and how it adds value. You'll work with our CEO and VP of Product to shape our AI direction, challenge it where the evidence says so, and turn it into work the team can deliver.

In Your First Year

  • Earn the trust of the engineering team, and support and develop our engineering manager
  • Put in place the operating rhythms and standards the team needs, and build depth in DevOps and on-call so the load is sustainable
  • Partner with our Automation & Operations team on a long-term ownership model for security, IT, and DevOps
  • Become a trusted voice with our bank, fintech and product partners
  • Set the team, our technology, and the business up to scale, with AI expanding how much a small team can build and ship

What You'll Do

  • Lead the team: Coach and grow engineers, DevOps, data, and our engineering manager. Build a culture of ownership and pride in craft, and give direct, caring feedback. Make sure critical knowledge and on-call never rest on one person.
  • Set direction: Connect engineering strategy to company goals and customer outcomes. Evolve how the team plans, prioritizes, and ships, and raise quality and predictability without adding unnecessary process.
  • Keep customers at the center: Make sure the team understands the customer's problem before it builds, through call reviews, implementation work, and time with the people who talk to customers every day. Treat Revenue, Client Services, and Implementations as teammates: when they need help landing or supporting a customer, the team's first answer is how we can help, and you make capacity tradeoffs. Help the team see that customer focus means solving the customer's real problem, not building every request.
  • Build with AI: Treat AI as a way to change how we scale, not just a productivity add-on. Find places where AI can take on whole pieces of work in complex, regulated financial workflows, and measure success by results customers and partner banks can trust. Choose models and tools on cost and performance, revisit what's been built as the technology changes, and be willing to rebuild or retire what no longer makes sense. Lead by example, using AI in your own work so it becomes a natural part of how the team builds.
  • Work across the company: Contribute to company strategy as an exec team member and partner with our VP of Product as a true peer: challenge direction with data, then commit and lead the team through it. Make engineering a trusted partner to Revenue, Client Services, Implementations, Compliance, and Operations, and explain technical tradeoffs in plain business terms.
  • Run a secure, regulated platform: Guide architecture, own reliability and incident response, and own engineering's part in SOC 2, PCI, and bank partner security reviews. Make sure AI systems get security review that matches the responsibility they're given.

What You Bring

  • 7+ years in software engineering, including 3+ years leading engineering organizations through managers
  • Head of engineering experience (VP, Head of, or similar) with a seat on an executive or senior leadership team
  • A strong technical foundation in backend systems, APIs, and distributed architecture, plus experience leading DevOps or infrastructure and data teams (we run on AWS)
  • A track record of building teams people want to join and stay on, and leading them through constant change and innovation
  • Hands-on experience leading a team through AI adoption, with a clear view of where AI helps, where it doesn't, and how to change the way a team uses it
  • Comfort engaging with a founder-CEO's vision: debating it, pushing back with evidence, and turning it into something a team can build
  • Strong cross-functional partnerships, especially with sales and customer success, and a track record of putting engineers close to customers and using customer evidence to change what the team builds
  • Experience in a regulated or security-sensitive industry such as fintech, payments, or banking
  • Comfort in a small, fast-moving company where leaders are both strategic and hands-on

While these are not hard requirements, the best candidates will meet many of them.

Bonus Points

  • Banking as a Service, core banking, payments, or ledger experience
  • Clojure or other functional programming languages
  • Leading engineering at a B2B company under 100 people through the growing pains that come with scaling a business
  • Building or running a security program
  • Shipping LLM-based or agentic products

We look forward to hearing from you!

US Pay Range
$275,000—$320,000 USD
Canada Pay Range
$205,000—$240,000 CAD

Treasury Prime hires in the United States and Canada only. Applications from candidates residing outside these countries cannot be processed at this time.

Treasury Prime is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process, please get in touch with and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. Our team will respond to your email promptly.

raw.description:
Marketing Copywriter

Codekeeper is looking for a sharp, detail-oriented Marketing Copywriter with a strong grasp of modern web marketing - and a passion for writing that drives results. If you enjoy working in a fast-paced environment where your words directly influence performance, conversions, and brand perception, this role is for you.

We're looking for a highly skilled writer who can balance creativity with precision - someone who not only produces compelling copy but also understands how to structure, optimize, and refine content for maximum impact. You'll take ownership of key marketing assets, working hands-on across campaigns while continuously improving performance through iteration and insight.

We're accepting applications for the next two months and will fill the position as soon as we've found the perfect match.

About the Role

As a Marketing Copywriter, you'll work across multiple projects with a strong focus on crafting high-performing marketing copy. You will be responsible for producing, refining, and optimizing content that aligns with business objectives and drives measurable results.

This role goes beyond writing - you’ll be expected to understand search intent, apply SEO and CRO principles, analyze performance, and continuously improve output. In our fast-paced environment, you won’t just deliver copy - you’ll actively shape and elevate how we communicate as a brand.

What You’ll Be Doing

Write and Optimize:

  • Create high-quality, conversion-focused copy for websites, landing pages, emails, and campaigns
  • Write compelling CTAs, sales collateral, and funnel content designed to drive action
  • Produce SEO-optimized content aligned with search intent and structured for readability and performance
  • Develop and refine landing pages with a strong focus on conversion rate optimization (CRO)
  • Use AI tools effectively

Edit and Elevate:

  • Edit and refine content to ensure clarity, consistency, and high quality
  • Maintain and enforce a consistent brand voice across all channels
  • Apply strong attention to detail across all deliverables

Analyze and Improve:

  • Monitor content performance and identify opportunities for improvement
  • Iterate on copy based on data, testing, and insights
  • Continuously optimize messaging to improve engagement and conversion rates

Collaborate and Deliver:

  • Work closely with marketing, design, and development teams to execute campaigns
  • Manage briefs effectively and ensure alignment across stakeholders
  • Balance speed and quality, delivering strong work within tight timelines
  • Contribute to a culture of high standards and continuous improvement

Why Codekeeper?

Codekeeper was founded by tech industry professionals to revolutionize software escrow for the cloud era. We offer state-of-the-art disaster recovery solutions that mitigate third-party risks in business operations. As a remote-first company with a central office in The Hague, we prioritize a healthy, resilient organization to support the development of our robust app.

🌐

raw.description:
Money Canvas is a free online coaching program that helps people build healthier budgeting, savings, and spending behaviors. Our mission is to help people see their money in a new way and take practical steps to find more breathing room in their day-to-day finances. The program offers user-friendly, virtual guided sessions designed to make conversations about money less intimidating that help families and individuals free up more money to put toward their financial priorities.

The Money Coach position offers a unique opportunity for a highly motivated individual to work for a fast-paced, growth-oriented program while also making a meaningful impact.

Coaches provide personalized, one-on-one coaching to help people build money management skills at their own pace. They help families and individuals unlock behavioral changes through empathy and accountability, build working relationships with people from a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences while empowering people to understand their current behaviors and help them commit to small changes that add up over time.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Behavioral Coaching:

  • Work with hundreds of individuals across academic, geographic, socioeconomic, cultural, linguistic, and ethnic backgrounds each year to share foundational money management lessons and spark healthier habits around budgeting, saving, and spending
  • Conduct one-on-one virtual money coaching sessions with participants by facilitating a dialogue that prompts critical thinking and self-awareness while navigating a shared digital experience.
  • Pilot experimental coaching protocols and techniques as a part of a test-driven environment to merge behavior change with digital technology
  • Apply motivational interviewing techniques (e.g., active listening, probing questions, withholding opinions/advice) to create a judgment-free space for participants to learn, reflect, and commit to healthy behavior changes
  • Create personalized action plans that align to participants’ goals, breaking major objectives into practical, manageable steps.
  • Motivate, guide, and empower participants to progress through the Money Canvas program and meet their financial wellness goals
  • Make appropriate referrals to other support services as needed (e.g., credit counseling)

Client Relationship Management:

  • Establish and maintain excellent relationships with participants to provide ongoing support between sessions – address inquiries, reinforce new perspectives on money management, celebrate progress, and work through setbacks
  • Maintain client data in a customer relationship management (CRM) platform, capturing all required client information and documenting consistent and accurate client notes for impact reporting and relationship handoffs
  • Coordinate and schedule coaching appointments while remaining responsive to daily inflows of phone, text, and email communications with clients.

Ongoing Administrative Work:

  • Actively manage appointment calendar, input client and session data in a timely manner, participate in professional development, and complete ongoing training as provided, on programs and services
  • Communicate in a timely manner with your team and other stakeholders who may contact you with inquiries about the program (e.g., Thrivent Financial Advisors, other Thrivent employees, case workers from partner organizations)
  • Adheres to all policies guidelines related to Money Canvas operations, by being reliable to work schedules and responsibilities, following regulatory and quality-control requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS:

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Minimum of two years of work experience in financial services, financial planning, economic development, social work, community organizing, teaching, or other related fields
  • Strong empathy / high levels of emotional intelligence
  • Excellent communication skills and responsiveness
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and productively in a virtual setting
  • High-energy individual who demonstrates confidence, accountability, and strong time management skills.
  • Demonstrate flexibility and adaptive positive attitude in a constantly changing environment
  • Detail-oriented, with a willingness to learn new skills and techniques to promote quality, efficiency, and successful customer outcomes
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office – Word, Excel, Power Point, Outlook – and videoconferencing platforms (e.g., MS Teams, Zoom)

Preferred:

  • Bilingual in English and Spanish
  • Prior experience as a financial coach
  • Demonstrated financial literacy / understanding of money management concepts
  • Demonstrated propensity to learn, use, and implement behavioral and financial literacy learning strategies
  • Experience working with families from all income levels in one or more of the following areas: financial goal setting; budgeting; credit building/rebuilding and debt repayment.
  • Dedicated individual to engage/motivate/encourage customers and help them resolve financial challenges and accomplish goals.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Teams and Microsoft Bookings
Pay TransparencyThrivent’s long-term growth depends on attracting, rewarding, and retaining people who are committed to helping others thrive with purpose. We accomplish this by offering a wide variety of market competitive compensation programs to attract, reward, and retain top talent. The applicable salary or hourly wage range for this full-time role is $22.92 - $31.01 per hour, which factors in various geographic regions. The base pay actually offered will be determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to, location, relevant experience, skills, and knowledge, business needs, market demand, and other factors Thrivent deems important.Thrivent is unique in our commitment to helping people to be wise with money and live balanced and generous lives. That extends to our benefits.The following benefits may be offered: various bonuses (including, for example, annual or long-term incentives); medical, dental, and vision insurance; health savings account; flexible spending account; 401k; pension; life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance; disability insurance; supplemental protection insurance; 20 days of Paid Time Off each year; Sick and Safe Time; 10 paid company holidays; Volunteer Time Off; paid parental leave; EAP; well-being benefits, and other employee benefits. Eligibility for receipt of these benefits is subject to the applicable plan/policy documents. Thrivent’s plans/policies are subject to change at any time at Thrivent’s discretion.

This policy applies to all employees and job applicants.

Summary of the Role

Weare looking for an experienced and dynamic Senior Planner (Land Development) to become an integral part of our private-sector team. In this pivotal role, the Senior Planner will spearhead the strategy, planning, and execution of private land development projects while also managing a team. This is a great opportunity to have a hand in the growth and success of our operation.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee corporate programs, including contract preparation, setting schedules, assigning projects, tracking performance, providing mentorship, setting standards, and acting as primary liaison to the client.
  • Oversee complex projects that require senior level experience. Provide expertise in site planning, due diligence, land use entitlements, and construction permitting.

  • Collaborate with the project team to develop site plans that meet the client’s objectives.

  • Oversee subconsultant contracts and deliverables, such as land survey, traffic, geotechnical, environmental, etc. Oversee the timely preparation of complete, high-quality applications for land use entitlements.
  • Advocate for prompt review of application materials and coordinate responses to comments.
  • Represent the client at meetings and public hearings to advocate for project approval.
  • Oversee staff on the processing of ministerial construction permit applications.
  • Collaborate with team members using standard tracking tools, checklists, file management systems, etc. Collaborate with team members to continually refine & improve materials and procedures.

If you’re driven, collaborative, and ready to take the next step in your career, we want to hear from you. The following qualifications will help you succeed in this role:

  • Proficient knowledge of project management processes and the principles and practices associated with land development.
  • Proven track record of effectively leading and managing high-performing teams, fostering collaboration, and achieving successful project outcomes.
  • Ability to prioritize a diverse workload, resolve complex issues, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced setting.
  • Ability to communicate well with clients and team members, strong technical writing skills, and public speaking proficiency.
  • Experience in multiple sectors is preferred (commercial, industrial, residential, energy, etc.).
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to identify practical uses for company-approved AI tools to improve team processes, support better decisions, and increase efficiency
  • Demonstrated ability to review AI-generated content for accuracy, protect confidential information, and remain responsible for the final work product

Work Location

This is a remote position that needs to be in driving distance of Sterling, VA. Ideal candidates will be in VA or MD. Some travel will be required to support a client.

Company Overview

Core States Group is an industry-leading architecture, engineering, and construction (A/E/C) firm trusted by many of the world’s most notable brands. With 26 offices across the United States and Canada, the firm delivers speed to market, cost certainty, and compelling design for national multisite programs and projects.

Established in 1999, Core States Group drives innovation and improves everyday life for countless people across several markets, including Convenience, Distributed Generation, Financial, Grocery, Housing, Industrial, Restaurants, Retail, Semiconductor, Zero-Emission Vehicle (ZEV) Infrastructure, and more.

A Note to Candidates

At Core States Group, we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, so if you are excited about this role but your experience does not align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

raw.description:
Perforce is a community of collaborative experts, problem solvers, and possibility seekers who believe work should be both challenging and fun. We are proud to inspire creativity, foster belonging, support collaboration, and encourage wellness. At Perforce, you’ll work with and learn from some of the best and brightest in business. Before you know it, you’ll be in the middle of a rewarding career at a company headed in one direction: upward.
 
With a global footprint spanning more than 80 countries and including over 75% of the Fortune 100, Perforce Software, Inc. is trusted by the world’s leading brands to deliver solutions for the toughest challenges. The best run DevOps teams in the world choose Perforce. 

Position Summary:

Director / Senior Director, Product Management to lead product management for Perforce’s infrastructure automation business. This position will report to VP Product. Your mandate is to build a growth engine for infrastructure automation in the AI era, and to bring compliance and controls to infrastructure. At Perforce, product management runs on an AI-enabled operating model, and you will lead your team in it. You will own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the platform across its full lifecycle, and lead a team of 5–6 senior product managers. You will partner closely with Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, and the broader Perforce portfolio to drive adoption, retention, and growth.

About the Product:

The product is Perforce’s desired-state automation platform. It helps teams manage infrastructure wherever it is hosted, from the data center to the cloud, by automating repetitive tasks and configuration to prevent drift and reduce manual effort. Customers define custom policies, enforce them continuously, and automate reporting for audits, making the platform a trusted choice for security and compliance. More than 40,000 organizations rely on it to keep their systems in a desired state.

Responsibilities:

Product Strategy and Vision:

  • Define and own the product vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for the platform, aligned with Perforce portfolio direction and business goals.

  • Identify and prioritize investments across the core business and new opportunities, including where AI can change what the platform is responsible for in customers’ infrastructure operations.

  • Establish clear outcomes and success metrics for every major initiative, and hold the team accountable to measurable customer and business results.

Leadership and Team Management:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of 5–6 senior product managers, setting clear ownership and a high bar for quality.

  • Build a culture of discovery, evidence-based decision making, and clear communication, including surfacing risks and bad news early.

  • Hire and retain top product talent, and add specialist skills where the problem demands them.

Product Development Lifecycle:

  • Oversee the product development lifecycle from discovery through launch and post-release outcome review, partnering with Engineering to deliver on commitments.
  • Ensure problems are validated with customers before significant build investment, and that features ship with the instrumentation needed to measure their effect, including in on-premise deployments.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment on release planning, packaging, pricing, and go-to-market readiness.

Customer and Market Engagement:

  • Engage directly with customers, partners, and the open source and DevOps community to understand needs and validate direction.
  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Support to turn customer signal into roadmap decisions and to ensure customers realize the business value they bought.
  • Track the competitive landscape and analyst perspectives, and shape the product’s positioning and differentiation in the market.

Innovation and Thought Leadership:

  • Evaluate emerging technologies and trends in infrastructure automation, security, compliance, and AI-assisted operations.
  • Represent the product externally as a thought leader at industry events, with customers, and with analysts.
  • Identify partnership, ecosystem, and build/buy opportunities that strengthen the product’s long-term position.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in product management, with at least 3 years in a leadership role within the DevOps, cloud, or software development space.
  • Proven track record of delivering complex enterprise software solutions from concept to launch.
  • Extensive experience managing and growing product teams, with a demonstrated ability to lead and motivate cross-functional teams.
  • Strong background in Agile development methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and working closely with engineering teams.
  • Exceptional strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Strong technical acumen, with the ability to collaborate with engineering teams on architectural and technical discussions.
  • Deep understanding of DevOps practices, including configuration management, infrastructure as code (IaC), continuous integration and delivery, and containerization (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Expertise in product lifecycle management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Aha!).
  • Strong customer-centric mindset with an ability to understand market needs and translate them into actionable product solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience defining and shipping AI-powered product capabilities (for example generative AI or agentic automation), including how they are evaluated, governed, and measured in production.
  • Experience leading product managers in an AI-enabled product management operating model, where AI is used across discovery, specification, and delivery, and every artifact still has a named human owner accountable for its quality.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Puppet, Ansible, Chef, Terraform, or similar infrastructure automation platforms.
  • Experience with open-source business models and on-premise and hybrid enterprise deployments.
  • Experience selling to or building compliance and security-driven buyers.
  • Experience bringing AI into infrastructure operations, such as AI-assisted authoring, remediation, or compliance, and a point of view on how AI changes what an automation product is responsible for.
  • Familiarity with AI product risks: accuracy and evaluation, guardrails and human approval, data privacy, and customer trust in on-premise and regulated environments.
  • Experience building or adopting an AI PM operating model: defined agent roles, evidence standards, review gates, and measures of the team’s speed and quality of learning.
  • Proven leadership presence with the ability to influence and engage at all levels of the organization.
  • Highly collaborative with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Passionate about DevOps, automation, and delivering high-value products that solve real-world customer problems.
Additionally, this position is eligible for benefits including, but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, retirement benefits, life insurance, wellness programs, total time off, and other employee perks that may be offered by Perforce from time to time. The actual offer will depend on a number of factors including, but not limited to, a candidate’s education, skills, qualifications, depth of experience and other relevant business considerations. Perforce reserves the right to amend or modify employee perks and benefits at any time.

All employees are expected to demonstrate AI fluency appropriate to their role and level, including responsible use of AI tools, sound judgment, and adherence to company AI governance and security policy standards.

Come work with us! Our team members are valued for their contributions, introduced to new opportunities, and rewarded well. Perforce combines the experience and rewards of a start-up with the security of an established and privately held profitable company.
If you are passionate about the technology that impacts our day-to-day lives and want to work with talented and dedicated people across the globe, apply today!

raw.description:
Job Overview

Responsible for monitoring, analyzing, and reporting on program performance metrics. Develops and maintains program schedules, budgets, and forecasts to ensure alignment with organizational goals. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify risks, implement corrective actions, and support decision-making processes. Provides detailed reports and presentations to stakeholders to facilitate effective program management and control.

Essential Functions

  • Provide project management/administrative support and coordination to a complex contract, project, task(s) or business unit.
  • Provide support to Project Managers in the preparation and analysis of project financial data and other contract, project or business-related tasks.
  • Duties may include contract accounting and reporting, project schedule focus to management, tracking annual fiscal plans and monthly updates
  • Maintain contract budgets, prepare contract-billing (e.g., Wide Area Workflow ‘WAWF’), estimates materials, equipment, production costs and delivery schedules
  • Implement and provide financial controls, procedures, system requirements, and forecasting techniques, as directed, to evaluate contract/program status and ensure compliance with government and customer requirements
  • Monitor progress of program requirements and cost performance against plans to ensure contractual cost obligations are met
  • Prepare financial/administrative reports and distributes to customers/user organizations
  • Conduct financial analysis at varying levels – inclusive of individual programs and the business units they belong to (variance analysis, risk analysis, profit/loss analysis, etc.)
  • Perform other duties as required.

Standard Essential Functions

  • Regular and reliable attendance on a full time basis [or in accordance with posted schedule].
  • Responsible for exhibiting professional behavior with both internal and external business associates that reflects positively on the company and is consistent with the company's policies and practices.
  • Embodies AEVEX’s cultural values and aligns daily actions with department goals and company culture.

Qualifications and Competencies

  • Working knowledge of finance law and regulatory standards (GAAP, FAR, CAS)
  • Working knowledge in government contract types (T&M, CPFF, FFP) and ability to properly account for each type of contract, including a working knowledge of revenue recognition for each contract type.
  • Must be well-experienced with Microsoft Excel and have familiarity with MS Project.
  • Working knowledge of Earned Value Management is not required, but desired
  • Ability to relate to all levels of the organizations
  • Self-motivator, independent, organized, cooperative, flexible, creative

Education / Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, accounting, finance, or related field

Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in US Government project related finance using financial management software (Deltek, Business Central, QuickBooks, SAP, ORACLE ERP, Peachtree/Sage 50 Accounting, etc.)

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties the employee is:

  • Frequently required to sit, and to reach to use computers and other office equipment

For the purpose of this summary, occasionally is used to represent up to 1/3 of the time given to the work day, frequently represents 1/3 to 2/3 of the time and constantly represents 2/3 or more of the time.

Security Clearance

  • S. Citizenship required.

About AEVEX

AEVEX, headquartered in Solana Beach, California, supports the U.S. national security mission and partner nation needs around the world by providing full-spectrum aviation, remote sensing, and analysis solutions. The company's capabilities include custom design and engineering; rapid prototyping; sensor integration and sustainment; aircraft modification and certification; flight test instrumentation and support; mission operations service; advanced intelligence data processing, exploitation, and dissemination solutions; and tailored hardware and software mission-system tools. AEVEX uses agile and customized approaches to rapidly define, develop, and deliver specialized solutions for airborne special mission needs for the U.S. Government, partner nations, and commercial businesses. AEVEX has major offices in California, Florida, North Carolina, Ohio, and Virginia.

AEVEX provides a full suite of comprehensive benefits, including a 401(k)-retirement plan, comprehensive Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability and Life insurance group coverage with a portion of the premiums paid by the company, professional development funds, and an Employee Assistance Plan (EAP) with counseling, legal help, child and elder care support, among other benefits for qualified employees.

raw.description:
Make a difference. Be happy. Grow your career.

The Role

The Service Management CMDB Advisor possesses an advanced understanding of ITIL processes and principles and a highly technical knowledge of Configuration Management Database (CMDB) requirements. Responsibilities include implementing, configuring and maintaining all CMDB policies, processes, work instructions and activities. This will be done in compliance with the information technology infrastructure library (ITIL) framework. This role works with the teams necessary to define and implement all mechanisms needed to ensure full control of the Configurable Items and maintaining an up-to-date record of those items.


Key Responsibilities

The Service Management CMDB Advisor (SA) normally works independently, with coordination across Service Management delivery. Responsibilities include:

  • ITOM & Discovery Leadership: Drive the end-to-end deployment of ITOM Visibility, including robust Discovery and automated Service Mapping to define business service dependencies
  • IRE & Governance: Act as the technical authority for the Identification and Reconciliation Engine (IRE). You will define data source precedence and maintain high-integrity data in a multi-source CMDB environment
  • CSDM Stewardship: Champion the adoption of CSDM 4.0 standards, ensuring all technical assets are accurately mapped to business services and application portfolios
  • Service Delivery Integration: Partner with Incident, Change, and Major Incident management teams to provide real-time impact analysis, reducing MTTR through dependency visualization
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Act as the primary liaison between ITOM and functional teams, including Application Portfolio Management (APM) and Asset Management (SAM/HAM), ensuring data consistency across all platforms
  • Ensuring that the Configuration Items required to deliver services are accurate and reliable information about those items is available when and where needed
  • Performing configuration audits to check that the physical IT inventory is consistent with the asset and CMDB and initiates necessary corrective action
  • Maintaining traceability of all current and historical data relative to each configuration item throughout its life cycle
  • Identifying and implementing opportunities to better govern inventory and CMDB processes through continual service improvement
  • Ensuring configuration management processes, workflows, and activities are documented and followed
  • Performing data entry to populate non-discoverable software and hardware CI data in the ITSM CMDB
  • Engaging and working with field resources and IT service delivery teams to identify and then collect missing Configuration Item (CI) information
  • Providing ad-hoc reports for Configuration Items

Required Skills And Experience

  • Generally, requires a Bachelor's degree and 5 years of related experience, a Master's degree and 3 years of related experience, or 8 years of related experience and no degree.
  • Degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, system analysis or a related study, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years’ experience in ServiceNow platform administration or architecture, with a specific focus on CMDB/ITOM suite.
  • ITIL v4 certification required
  • Knowledge of Information Technology principles and processes
  • Understanding of Discovery patterns, JavaScript, and JSON.
  • Proven success in configuring IRE rules and Service Graph Connectors is preferred
  • Understanding of IT standards and controls
  • Demonstrated ability to execute top-down service mapping to provide visibility into application traffic patterns and infrastructure dependencies
  • Excellent analytical, planning, organizational and technical and skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Specific experience in process optimization in a technology environment
  • Exposure to multiple, diverse technologies, platforms, and processing environments
  • Good understanding of strategic and emerging technology trends, and the practical application of existing and emerging technologies to new and evolving business and operating models
  • Experience working in healthcare is required
  • Experience developing internal and external relationships
  • Experience delivering presentations to leadership, customer and technical audiences

Additional Details

  • Travel including overnight domestic trips may be required.
  • 10% travel

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Golang Developer to design and build high-performance backend services, infrastructure tooling, and cloud-native applications using Go. In this role you will work on systems where latency, concurrency, and operational efficiency are first-class concerns, and you will contribute to a codebase shared by engineers across multiple teams. The ideal candidate will combine strong Go expertise with broad systems knowledge, including network programming, container ecosystems, and distributed system design. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and implement performant backend services and APIs in Go, with strong attention to concurrency, error handling, and resource management.
  • Build cloud-native applications using Go and Kubernetes-native libraries, applying idiomatic Go patterns, well-defined module boundaries, and operational hooks that make the resulting services easy to deploy and run.
  • Develop CLI tools, Kubernetes controllers, and custom operators for internal platforms, designing clear command surfaces, robust error handling, and reconciliation logic that operates safely in long-running environments.
  • Implement gRPC and REST APIs with appropriate observability and security.
  • Profile and optimize Go applications for memory, GC, and goroutine behavior, applying systematic measurement, targeted improvements, and data-driven validation to deliver quantifiable gains in throughput, latency, or resource efficiency.
  • Integrate with messaging systems (Kafka, NATS) and data stores (PostgreSQL, Redis, etcd).
  • Build comprehensive automated tests, including unit, integration, and benchmark tests.
  • Implement structured logging, metrics emission, and distributed tracing throughout services so that operators and on-call engineers have the signals they need to diagnose issues and reason about system behavior.
  • Lead code reviews and uphold engineering standards in Go projects.
  • Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time.
  • Contribute meaningfully to internal Go libraries, shared platform tooling, and reusable patterns that accelerate development across multiple engineering teams and codify hard-won best practices.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Continuously evaluate Go ecosystem evolution and contribute to internal patterns.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of professional software engineering experience, with significant time in Go.
  • Strong understanding of Go concurrency patterns (goroutines, channels, contexts).
  • Hands-on experience building production gRPC and/or REST APIs in Go.
  • Experience with Kubernetes-native development (client-go, controller-runtime).
  • Solid experience with relational and key-value data stores.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems and networking fundamentals.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and container-based deployment.
  • Excellent debugging and performance-engineering skills.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Open-source contributions to Go-based projects.
  • Experience writing Kubernetes operators or controllers.

  • Exposure to security-sensitive Go projects (cryptography, auth).

Job Description:

As a Technical Program Manager at Parsons, you will work with directly with clients, technical directors, and drive development teams to deliver mission impacting systems and solutions. Strong understanding of international engagement, future generation wireless and systems is required for this position. You’ll be Responsible for the full lifecycle management of complex research and development projects focused on advancing wireless communication capabilities and pioneering 6G security paradigms for the Department of War (DoW). This role requires an understanding of current military and other US government agency’s processes and taskings that are focused on monitoring and securing communications. Technical capabilities are specifically needed in wireless communication technologies, DoW Science & Technology (S&T) priorities, program management principles, and specialized technical expertise in 6G security architectures, threat mitigation, and zero-trust network integration. The Project Manager will lead multi-disciplinary teams in a dynamic and often classified environment to ensure that projects are aligned with DoW strategic goals, delivered on time and within budget, and transition successfully to operational use, providing enhanced, hardened, and highly resilient next-generation (6G) communication capabilities for warfighters. The Project Manager will assist in coordination with other military and government agencies to align strategic objectives.
